scenario_en: Benchmarks for minimally acceptable behaviors of community members are:
scenario_cn: 社群成员最低可接受⾏为的基准是：

options.A: a code of ethics . 道德准则。
options.B: laws and regulations. 法律法规。
options.C: standards of conduct. ⾏为标准。

explanation: C 正确。⾏为标准（ standards of conduct ）适⽤于特定社群或社会群体，明确成员必须遵守的具体⾏为， 是社群成员最低可接受⾏为的基准。 A 错：道德准则只是成员应如何⾏事的⼀般性指引，传达组织价值观和 总体期望，但不指明具体⾏为。 B 错：法律法规由政府及相关实体制定，适⽤于其管辖范围内所有个⼈和实 体，不限于特定社群成员。（当时未作答）
method: 抓住关键词 minimally acceptable behaviors ，对应 standards of conduct ； code of ethics 是 " ⼀般指引 " ⽽⾮ 具体基准。
header: 基本概念 · ⾏为标准定义 当时未作答

scenario_en: Specialized knowledge and skills, a commitment to serve others, and a shared code of ethics best characterize a(n):
scenario_cn: 专业知识与技能、服务他⼈的承诺以及共享的道德 准则，最能描述的是：

options.A: vocation. 天职 /志业。
options.B: profession. 职业（专业） 。
options.C: occupation. ⼀般⼯作 / ⾏当。

explanation: B 正确。职业（ profession ）区别于⼀般⾏当或志业的特征包括：专业知识与技能、服务他⼈、成员共享 的道德准则。职业是⾏当的终极演进形态，源于卓越实践、精益求精的⼼态以及对道德准则与执业标准的恪 守。 A、 C 均不具备这⼀整套特征组合。（当时未作答）
method: 三⼤特征组合（专业知识 + 服务他⼈ + 共享道德准则）直接锁定 profession 。
header: 基本概念 · 职业的特征 当时未作答

scenario_en: When unethical behavior erodes trust in an investment firm, that firm is more likely to experience:
scenario_cn: 当不道德⾏为侵蚀了市场对某投资公司的信任时， 该公司更可能经历：

options.A: lower revenues only . 仅收⼊下降。
options.B: higher expenses only . 仅费⽤上升。
options.C: lower revenues and higher expenses. 收⼊下降且费⽤上升。

explanation: C 正确。不道德⾏为最终伤害投资公司：客⼾若怀疑公司⾏为不端便不会上⻔，业务减少导致收⼊下 降；同时监管机构更可能发起代价⾼昂的调查，使公司相对成本上升。 A 、 B 各只说对了⼀半，均不完整。 （当时未作答）
method: 信任受损有双重后果 —— 需求端收⼊降、监管端成本升，选 " 两者兼有 " 的选项。
header: 信任的经济后果 · 对公司的影响 当时未作答

scenario_en: High ethical standards are distinguishing features of which of the following bodies?
scenario_cn: ⾼道德标准是下列哪类组织的区别性特征？

options.A: Craft guilds ⼿⼯业⾏会
options.B: Trade bodies ⾏业协会
options.C: Professional bodies 职业团体

explanation: C 正确。⾼道德标准使职业（团体）区别于⼿⼯业⾏会或⾏业协会。与⾏业协会不同，职业团体通常还 负有服务社会的使命，并对从业者执⾏职业⾏为准则。 A 、 B 均不以设定并维护⾼道德标准为宗旨。（当时未 作答）
method: "⾼道德标准 + 服务社会使命 + 执⾏⾏为准则 " 三位⼀体 → professional bodies 。
header: 基本概念 · 职业团体的特征 当时未作答

scenario_en: Fiduciary duty is a standard most likely to be upheld by members of a(n):
scenario_cn: 受托责任（ fiduciary duty ）这⼀标准最可能由下列哪 类主体的成员恪守：

options.A: employer . 雇主。
options.B: profession. 职业（专业） 。
options.C: not-for -profit body . ⾮营利组织。

explanation: B 正确。受托责任是指为另⼀⽅利益⾏事时交付⾼标准的谨慎义务。职业⼈⼠必须以客⼾最佳利益⾏ 事，运⽤合理⽔平的谨慎、技能与勤勉。其他实体（雇主、监管机构、⾏业协会、⾮营利组织）虽也⽀持⾏ 业发展，但并⾮以设定和维护职业标准为⼰任，与职业团体不同。 A 、 C 均不正确。（当时未作答）
method: fiduciary duty 是职业⼈⼠对客⼾的核⼼义务，直接对应 profession 。
header: 基本概念 · 受托责任 当时未作答

scenario_en: Which of the following best identifies an internal trait that may lead to poor ethical decision making?
scenario_cn: 下列哪项最贴切地指出了可能导致糟糕道德决策的 内在特质？

options.A: Overconfidence 过度⾃信
options.B: Loyalty to employer 对雇主的忠诚
options.C: Promise of money or prestige ⾦钱或声望的诱惑

explanation: A 正确。过度⾃信偏差会使⼈过分看重内在特质与内在动机（例如⾃认诚实），从⽽导致错误决策。 B 、 C 错：对雇主的忠诚、⾦钱或声望的诱惑都属于情境影响（ situational influences ），不是内在特质。（当时未作 答）
method: 区分 internal trait （内在特质：过度⾃信）与 situational influence （外部情境：忠诚、⾦钱诱惑） 。
header: ⾏为偏差 · 内在特质 vs 情境影响 当时未作答

scenario_en: Situational influences in decision making will most likely be minimized if:
scenario_cn: 下列哪种做法最可能使决策中的情境影响最⼩化？

options.A: strong compliance programs are in place. 建⽴强有⼒的合规项⽬。
options.B: longer -term consequences are considered. 考虑更⻓期的后果。
options.C: individuals believe they are truthful and honest. 个⼈相信⾃⼰诚实守信。

explanation: B 正确。有意识地考虑⻓期后果有助于抵消情境影响。我们更容易识别短期情境因素，⽽⻓期考虑缺乏 即时后果，容易被忽视；决策过于聚焦短期时，糟糕道德决策的概率上升。 A 错：强有⼒的合规项⽬只是建 设道德⽂化的第⼀步，过度强调规则反⽽可能变成另⼀种情境影响，使员⼯忽视其他重要因素。 C 错： " 我很 诚实不会撒谎 " 是过度⾃信偏差，研究表明内在特质通常不是是否道德⾏事的主要决定因素。（当时未作答）
method: 情境影响的解药是拉⻓时间视⻆；合规⽂化可能本⾝沦为情境影响；⾃认诚实属于过度⾃信。
header: ⾏为偏差 · 情境影响的化解 当时未作答

scenario_en: Decision makers who use a compliance approach are most likely to:
scenario_cn: 采⽤合规（ compliance ）路径的决策者最可能：

options.A: avoid situational influences . 避免情境影响。
options.B: oversimplify decision making. 过度简化决策。
options.C: consider more factors than when using an ethical decision- making approach.⽐采⽤道德决策路径时考虑更多因素。

explanation: B 正确。合规路径会过度简化决策，且不⿎励决策者着眼⼤局；强合规⽂化虽是建设道德⽂化的良好开 端，却可能沦为另⼀种情境影响，使员⼯忽视其他重要因素。 A 错：合规路径本⾝可能成为情境影响，⽆法 避免之。 C 错：与道德决策路径相⽐，合规路径考虑的因素更少⽽⾮更多。（当时未作答）
method: 合规路径 = 规则导向、视野窄 → 关键词 oversimplify 。
header: 道德⽂化 · 合规路径的局限 当时未作答

scenario_en: To maintain trust , the investment management profession must be interdependent with:
scenario_cn: 为维持信任，投资管理⾏业必须与下列哪类主体相 互依存：

options.A: regulators. 监管机构。
options.B: employers. 雇主。
options.C: investment firms. 投资公司。

explanation: C 正确。投资管理⾏业与投资公司必须相互依存才能维持信任。 A 、 B 错：雇主和监管机构各有⾃⼰的 标准与实务，可能与职业团体制定的法规和标准不同，并⾮⾏业信任所要求的相互依存对象。（当时未作答）
method: ⾏业（ profession ） ↔ 公司（ firms ）相互依存是教材原⽂表述，直接记忆。
header: ⾏业信任 · 相互依存关系 当时未作答

scenario_en: Which is an example of an activity that may be legal but that CFA Institute considers unethical?
scenario_cn: 下列哪项是可能合法但被 CFA 协会视为不道德的⾏ 为⽰例？

options.A: Making legally required disclosures in marketing materials 在营销材料中作出法律要求的披露
options.B: Trading while in possession of material nonpublic information 在持有重⼤⾮公开信息时进⾏交易
options.C: Disclosure by an employee of his or her own company’ s dishonest activity员⼯披露其⾃⼰公司的不诚实⾏为

explanation: B 正确。投资⾏业存在合法但被 CFA 协会视为不道德的⾏为。持有重⼤⾮公开信息进⾏交易并未在全球 所有法域被法律禁⽌，因此在某些地⽅可能合法，但 CFA 协会认为此类交易不道德。 A 是履⾏法定义务，道 德上⽆问题； C 是正当的举报⾏为。（当时未作答）
method: 找"合法但违反更⾼道德标准 " 的⾏为：内幕信息交易是经典例⼦。
header: 道德 vs 法律 · 合法但不道德 当时未作答

scenario_en: An ethical decision-making framework will most likely :
scenario_cn: 道德决策框架最可能：

options.A: include a pre-determined, uniform sequence. 包含预先确定的统⼀顺序。
options.B: focus exclusively on confirmable facts and relationships. 只关注可证实的事实与关系。
options.C: help avoid a decision that has unanticipated ethical consequences.帮助避免产⽣未预料道德后果的决策。

explanation: C 正确。持续使⽤道德决策框架有助于培养健全的判断⼒与决策技能，避免作出带有未预料道德后果的 决定。 A 错：决策过程往往是迭代的，决策者可以在框架各阶段之间往返，并⾮固定顺序。 B 错：决策者应 考虑的不⽌是可证实的事实与关系，还应考虑情境影响和个⼈偏差。（当时未作答）
method: 框架是迭代⽽⾮线性的，且要考虑偏差与情境；其⽬的是避免未预料的道德后果。
header: 道德决策框架 · 框架的作⽤ 当时未作答

scenario_en: When an ethical dilemma occurs, an investment professional should most likely first raise the issue with a:
scenario_cn: 出现道德困境时，投资专业⼈⼠最应该⾸先向谁提 出该问题：

options.A: mentor outside the firm. 公司外部的导师。
options.B: professional body’ s hotline. 职业团体的热线。
options.C: senior individual in the firm. 公司内部的⾼级⼈员。

explanation: C 正确。出现困境时，先在公司内部向⾼级员⼯反映通常是良好的起点，也为独⽴的内部审查创造了机 会。保护客⼾与公司的利益可能优先于提出关切的个⼈之职位处境。 A 、 B 均为内部途径⽆法解决时的后续选 项，⽽⾮⾸选。（当时未作答）
method: 道德困境⾸选内部升级：先找公司内⾼级⼈员，再考虑外部热线或导师。
header: 道德困境 · 升级处理路径 当时未作答

scenario_en: Which of the following statements is most accurate ? Ethical principles are sets of beliefs centered around:
scenario_cn: 下列哪项表述最准确？道德原则是围绕什么形成的 ⼀套信念：

options.A: societies’ views on what is considered good or bad conduct 社会关于何为良好或不良⾏为的看法
options.B: acceptable conduct based on the direct and indirect consequences on others基于对他⼈直接和间接后果的可接受⾏为
options.C: rules established by a government with regard to what is acceptable behavior政府就何为可接受⾏为所订⽴的规则

explanation: A 正确。道德原则可描述为社会关于何为良好或不良⾏为的信念；道德是社群或社会群体所期望或要求 的⾏为标准⽅⾯的共享信念或道德原则。 B 错：基于道德原则的可接受⾏为要在⾃⾝利益与他⼈直接、间接 后果之间取得平衡，⽽⾮只看后果。 C 错：合乎道德的可接受⾏为是在法律要求之外判定的，⾏为合法也可 能不道德。（当时未作答）
method: ethics = 社会共享的善恶信念；注意 " 合法 ≠ 合乎道德 " 这⼀区分。
header: 基本概念 · 道德原则的定义 当时未作答

scenario_en: A research analyst is facing a moral dilemma and decides to use an ethical decision-making framework . After looking at the facts at hand and identifying the situational influences , he still cannot make a decision on the best course of action. His least appropriate next step is to:
scenario_cn: ⼀位研究分析师⾯临道德困境，决定使⽤道德决策 框架。在审视现有事实并识别情境影响后，他仍⽆ 法决定最佳⾏动⽅案。他最不恰当的下⼀步是：

options.A: decide, act, monitor , and reflect. 直接决定、⾏动、监督并反思。
options.B: ask someone else to give guidance. 请他⼈提供指引。
options.C: determine what additional information is needed. 确定还需要哪些额外信息。

explanation: A 正确（题⽬问 " 最不恰当 " ）。在信息不⾜时贸然决定并⾏动是最不恰当的做法，可能造成伤害、使情况 恶化。道德决策框架是迭代的，使⽤者可以在各阶段之间往返⽽不必按某⼀顺序进⾏；若尚未准备好作决 定，最恰当的做法是请他⼈提供指引（ B ）并确定还需要哪些额外信息以澄清情况（ C ）。（当时未作答）
method: least appropriate 题：信息不⾜时最不该贸然⾏动；迭代框架允许回到收集信息与求助阶段。
header: 道德决策框架 · 迭代与求助 当时未作答

scenario_en: The belief that one’ s ethical standards are above average is most likely a reflection of which of the following behavioral biases?
scenario_cn: 认为⾃⼰的道德标准⾼于平均⽔平，最可能反映了 下列哪种⾏为偏差？

options.A: Overconfidence 过度⾃信
options.B: Short-term focus 短期聚焦
options.C: Situational influence 情境影响

explanation: A 正确。相信⾃⼰的道德标准⾼于平均是过度⾃信偏差的体现。过度⾃信会使⼈⾼估⾃⾝⾏为的道德⽔ 平，从⽽忽视作出最佳道德决策所需的重要信息与变量。 B 错：短期聚焦属于情境影响的⼀个⽅⾯。 C 错： 情境影响是塑造思维与⾏为的外部因素，本⾝不是⾏为偏差。（当时未作答）
method: "我⽐⼀般⼈更道德 " 是典型的过度⾃信表述；情境影响是外部因素⽽⾮偏差。
header: ⾏为偏差 · 过度⾃信 当时未作答

scenario_en: From the point of view of an investor , unethical behavior by investment professionals can most likely lead to which of the following?
scenario_cn: 从投资者⻆度看，投资专业⼈⼠的不道德⾏为最可 能导致下列哪种结果？

options.A: Demand for a higher return 要求更⾼的回报
options.B: Rise in the demand for investments 投资需求上升
options.C: Increased willingness to accept risk 承担⻛险的意愿增强

explanation: A 正确。不道德⾏为侵蚀并摧毁信任。信任度低的投资者更不愿承担⻛险，因此会为其资本的使⽤要求 更⾼回报；他们也可能转投他处或⼲脆不投资。 B 错：信任丧失会减少⽽⾮增加投资需求。 C 错：信任丧失 降低⽽⾮提⾼⻛险承担意愿。（当时未作答）
method: 信任下降 → ⻛险承受意愿下降 → 要求更⾼⻛险补偿（回报） ，需求减少。
header: 信任的经济后果 · 对投资者的影响 当时未作答

scenario_en: A regulator who requires financial advisers to merely consider the suitability of a product when making recommendations to their clients would most likely be setting:
scenario_cn: 监管者仅要求理财顾问在向客⼾提出建议时考虑产 品的适合性（ suitability ），这最可能是在设定：

options.A: a legal standard. 法律标准。
options.B: an ethical standard. 道德标准。
options.C: both a legal and an ethical standard. 既是法律标准⼜是道德标准。

explanation: A 正确。监管者仅要求顾问考虑适合性时设定的只是法律标准。 B 、 C 错：要求顾问以受托⼈ （fiduciary ）⾝份⾏事 —— 即把客⼾利益置于公司或员⼯利益之上 —— 才同时构成法律标准和道德标准；仅考 虑适合性不构成道德标准。（当时未作答）
method: suitability （适合性） = 法律底线； fiduciary （受托责任） = 法律 + 道德双重标准。
header: 道德标准 vs 法律标准 · 适合性要求 当时未作答

scenario_en: Which of the following best outlines the minimally acceptable behaviors expected of a member belonging to a societal group?
scenario_cn: 下列哪项最贴切地勾勒了对社会群体成员所期望的 最低可接受⾏为？

options.A: Code of ethics 道德准则
options.B: Standards of conduct ⾏为标准
options.C: A firm’ s employee handbook 公司的员⼯⼿册

explanation: B 正确。⾏为标准勾勒了社会群体成员的最低可接受⾏为；道德准则只是成员应如何⾏事的⼀般性指 引。 A 错：道德准则是⼀般指引，不规定最低可接受⾏为。 C 错：员⼯⼿册规定的是公司员⼯的⾏为期望， ⽽⾮社会群体成员的最低可接受⾏为。与
header: 基本概念 · ⾏为标准定义（复现） 当时未作答

scenario_en: How does ethical conduct most likely compare with what is legally required?
scenario_cn: 合乎道德的⾏为与法律要求相⽐，最可能是怎样的 关系？

options.A: Ethical conduct goes beyond what is legally required 合乎道德的⾏为超出法律要求的范围
options.B: There are no dif ferences between the two; they are the same ⼆者没有差异，完全相同
options.C: Doing what is legally required removes the need for ethical conduct做到法律要求即⽆需再讲求道德

explanation: A 正确。合乎道德的⾏为超出法律要求，涵盖⼤多数社会、社群和职业组织所认定的道德上正确的⾏ 为；良好的道德判断要求兼顾众多利益相关者的利益并将其⻛险最⼩化。 B 错：⼆者虽有重叠，但很多情形 下并不⼀致。 C 错：守法并不能取代道德要求，投资⾏业中存在合法但不道德的⾏为。（当时未作答）
method: 道德标准⾼于法律底线：选 goes beyond ；合法 ≠ 道德是核⼼考点。

scenario_en: The goals of the CF A Institute Code of Ethics would least likely include:
scenario_cn: CFA 协会道德准则的⽬标最不可能包括：

options.A: fostering public confidence. 培养公众信⼼。
options.B: addressing past ethical failings. 处理过去的道德失当⾏为。
options.C: publicly communicating established principles. 向公众传达既定原则。

explanation: B 正确（题⽬问 least likely ）。处理过去的道德失当并⾮ CFA 协会道德准则的⽬标；培养公众信⼼（ A ） 和向公众传达既定原则（ C ）都是道德准则的⽬标。道德准则⾯向未来、树⽴⾏为期望，⽽⾮追究既往个案。 （当时未作答）
method: least likely 题：准则是前瞻性指引，不处理 past failings 。

scenario_en: The most important factor in promoting ethical decision making among an investment firm’ s employees is:
scenario_cn: 促进投资公司员⼯道德决策的最重要因素是：

options.A: a strong culture of integrity by the firm’ s senior management. 公司⾼级管理层营造并⽰范强⼤的诚信⽂化。
options.B: the investment professional’ s natural desire to do the right thing.投资专业⼈⼠天⽣想做正确之事的愿望。
options.C: adoption of a code of ethics that clearly defines the firm’ s ethical principles.采纳⼀部清晰界定公司道德原则的道德准则。

explanation: A 正确。促进投资公司内部道德⾏为最重要的单⼀因素，是⾼级管理层建⽴、维护并⽰范强⼤的诚信⽂ 化（ tone at the top ）。 B 错：个⼈天⽣向善的愿望可以被公司诚信⽂化强化，但不是最重要的单⼀因素。 C 错：仅有清晰阐述道德原则的准则⽂本是不够的，必须由管理层践⾏。（当时未作答）
method: "most important factor" 题⼀律指向⾼管层的诚信⽂化（ tone at the top ）；准则⽂本 alone is insuf ficient 。
header: 道德⽂化 · 最关键因素 当时未作答

scenario_en: What is most likely a critical aspect of the Consider phase of an ethical decision-making framework ?
scenario_cn: 道德决策框架中 Consider （考虑）阶段最关键的内容 最可能是：

options.A: Contemplating your decision 思索你的决定
options.B: Seeking additional guidance 寻求额外指引
options.C: Distinguishing duties to stakeholders 区分对各利益相关者的职责

explanation: B 正确。在 Consider 阶段寻求额外指引是从不同视⻆审视情况的关键步骤，最好向不受相同情境影响或 ⾏为偏差影响的⼈求助，以获得新鲜视⻆；也可从公司政策程序及 CFA 协会准则中获得指引。 A 错：思索决 定属于 Reflect 阶段。 C 错：区分对利益相关者的职责属于 Identify 阶段。（当时未作答）
method: 记忆各阶段动作： Identify= 辨职责， Consider= 求指引， Reflect= 反思决策。
header: 道德决策框架 · Consider 阶段 当时未作答

scenario_en: If you are seeking guidance from the firm’ s code of ethics or written policies, your actions most likely reflect which phase of an ethical decision-making framework ?
scenario_cn: 如果你正在查阅公司的道德准则或书⾯政策寻求指 引，你的⾏为最可能属于道德决策框架的哪个阶 段？

options.A: Decide 决定
options.B: Reflect 反思
options.C: Consider 考虑

explanation: C 正确。查阅公司道德准则或书⾯政策寻求指引属于 Consider 阶段；该阶段还包括考虑情境影响与可能 影响思维的个⼈偏差，并可向合规部⻔或外部法律顾问等可信来源求助。 A 错： Decide 阶段是作出决定，不 涉及查阅指引。 B 错： Reflect 阶段是对已作出的决定及其结果进⾏反思评估。（当时未作答）
method: 与 Q22 同源：凡 " 寻求指引 / 查准则政策 " 均归 Consider 阶段。
header: 道德决策框架 · Consider 阶段（复现） 当时未作答

scenario_en: Can an individual most likely cause the public to lose confidence in the global financial markets?
scenario_cn: 单⼀个⼈是否最可能使公众对全球⾦融市场失去信 ⼼？

options.A: Yes 是
options.B: No, a single person does not have enough influence 否，单个⼈没有⾜够影响⼒
options.C: No, a negative event would need to be considered systemic 否，负⾯事件须具有系统性才会如此

explanation: A 正确。任何有关⾦融业从业⼈员的负⾯报道都可能导致公众丧失市场信⼼和对投资⾏业的信任，因此 ⾦融服务业从业者必须以合乎道德的⽅式⾏事。伯纳德 · ⻨道夫（ Bernie Madoff ）就是单⼀个⼈导致公众对投 资专业⼈⼠失去信任的例证。 B 、 C 错：个⼈完全可能造成市场信⼼丧失，⽆需系统性事件。（当时未作答）
method: 个⼈丑闻（如⻨道夫案）⾜以摧毁公众信任 → Y es 。
header: ⾏业信任 · 个⼈⾏为的影响 当时未作答

scenario_en: Which of the following is most likely an example of an overconfidence bias leading to poor ethical decision making?
scenario_cn: 下列哪项最可能是过度⾃信偏差导致糟糕道德决策 的例⼦？

options.A: “I’m sure I did the right thing.” "我确定我当时做得对。 "
options.B: “I’m aware of my ethical obligations.” "我清楚⾃⼰的道德义务。 "
options.C: “I’m smart; that will keep me out of trouble.” "我很聪明，这能让我免于⿇烦。 "

explanation: C 正确。认为⾃⼰的聪明才智能防⽌⾃⼰做出不道德⾏为，正是过度⾃信偏差的表现；⽆论智⼒⾼低， 理解道德⾏为的⼈都可以通过审视不当⾏为的⻓期后果来辨别不道德⾏为。 A 错：过度⾃信使⼈意识不到⾃ ⼰未来可能作出糟糕的道德决策，⽽⾮事后回看（事后笃定属于事后偏差范畴）。 B 错：清楚⾃⼰的道德义务 并不必然产⽣ " 我定会做对 " 的过度⾃信；熟知义务的⼈也可能故意不道德⾏事。（当时未作答）
method: 过度⾃信 = ⾼估⾃⼰免于犯错的能⼒（⾯向未来） ；事后笃定不算过度⾃信。
header: ⾏为偏差 · 过度⾃信的表现 当时未作答

scenario_en: Which of the following statements best describes an aspect of the Professional Conduct Program process?
scenario_cn: 下列哪项陈述最恰当地描述了职业⾏为计划（ PCP ） 流程的⼀个⽅⾯？

options.A: Inquiries are not initiated in response to information provided by the media.不会因媒体提供的信息⽽发起调查。
options.B: Investigations result in Disciplinary Review Committee panels for each case.每起案件的调查都会交由纪律审查委员会 （DRC）⼩组处理。
options.C: Investigations may include requesting a written explanation from the member or candidate.调查可以包括要求会员或考⽣提供书⾯解释。

explanation: C 正确：调查⼀经发起，职业⾏为 staff 开展的调查可以包括要求会员或考⽣提供书⾯解释。 A 错： PCP 调查可以因媒体报道、监管通告或其他公开来源的信息⽽发起。 B 错：只有当会员或考⽣不接受指控和拟议 制裁时，案件才会移交由 DRC 成员组成的⼩组，并⾮每案都移交。（当时未作答）
method: PCP 流程：信息来源（含媒体） → staf f 调查（可要求书⾯解释） → 接受制裁则结案，不接受才移交 DRC ⼩组。
header: 职业⾏为计划 PCP · 流程辨析 当时未作答

scenario_en: A current Code of Ethics principle reads in full, “Promote the integrity:
scenario_cn: 现⾏道德准则中有⼀条原则的完整表述为 “Promote the integrity （促进 …… 的完整性）：

options.A: and viability of the global capital markets.” 及全球资本市场的活⼒。 ”
options.B: of and uphold the rules governing capital markets.” 并维护资本市场的监管规则。 ”
options.C: and viability of the global capital markets for the ultimate benefit of society .”及全球资本市场的活⼒，最终造福社会。 ”

explanation: C 正确：该原则完整表述为 “ 促进全球资本市场的诚信与活⼒，最终造福整个社会 ” ，体现资本市场在社 会整体中的作⽤。 A 不完整，缺少 " 最终造福社会 " 部分； B 表述与准则原⽂不符。（当时未作答）
method: 记道德准则原⽂关键词： integrity and viability of global capital markets for the ultimate benefit of society 。
header: 道德准则 · 原则原⽂ 当时未作答

scenario_en: Which of the following is correct with regard to the Standards of Professional Conduct ?
scenario_cn: 关于职业⾏为标准（ Standards of Professional Conduct），下列哪项是正确的？

options.A: They require supervisors to focus only on the detection and prevention of violations.要求监督者只关注违规⾏为的发现与防范。
options.B: They set ethical conduct requirements for members and candidates that have remained unchanged since their creation.为会员和考⽣设定的道德⾏为要求⾃创⽴以来从 未改变。
options.C: They address the risks and limitations of recommendations being made to clients.涉及向客⼾提出的建议的⻛险与局限性。

explanation: C 正确：鉴于⾦融⼯具与策略不断创新，与客⼾沟通准则（ V(B) ）隐含要求向客⼾披露建议的⻛险与局 限。 A 错：监督者准则（ IV(C) ）的合规期望超出单纯的发现与防范。 B 错：准则随⾏业发展不断演进，以保 持最⾼职业⾏为标准的相关性。（当时未作答）
method: 排除绝对化表述（ only / unchanged ） ——CF A 准则题中绝对化选项通常错误。
header: 职业⾏为标准 · 总体特征 当时未作答
required_actions: 区分事实与观点；披露分析方法与风险

scenario_en: Which of the following statements best describes an aspect of the Standards of Professional Conduct ? Members and candidates are required to:
scenario_cn: 下列哪项最恰当地描述了职业⾏为标准的⼀个⽅ ⾯？会员和考⽣必须：

options.A: ensure a portfolio mandate is suitable for all investors. 确保投资组合授权对所有投资者都是适当的。
options.B: promptly disclose changes that might materially af fect investment processes.及时披露可能对投资流程产⽣重⼤影响的变更。
options.C: have a reasonable and adequate basis for decisions about client confidentiality .对客⼾保密事项的决定有合理充分的依据。

explanation: B 正确：职业⾏为标准要求会员和考⽣及时披露任何可能对投资流程产⽣重⼤影响的变更。 A 错：按 III(C) 适当性，管理特定授权组合时只需采取与组合既定⽬标⼀致的⾏动，⽆需关⼼授权是否适合所有投资 者。 C 错： III(E) 保密要求直接规定保密义务及例外（违法、法律要求、客⼾许可），不需要 " 决定 " ；合理充分 依据属于 V(A) 勤勉与合理依据。（当时未作答）
method: 区分准则责任主体：适当性 III(C) 看组合⽬标⽽⾮全体投资者；保密 III(E) ⽆⾃由裁量；合理依据归 V(A)。
header: 职业⾏为标准 · 要求归属 当时未作答

scenario_en: A CFA Institute member or candidate violates Standard II(A) Material Nonpublic Information by:
scenario_cn: CFA 协会会员或考⽣通过下列哪种⾏为违反准则 II(A) 重⼤⾮公开信息？

options.A: conducting price distortion practices. 实施价格扭曲⾏为。
options.B: inappropriately causing others to act. 不当地促使他⼈据此⾏事。
options.C: inadequately maintaining investment records. 未妥善保存投资记录。

explanation: B 正确： II(A) 规定持有⾜以影响投资价值的重⼤⾮公开信息的会员不得促使他⼈依据该信息⾏事。 A 错：价格扭曲属 II(B) 市场操纵。 C 错：保存⽀持投资分析的记录属 V(C) 记录保存。（当时未作答）
method: 关键词定位：价格扭曲 →II(B) ；促使他⼈⾏动 →II(A) ；记录保存 →V(C) 。
header: 准则 II(A) · 重⼤⾮公开信息 当时未作答
required_actions: 不得利用或促使他人利用重大非公开信息

scenario_en: Standard III(C) Suitability requires members and candidates in an advisory relationship with a client to:
scenario_cn: 准则 III(C) 适当性要求与客⼾存在咨询关系的会员和 考⽣：

options.A: place their client’ s interests before their own interests. 将客⼾利益置于⾃⾝利益之上。
options.B: consider investments in the context of the client’ s total portfolio.在客⼾整体投资组合的语境下考量投资。
options.C: not knowingly make misrepresentations relating to recommendations.不得故意就建议作出虚假陈述。

explanation: B 正确： III(C) 规定处于咨询关系中的会员和考⽣必须在客⼾整体组合的语境下判断投资的适当性。 A 错：客⼾利益优先是 III(A) 忠诚、审慎与谨慎的要求。 C 错：不得故意虚假陈述是 I(C) 虚假陈述的要求。（当 时未作答）
method: 逐条对应：利益优先 →III(A) ；总组合语境 →III(C) ；虚假陈述 →I(C) 。
header: 准则 III(C) · 适当性 当时未作答
required_actions: 投资行动前了解客户需求、目标与风险承受能力

scenario_en: Standard III: Duties to Clients states that members and candidates must:
scenario_cn: 准则 III：对客⼾的责任规定会员和考⽣必须：

options.A: document client financial constraints after an initial investment action.在⾸次投资⾏动之后记录客⼾的财务约束。
options.B: maintain an equal balance of interests owed to their clients and employers.在客⼾与雇主利益之间维持同等平衡。
options.C: deal fairly and objectively with all clients when engaging in professional activities.在从事职业活动时公平、客观地对待所有客⼾。

explanation: C 正确： III(B) 公平交易要求在提供投资分析、建议、⾏动及其他职业活动时公平客观地对待所有客 ⼾。 A 错： III(C) 要求在采取投资⾏动之前（⽽⾮之后）合理了解客⼾财务约束并定期更新。 B 错： III(A) 要 求将客⼾利益置于雇主或⾃⾝利益之上，⽽⾮等权平衡。（当时未作答）
method: 注意时序（ prior to ）与优先级（ before ）两类陷阱词。
header: 准则 III · 对客⼾的责任 当时未作答
required_actions: 公平客观对待所有客户

scenario_en: Standard IV : Duties to Employers states that members and candidates must not:
scenario_cn: 准则 IV：对雇主的责任规定会员和考⽣不得：

options.A: accept any gifts that might compromise their independence and objectivity .接受任何可能损害其独⽴性与客观性的礼物。
options.B: deprive their employer of their skills and abilities as related to their employment.在与雇佣相关的事务中剥夺雇主利⽤其技能与能 ⼒的优势。
options.C: accept compensation competing with their employer ’s interest without the written consent of their employer only .仅未经雇主书⾯同意即接受与雇主利益相竞争的 报酬。

explanation: B 正确： IV(A) 忠诚规定会员和考⽣不得在与雇佣相关的事务中剥夺雇主获得其技能与能⼒优势的权 利。 A 错：损害独⽴客观性的礼物属准则 I 职业操守（ I(B) ）。 C 错： IV(B) 额外报酬安排允许在获得所有相关 ⽅（不仅是雇主）书⾯同意后接受竞争性报酬。（当时未作答）
method: 注意 C 的 "only" 陷阱：额外报酬需所有相关⽅书⾯同意。
header: 准则 IV · 对雇主的责任 当时未作答
required_actions: 不得剥夺雇主技能优势；避免利益冲突

scenario_en: Standard V: Investment Analysis , Recommendations, and Actions states that members and candidates must:
scenario_cn: 准则 V：投资分析、建议与⾏动规定会员和考⽣必 须：

options.A: find an investment suitable for their client before making a recommendation.在提出建议前为客⼾找到适当的投资。
options.B: make reasonable ef forts to ensure that performance presentation is fair , accurate, and complete.作出合理努⼒确保业绩陈述公平、准确、完整。
options.C: distinguish between fact and opinion in the presentation of investment analysis and recommendations.在投资分析与建议的陈述中区分事实与观点。

explanation: C 正确： V(B) 与客⼾及潜在客⼾沟通要求在陈述投资分析与建议时区分事实与观点。 A 、 B 均错：适当 性要求与业绩陈述要求属于准则 III 对客⼾的责任，不属于准则 V 。（当时未作答）
method: 准则 V 记忆点：合理依据 V(A) 、沟通（事实 / 观点 + 流程披露） V(B) 、记录保存 V(C) 。
header: 准则 V · 投资分析、建议与⾏动 当时未作答
required_actions: 区分事实与观点；披露分析方法与风险

scenario_en: Standard VII: Responsibilities as a CF A Institute Member or CFA Candidate explicitly states a requirement regarding:
scenario_cn: 准则 VII：作为 CFA 协会会员或 CFA 考⽣的责任， 明确规定了关于下列哪项的要求？

options.A: loyalty . 忠诚。
options.B: responsibility of supervisors. 监督者的责任。
options.C: reference to the CF A Program. 对 CFA 项⽬的引⽤表述。

explanation: C 正确： VII(B) 对 CFA 协会、 CFA 头衔及 CFA 项⽬的引⽤，明确规定了引⽤ CFA 协会会员资格、 CFA 头衔或考⽣⾝份的适当⽅式。 A 错：忠诚⻅于 III(A) 与准则 IV 。 B 错：监督者责任⻅于 IV(C) 。（当时未作答）
method: 准则 VII 只含两块： VII(A) 考试⾏为 / 保密， VII(B) 头衔引⽤。
header: 准则 VII · 会员 / 考⽣责任 当时未作答
required_actions: 按规范引用CFA协会会员资格与头衔

scenario_en: Which of the following activities if undertaken by CF A Institute members and/or candidates would most likely violate the Code and Standards?
scenario_cn: CFA 协会会员和 / 或考⽣的下列哪项⾏为最可能违反 道德准则与职业⾏为标准？

options.A: An analyst discloses confidential, sensitive information about a client account as part of an investigation by the CF A Institute Professional Conduct Program.⼀名分析师在 CFA 协会职业⾏为计划（ PCP ） 调查中披露客⼾账⼾的机密敏感信息。
options.B: A senior trader does not have safeguards in place to determine whether a junior trader under their supervision is following the firm’ s policies regarding best execution .⼀名⾼级交易员未设置保障措施，以确定其监管 下的初级交易员是否遵守公司关于最佳执⾏的政 策。
options.C: An institutional portfolio manager takes a group of clients to an expensive restaurant to discuss portfolio returns over the recently completed quarter without prior written consent from his employer .⼀名机构组合经理未经雇主事先书⾯同意，带⼀ 组客⼾到⾼档餐厅讨论最近⼀个季度的组合收 益。

explanation: B 正确： IV(C) 监督者责任要求会员和考⽣作出合理努⼒，防范受其监管者违反法律法规及准则；不设 保障措施即违反。 A 错： III(E) 保密不阻⽌配合 PCP 调查， PCP 可视为会员⾃⾝的延伸。 C 错：请客⼾吃饭讨 论业绩不与雇主构成利益冲突，除⾮违反公司政策，不构成明确违规。（当时错选此项 C ）错误路径：把 " 未 经雇主书⾯同意 " 机械套⽤ IV(B) 额外报酬，但聚餐讨论已完成季度业绩并⾮与雇主利益竞争的报酬安排。
method: most likely violate 题：先找有明确准则条款⽀撑的⾏为（此处 IV(C) 监督保障缺失） 。
header: 准则综合应⽤ · 违规识别 当时做错 · 错选 C
required_actions: 建立合规程序；监督下属行为

scenario_en: Which of the following least likely reflects the two primary principles of the CF A Institute Rules of Procedure for Proceedings Related to Professional Conduct?
scenario_cn: 下列哪项最不可能是 CFA 协会职业⾏为相关程序规 则（ Rules of Procedure ）的两⼤基本原则之⼀？

options.A: Confidentiality of proceedings. 程序的保密性。
options.B: Public disclosure of disciplinary sanctions. 公开披露纪律制裁。
options.C: Fair process to the member and candidate. 对会员和考⽣的公平程序。

explanation: B 正确：程序规则的两⼤原则是程序的保密性和对会员 / 考⽣的公平程序， " 公开披露制裁 " 与之相悖。 A、C 均为两⼤原则本⾝，故不选。（当时未作答）
method: least likely 题：记住两⼤原则 =confidentiality + fair process ，选之外项。
header: 职业⾏为程序规则 · 两⼤原则 当时未作答

scenario_en: Which of the following is not a component of the CF A Institute Code of Ethics ?
scenario_cn: 下列哪项不是 CFA 协会道德准则的组成部分？

options.A: Promote financial integrity and seek to prevent and punish abuses in the financial markets.促进⾦融诚信并寻求防⽌和惩罚⾦融市场的滥⽤ ⾏为。
options.B: Place the integrity of the investment profession and the interests of clients above their own personal interests.将投资⾏业的诚信和客⼾利益置于个⼈利益之 上。
options.C: Practice and encourage others to practice in a professional and ethical manner that will reflect credit on themselves and the profession.以专业且合乎道德的⽅式执业并⿎励他⼈如此， 为⾃⼰和⾏业增光。

explanation: A 正确（即答案）：道德准则六⼤组成中不包含 " 惩罚市场滥⽤ " ， punish 不是准则内容。 B 、 C 均为六⼤ 组成部分原⽂。（当时未作答）
method: not 题：背诵六条组成，含 punish abuses 的表述直接锁定。
header: 道德准则 · 六⼤组成 当时未作答

scenario_en: Which of the following groups is most likely responsible for maintaining oversight and responsibility for the Professional Conduct Program (PCP)?
scenario_cn: 下列哪个机构最可能对职业⾏为计划（ PCP ）承担监 督与负责职责？

options.A: Professional Conduct Division. 职业⾏为部。
options.B: Disciplinary Review Committee. 纪律审查委员会（ DRC ）。
options.C: CFA Institute Board of Governors. CFA 协会理事会。

explanation: C 正确： CFA 协会理事会（ Board of Governors ）对 PCP 保持监督与最终责任。 A 错：职业⾏为部与 DRC 合作制定和审查职业⾏为政策，并负责其他教育项⽬的考试政策执⾏。 B 错： DRC 与 PCP 协同⼯作，负责准 则的执⾏，但不承担监督责任。（当时未作答）
method: 分层记忆：理事会 = 监督负责； DRC= 执⾏； Professional Conduct staf f= 调查。
header: PCP · 监督主体 当时未作答

scenario_en: When can a party , nonmember or firm, most likely claim compliance with the CF A Institute Code of Ethics and Standards of Professional Conduct ? Once they have:
scenario_cn: ⾮会员或公司⼀⽅何时最可能声称遵循 CFA 协会道 德准则与职业⾏为标准？当他们已经：

options.A: notified the CF A Institute of their claim. 将其遵循声明通知 CFA 协会。
options.B: verified their claim of compliance with the CF A Institute. 经 CFA 协会核实其遵循声明。
options.C: ensured that their code and ethics meets the principles of the Code and Standards.确保其⾃⾝的道德规范符合道德准则与职业⾏为 标准的各项原则。

explanation: C 正确：准则适⽤于个⼈会员与考⽣；协会⿎励公司采纳为准则的⼀部分，声称遵循者应充分理解并确 保⾃⾝规范满⾜准则各项原则。 A 错：通知协会只是受⿎励的做法，⾮声称遵循的前提。 B 错： CFA 协会不 会核实任何遵循声明。（当时未作答）
method: 声称遵循 = ⾃我确保合规；协会不认证、不核实。
header: 准则遵循声明 · ⾮会员 / 公司 当时未作答

scenario_en: Sanctions imposed by CF A Institute for violations of the CF A Institute Code of Ethics or Standards of Professional Conduct least likely include:
scenario_cn: CFA 协会对违反道德准则或职业⾏为标准的⾏为实 施的制裁，最不可能包括：

options.A: public censure. 公开谴责。
options.B: monetary fines. 罚款。
options.C: revocation of a CF A Charter . 吊销 CFA 特许资格。

explanation: B 正确（即答案）： CFA 协会的制裁不包括罚款；制裁包括公开谴责、暂停会员资格及 CFA 头衔使⽤ 权、吊销 CFA 特许资格，考⽣可被暂停或禁⽌继续参加 CFA 项⽬。 A 、 C 均为实际制裁种类。（当时未作答）
method: least likely 题： CFA 制裁⽆ monetary fines—— ⾼频考点。
header: PCP 制裁 · 种类辨析 当时未作答

scenario_en: Which of the following statements related to requirements for the CF A Institute Standards of Professional Conduct Standard V(B)- Communication with Clients and Prospective Clients is least likely accurate? The standard requires members and candidates to:
scenario_cn: 关于准则 V(B) 与客⼾及潜在客⼾沟通的要求，下列 哪项最不可能准确？该准则要求会员和考⽣：

options.A: disclose the basic format and general principles of the investment process.披露投资流程的基本形式和⼀般原则。
options.B: divulge the number of investment related personnel responsible for external communication.透露负责对外沟通的投资相关⼈员数量。
options.C: distinguish between fact and opinion in the presentation of investment analysis and recommendations.在投资分析与建议的陈述中区分事实与观点。

explanation: B 正确（即答案）： V(B) 不限制负责对外沟通的员⼯类型或数量，因此 " 透露⼈员数量 " 不是准则要求。 A、C 均为 V(B) 的明确要求。（当时未作答）
method: V(B) 三要求：披露流程基本格式与原则、区分事实与观点、披露建议的⻛险与局限。
header: 准则 V(B) · 与客⼾沟通 当时未作答
required_actions: 区分事实与观点；披露分析方法与风险

scenario_en: Which of the following is most likely found in the CF A Institute Standards of Professional Conduct , Standard I- Professionalism ? Members and candidates must:
scenario_cn: 下列哪项最可能出⾃ CFA 协会职业⾏为标准之准则 I 职业操守？会员和考⽣必须：

options.A: place the integrity of the investment profession and the interest of clients above their own interest.将投资⾏业的诚信和客⼾利益置于⾃⾝利益之 上。
options.B: maintain and improve their professional competence and strive to maintain and improve the competence of other investment professionals.保持并提升⾃⾝专业能⼒，并努⼒保持和提升其 他投资专业⼈⼠的能⼒。
options.C: not engage in any professional conduct involving dishonesty , fraud, or deceit or commit any act that reflects adversely on their professional reputation, integrity , or competence.不得从事任何涉及不诚实、欺诈或欺骗的职业⾏ 为，或实施任何损害其职业声誉、诚信或能⼒的 ⾏为。

explanation: C 正确：该表述出⾃准则 I(D) 不当⾏为（ Misconduct ）。 A 、 B 错：两句均为道德准则（ Code of Ethics ） 的组成部分，⽽⾮职业⾏为标准准则 I 的内容。（当时答对）
method: 区分 Code of Ethics （原则性宣⾔）与 Standards （具体⾏为条款） ： I(D) Misconduct 原⽂识别。
header: 准则 I · 职业操守 vs 道德准则 当时做对
required_actions: 不得从事欺诈、欺骗等有损职业声誉的行为

scenario_en: Nicholas Bennett, CF A, is a trader at a stock exchange. Another trader approached Bennett on the floor of the exchange and verbally harassed him about a poorly executed trade. In response, Bennett pushed the trader and knocked him to the ground. After investigating the incident, the exchange cleared Bennett from any wrongdoing. Which of the following best describes Bennett’ s conduct in relation to the CF A Institute Code of Ethics or Standards of Professional Conduct ? Bennett:
scenario_cn: Nicholas Bennett （ CFA ）是⼀家证券交易所的交易 员。另⼀名交易员在交易⼤厅⾛近他，就⼀笔执⾏ 糟糕的交易对其进⾏⾔语骚扰。作为回应， Bennett 推了该交易员并将其推倒在地。交易所调查后认定 Bennett ⽆任何过错。下列哪项最恰当地描述了 Bennett 的⾏为与 CFA 协会道德准则或职业⾏为标准 的关系？ Bennett ：

options.A: did not violate any Code or Standard. 未违反任何准则或标准。
options.B: violated the Professional Misconduct Standard. 违反了职业不当⾏为标准（ I(D) ）。
options.C: violated both Misconduct and Integrity of Capital Markets Standards.同时违反了不当⾏为标准与资本市场诚信标准 （准则 II ）。

explanation: B 正确：道德准则要求会员以诚信、胜任、勤勉、尊重且专业的⽅式⾏事； I(D) 规定不得实施任何损害 职业声誉、诚信或能⼒的⾏为。肢体冲突违反道德准则与职业操守标准。 A 错：交易所免除责任不影响 CFA 准则的独⽴评判。 C 错：该⾏为与资本市场诚信（准则 II ）⽆关。（当时未作答）
method: 个⼈肢体冲突 / 不端⾏为 →I(D) Misconduct ；与市场操纵、内幕信息⽆关则不选准则 II 。
header: 准则 I(D) · 不当⾏为案例 当时未作答
required_actions: 不得从事欺诈、欺骗等有损职业声誉的行为

scenario_en: Tibor Figeczky , CFA, is an equity trader at Global Investment Bank (GB). Figeczky traded the bank’ s investment portfolio profitably for the past three years and earned significant bonuses for his ef forts. Subsequently , internal auditors of GB formally accused Figeczky of exceeding his trading authority and engaging in unauthorized trades. According to the CF A Institute Code of Ethics and Standards of Professional Conduct , Figeczky should most likely :
scenario_cn: Tibor Figeczky （ CFA ）是环球投资银⾏（ GB ）的股 票交易员。过去三年他为银⾏的投资组合盈利交易 并获得丰厚奖⾦。随后， GB 内部审计师正式指控其 超越交易权限并从事未经授权的交易。根据 CFA 协 会道德准则与职业⾏为标准， Figeczky 最应当：

options.A: disclose the complaint to CF A Institute. 向 CFA 协会披露该投诉。
options.B: refuse further bonuses until the issue is resolved. 在问题解决前拒绝进⼀步奖⾦。
options.C: request a temporary suspension of his CF A Institute membership.申请临时暂停其 CFA 协会会员资格。

explanation: A 正确：会员和考⽣必须在年度职业⾏为声明（ Professional Conduct Statement ）中主动披露所有质疑其 职业⾏为的事项，包括⺠事诉讼、刑事调查或成为书⾯投诉对象。 B 错：准则不禁⽌调查期间接受奖⾦，其 ⾏为是否违规尚⽆定论。 C 错：准则不要求在投诉调查期间主动暂停会员资格。（当时未作答）
method: 被书⾯投诉 / 诉讼 / 调查 → 年度职业⾏为声明⾃我披露，这是最优先动作。
header: ⾃我披露 · 年度职业⾏为声明 当时未作答

scenario_en: Which of the following statements most likely reflects one of the six components of the CF A Code of Ethics ? Candidates must:
scenario_cn: 下列哪项最可能反映 CFA 道德准则的六⼤组成部分 之⼀？考⽣必须：

options.A: place the integrity of the investment profession above their own interests.将投资⾏业的诚信置于⾃⾝利益之上。
options.B: promote the viability of the global capital markets for their employer ’s benefit.为雇主的利益促进全球资本市场的活⼒。
options.C: ignore unprofessional conduct displayed by others within the profession.⽆视⾏业内他⼈的不专业⾏为。

explanation: A 正确：持证⼈与考⽣必须将投资⾏业的诚信及客⼾利益置于个⼈利益之上。 B 错：促进全球资本市场 诚信与活⼒是为了 " 最终造福社会 " ，⽽⾮雇主利益。 C 错：准则要求以⾝作则并⿎励他⼈以专业道德⽅式⾏ 事，⽆视不端⾏为违背该要求。（当时未作答）
method: 逐字⽐对准则原⽂： benefit of society ≠ employer ’s benefit ； encourage others ≠ ignore 。
header: 道德准则 · 六⼤组成识别 当时未作答

scenario_en: Disclosure of confidential CF A exam information will most likely be detected by the Professional Conduct staf f through:
scenario_cn: 职业⾏为 staff 最可能通过下列哪种途径发现对 CFA 考试保密信息的泄露？

options.A: monitoring online and social media. 监控⽹络和社交媒体。
options.B: analysis of Proctor Reports. 分析监考报告。
options.C: annual Professional Conduct Statements. 年度职业⾏为声明。

explanation: A 正确：职业⾏为调查的信息来源众多，包括监控⽹络与社交媒体以侦测保密考试信息的泄露。 B 错： 监考报告⽤于记录考试现场及考场内疑似违反考试规则的⾏为。 C 错：年度职业⾏为声明是⾃我披露渠道， 考试信息泄露不会出现在年度声明中。（当时未作答）
method: 按信息性质匹配渠道：⽹上泄露 → ⽹络 / 社媒监控；考场违规 → 监考报告；诉讼投诉 → 年度声明。
header: PCP 调查信息来源 · 考试信息泄露 当时未作答

scenario_en: Smith, a research analyst with a brokerage firm, decides to change his recommendation for the common stock of Green Company , Inc., from a "buy" to a "sell." He mails this change in investment advice to all the firm's clients on Wednesday . The day after the mailing, a client calls with a buy order for 500 shares of Green Company . In this circumstance, Smith should:
scenario_cn: Smith 是⼀家券商的研究分析师，决定将 Green 公司 普通股的建议从 " 买⼊ " 改为 " 卖出 " 。他于周三将建议 变更邮寄给公司所有客⼾。邮寄次⽇，⼀位客⼾来 电要求买⼊ 500 股 Green 公司股票。此时 Smith 应 当：

options.A: accept the order . 接受该订单。
options.B: advise the customer of the change in recommendation before accepting the order .在接受订单前告知客⼾建议已变更。
options.C: not accept the order because it is contrary to the firm's recommendation.因该订单与公司建议相反⽽拒绝接受。

explanation: 正确答案 B 。涉及 Standard III(A) Loyalty, Prudence, and Care 与 III(B) Fair Dealing ：邮寄次⽇客⼾很可能 尚未收到建议变更通知， Smith 应先确认客⼾已收到变更后的建议；若客⼾知情后仍坚持买⼊， Smith 有义务 遵从客⼾指令。 A 错在未确认客⼾知情即执⾏； C 错在客⼾的投资指令优先于公司建议，不能仅因与建议相 反⽽拒绝。（当时未作答）
method: 客⼾指令优先，但须先确认客⼾知悉最新的建议变更。
header: S III(A)/III(B) 忠诚与公平交易 · 建议变更后接单 当时未作答
required_actions: 以客户利益为先；审慎管理客户资产
公平客观对待所有客户

scenario_en: Which statement about a manager's use of client brokerage commissions violates the Code and Standards?
scenario_cn: 关于基⾦经理使⽤客⼾经纪佣⾦的下列说法中，哪 ⼀项违反准则与标准？

options.A: A client may direct a manager to use that client's brokerage commissions to purchase goods and services for that client.客⼾可以指⽰管理⼈⽤该客⼾的经纪佣⾦为该客 ⼾购买商品和服务。
options.B: Client brokerage commissions should be used to benefit the client and should be commensurate with the value of the brokerage and research services received.客⼾经纪佣⾦应⽤于使客⼾受益，并应与所获经 纪及研究服务的价值相称。
options.C: Client brokerage commissions may be directed to pay for the investment manager's operating expenses.客⼾经纪佣⾦可被⽤于⽀付投资管理⼈的运营费 ⽤。

explanation: 正确答案 C 。涉及 Standard III(A) Loyalty, Prudence, and Care 中的软美元（ soft dollars/soft commissions ）： 客⼾经纪佣⾦是客⼾的资产，不能⽤于⽀付管理⼈⾃⾝的运营费⽤。 B 是使⽤佣⾦的正确原则（符合客⼾最 佳利益且与服务价值相称）； A 是 " 定向经纪（ directed brokerage ） " ，佣⾦⽤于客⼾⾃⾝，不违反对客⼾的忠诚 义务。任何情况下都应向客⼾披露佣⾦使⽤⽅式。（当时未作答）
method: 佣⾦是客⼾资产：只能惠及客⼾，不能贴补管理⼈⾃⾝开⽀。
header: S III(A) 忠诚谨慎 · 软美元 / 客⼾佣⾦ 当时未作答
required_actions: 以客户利益为先；审慎管理客户资产

scenario_en: Jamison is a junior research analyst with Howard & Howard, a brokerage and investment banking firm. Howard & Howard's mer gers and acquisitions department has represented the Britland Company in all of its acquisitions for the past 20 years. Two of Howard & Howard's senior of ficers are directors of various Britland subsidiaries. Jamison has been asked to write a research report on Britland. What is the best course of action for her to follow?
scenario_cn: Jamison 是经纪与投⾏公司 Howard & Howard 的初级 研究分析师。该公司并购部过去 20 年⼀直代理 Britland 公司的所有收购业务，且公司两名⾼管担任 Britland 多家⼦公司的董事。 Jamison 被要求撰写关于 Britland 的研究报告。她的最佳做法是：

options.A: Jamison may write the report but must refrain from expressing any opinions because of the special relationships between the two companies.Jamison 可以撰写报告，但因两家公司的特殊关 系不得表达任何观点。
options.B: Jamison should not write the report because the two Howard & Howard of ficers serve as directors for subsidiaries of Britland.Jamison 不应撰写该报告，因为 Howard & Howard 的两名⾼管在 Britland ⼦公司担任董 事。
options.C: Jamison may write the report if she discloses the director relationship between the two companies.Jamison 可以撰写报告，只要披露两家公司之间 的董事关系。

explanation: 正确答案 B 。涉及 Standard VI(A) Avoid or Disclose Conflicts ：本题存在双重利益冲突 —— 雇主与标的公司 有客⼾关系，且雇主两名⾼管在对⽅⼦公司任董事。最佳做法是避免冲突，即不出具该报告；若⽆法避免， 则两种关系（客⼾关系 + 董事关系）都必须披露。 C 错（当时错选此项）：只披露了董事关系⼀种冲突，遗漏 了客⼾关系； A 错：是否表达观点与披露义务⽆关，不表达观点并不能免除披露特殊关系的责任。
method: 多重冲突时 " 避免 " 优先；若披露则必须披露全部冲突，只披露⼀部分不合规。
header: S VI(A) 利益冲突 · 研报披露 当时做错 · 错选 C
required_actions: 充分披露影响独立性的利益冲突

scenario_en: Which of the following statements clearly conflicts with the recommended procedures for compliance presented in the CFA Institute Standards of Practice Handbook?
scenario_cn: 下列哪项说法与 CFA 协会《执业标准⼿册》推荐的 合规程序明显冲突？

options.A: Firms should disclose to clients the personal investing policies and procedures established for their employees.公司应向客⼾披露其为员⼯制定的个⼈投资政策 与程序。
options.B: Prior approval must be obtained for the personal investment transactions of all employees.所有员⼯的个⼈投资交易须事先获得批准。
options.C: For confidentiality reasons, personal transactions and holdings should not be reported to employers unless mandated by regulatory or ganizations.出于保密原因，除⾮监管机构强制要求，个⼈交 易和持仓不应向雇主报告。

explanation: 正确答案 C 。⼿册建议：⽆论监管机构是否要求，雇主都应定期将员⼯个⼈交易与客⼾交易⽐对，以确 保员⼯个⼈交易不与对客⼾的义务冲突，⽐对可以保密⽅式进⾏。 A 不冲突：披露员⼯个⼈投资政策可让客 ⼾充分了解潜在利益冲突； B 不冲突：⼿册⿎励公司建⽴员⼯事先申报 / 获批个⼈持仓与交易的政策。（当时未 作答）
method: 员⼯个⼈交易必须向雇主报告并接受⽐对， " 保密 " 不能成为不报告的理由。
header: S 合规程序 · 员⼯个⼈投资 当时未作答

scenario_en: Bronson provides investment advice to the board of trustees of a private university endowment fund. The trustees have provided Bronson with the fund's financial information, including planned expenditures. Bronson receives a phone call on Friday afternoon from Murdock, a prominent alumnus, requesting that Bronson fax him comprehensive financial information about the fund. According to Murdock, he has a potential contributor but needs the information that day to close the deal and cannot contact any of the trustees. Based on the CF A Institute Standards, Bronson should:
scenario_cn: Bronson 为某私⽴⼤学捐赠基⾦的董事会提供投资建 议。受托⼈向其提供了基⾦的财务信息（含⽀出计 划）。周五下午，著名校友 Murdock 来电要求 Bronson 将基⾦完整财务信息传真给他，称有⼀位潜 在捐赠⼈、当天就需要且联系不上任何受托⼈。依 据准则， Bronson 应当：

options.A: send Murdock the information because disclosure would benefit the client.发送信息给 Murdock ，因为披露有利于客⼾。
options.B: not send Murdock the information, to preserve confidentiality .不发送信息，以维护保密性。
options.C: send Murdock the information, provided Bronson promptly notifies the trustees.发送信息，只要 Bronson 及时通知受托⼈。

explanation: 正确答案 B 。涉及 Standard III(A) 与 Standard III(E) Preservation of Confidentiality ：未经基⾦（客⼾）许 可，不得向任何⼈披露其机密财务信息，即使披露可能对基⾦有利（ A 错）。 C 错：必须事先取得基⾦许 可， "先发送后通知 " 不合规。（当时未作答）
method: 客⼾机密信息必须 " 先许可、后披露 " ，善意或事后通知都不能替代许可。
header: S III(A)+III(E) 保密 · 客⼾资料外发 当时未作答
required_actions: 以客户利益为先；审慎管理客户资产
对客户及前雇主信息保密

scenario_en: Willier is the research analyst responsible for following Company X. All the information he has accumulated and documented suggests that the outlook for the company's new products is poor , so the stock should be rated a weak "hold." During lunch, however , Willier overhears a financial analyst from another firm whom he respects of fer opinions that conflict with Willier's forecasts and expectations. Upon returning to his of fice, Willier releases a strong "buy" recommendation to the public. Willier:
scenario_cn: Willier 是跟踪 X 公司的研究分析师。他积累并记录 的所有信息都表明公司新产品前景不佳，股票应评 为弱势 "持有 " 。但午餐时他⽆意中听到⼀位他敬重的 其他公司分析师发表了与其预测相反的观点。回到 办公室后， Willier 向公众发布了强烈 " 买⼊ " 建议。 Willier：

options.A: violated the Standards by failing to distinguish between facts and opinions in his recommendation.因未能在建议中区分事实与观点⽽违反标准。
options.B: violated the Standards because he did not have a reasonable and adequate basis for his recommendation.因其建议缺乏合理且充分的依据⽽违反标准。
options.C: was in full compliance with the Standards. 完全符合标准。

explanation: 正确答案 B 。涉及 Standard V(A) Diligence and Reasonable Basis ：偶听另⼀位分析师的观点并不构成改变 建议的合理充分依据， C 错。 A 错：本题并未体现 " 未区分事实与观点 " 的违规；若该观点促使 Willier 开展进 ⼀步研究并证明应改变观点，则变更建议才恰当。（当时未作答）
method: 改评级必须有⾃⼰充分的研究依据，道听途说的他⼈观点不构成合理基础。
header: S V(A) 勤勉与合理依据 · 跟⻛改评级 当时未作答
required_actions: 基于充分研究与合理依据提出建议

scenario_en: An investment management firm has been hired by ETV Corporation to work on an additional public of fering for the company . The firm's brokerage unit now has a "sell" recommendation on ETV , but the head of the investment banking department has asked the head of the brokerage unit to change the recommendation from "sell" to "buy ." According to the Standards, the head of the brokerage unit would be permitted to:
scenario_cn: 某投资管理公司受 ETV 公司委托承办其增发。该公 司经纪部⻔⽬前对 ETV 的评级为 " 卖出 " ，但投⾏部 负责⼈要求经纪部负责⼈将评级从 " 卖出 " 改为 " 买 ⼊"。依据标准，经纪部负责⼈可以：

options.A: increase the recommendation by no more than one increment (in this case, to a "hold" recommendation).将评级上调不超过⼀档（本题中即调为 " 持 有"）。
options.B: place the company on a restricted list and give only factual information about the company .将该公司列⼊限制名单，只提供关于该公司的事 实性信息。
options.C: assign a new analyst to decide whether the stock deserves a higher rating.改派⼀名新分析师来决定该股票是否应获更⾼评 级。

explanation: 正确答案 B 。涉及 Standard I(B) Independence and Objectivity ：为维护建议的独⽴客观，经纪部负责⼈必 须拒绝投⾏部⻔的压⼒；为避免利益冲突表象，公司应停⽌发布对该公司的建议，将其列⼊限制名单并只提 供事实信息。 A 错：任何违背分析师真实观点的改动都违反独⽴客观义务； C 错：仅换分析师并不能消除利 益冲突。（当时未作答）
method: ⾯对内部施压改评级：拒绝 + 列⼊限制名单，只给事实。
header: S I(B) 独⽴客观 · 投⾏压⼒改评级 当时未作答
required_actions: 拒绝可能损害独立客观性的礼品、招待或好处

scenario_en: Albert and Tye, who recently started their own investment advisory business, have registered to take the Level III CF A exam. Albert's business card reads, "Judy Albert, CF A Level II." Tye has not put anything about the CF A designation on his business card, but promotional material that he designed for the business describes the CF A requirements and indicates that Tye participates in the CF A Program and has completed Levels I and II. According to the Standards:
scenario_cn: Albert 和 Tye 刚创⽴⾃⼰的投资顾问公司，已报名 CFA 三级考试。 Albert 的名⽚写着 "Judy Albert, CFA Level II"。 Tye 的名⽚未提及 CFA 称谓，但他设计的 宣传材料描述了 CFA 要求，并注明 Tye 正在参加 CFA 项⽬且已完成⼀、⼆级。依据标准：

options.A: Albert has violated the Standards, but Tye has not. Albert 违反了标准， Tye 没有。
options.B: Tye has violated the Standards, but Albert has not. Tye 违反了标准， Albert 没有。
options.C: both Albert and Tye have violated the Standards. 两⼈都违反了标准。

explanation: 正确答案 A 。涉及 Standard VII(B) Reference to CFA Institute, the CFA Designation, and the CFA Program ：名 ⽚上 "CFA Level II" 暗⽰存在某种 "CFA ⼆级 " 的部分称号，考⽣不得暗⽰通过某级考试即获得部分称号，故 Albert 违规；考⽣可以说明⾃⼰正在参加 CFA 项⽬及已完成哪些级别，故 Tye 未违规。（当时未作答）
method: 不存在 "CFA Level X" 称号；只能说 " 已通过第 X 级、现为三级考⽣ " 。
header: S VII(B) CFA 称谓 · 名⽚与宣传材料 当时未作答
required_actions: 按规范引用CFA协会会员资格与头衔

scenario_en: Scott works for a regional brokerage firm. He estimates that Walkton Industries will increase its dividend by US ＄ 1.50 a share during the next year . He realizes that this increase is contingent on pending legislation that would, if enacted, give Walkton a substantial tax break. The US representative for Walkton's home district has told Scott that, although she is lobbying hard for the bill and prospects for its passage are favorable, concern of the US Congress over the federal deficit could cause the tax bill to be voted down. Walkton Industries has not made any statements about a change in dividend policy . Scott writes in his research report, "W e expect Walkton's stock price to rise by at least US ＄ 8.00 a share by the end of the year because the dividend will increase by US＄ 1.50 a share. Investors buying the stock at the current time should expect to realize a total return of at least 15% on the stock." According to the Standards:
scenario_cn: Scott 任职于⼀家地区券商。他估计 Walkton ⼯业明 年将每股增发股息 ＄ 1.50 ，并意识到这取决于⼀项待 决的减税法案。该选区的联邦众议员告诉他：她正 ⼤⼒游说且通过前景乐观，但国会对联邦⾚字的担 忧可能导致法案被否决。 Walkton 公司未就股息政策 发表任何声明。 Scott 在研报中写道： " 我们预计 Walkton 股价年底前⾄少上涨 ＄ 8.00 ，因为股息将提 ⾼ ＄ 1.50 。现价买⼊的投资者应预期⾄少 15% 的总 回报。 "依据标准：

options.A: Scott violated the Standards because he used material inside information.Scott 因使⽤重⼤内幕信息⽽违反标准。
options.B: Scott violated the Standards because he failed to separate opinion from fact.Scott 因未能区分观点与事实⽽违反标准。
options.C: Scott violated the Standards by basing his research on uncertain predictions of future government action.Scott 因将研究建⽴在对未来政府⾏为的不确定 预测上⽽违反标准。

explanation: 正确答案 B 。涉及 Standard V(B) Communication with Clients and Prospective Clients ： Scott 明知股息增⻓取 决于不确定的⽴法结果，却在报告中以确定⼝吻陈述 " 股息将提⾼ ＄ 1.50" ，把观点当成了事实。 A 错：⽴法前 景属推测，并⾮重⼤⾮公开信息，且未表明议员是以保密⽅式告知； C 错（当时错选此项）：建议可以部分建 ⽴在对未来事件的预期之上，即使该事件不确定，问题在于把不确定预期表述为确定事实。
method: 报告中 "将会 " 式断⾔未经证实的内容＝混淆事实与观点（ V(B) ）。
header: S V(B) 与客⼾沟通 · 事实与观点不分 当时做错 · 错选 C
required_actions: 区分事实与观点；披露分析方法与风险

scenario_en: Which one of the following actions will help ensure the fair treatment of brokerage firm clients when a new investment recommendation is made?
scenario_cn: 发布新投资建议时，下列哪项措施有助于确保券商 客⼾受到公平对待？

options.A: Informing all people in the firm in advance that a recommendation is to be disseminated提前告知公司全体⼈员即将发布建议
options.B: Distributing recommendations to institutional clients prior to individual accounts先将建议发给机构客⼾，再发给个⼈客⼾
options.C: Minimizing the time between the decision and the dissemination of a recommendation尽量缩短作出决定与发布建议之间的时间

explanation: 正确答案 C 。涉及 Standard III(B) Fair Dealing ：缩短决定与发布之间的时间可减少信息提前泄露的机会， 有助于公平对待客⼾。 A 有负⾯作⽤：提前知情的⼈越多，越可能有⼈先透露给部分客⼾，应限制提前知情 ⼈数； B 按客⼾规模 / 资产类别区别对待，直接违反 III(B) 。（当时未作答）
method: 公平交易要点：同步发布、限制先知、不区分客⼾⼤⼩。
header: S III(B) 公平交易 · 建议发布流程 当时未作答
required_actions: 公平客观对待所有客户

scenario_en: The mosaic theory holds that an analyst:
scenario_cn: ⻢赛克理论（ mosaic theory ）认为分析师：

options.A: violates the Code and Standards if the analyst fails to have knowledge of and comply with applicable laws.若不了解并遵守适⽤法律即违反准则与标准。
options.B: can use material public information and nonmaterial nonpublic information in the analyst's analysis.可以在分析中使⽤重⼤公开信息和⾮重⼤⾮公开 信息。
options.C: should use all available and relevant information in support of an investment recommendation.应使⽤所有可得且相关的信息⽀持投资建议。

explanation: 正确答案 B 。涉及 Standard II(A) Material Nonpublic Information ：⻢赛克理论指分析师可将重⼤公开信息 与⾮重⼤⾮公开信息拼合，形成⽐任何单⼀信息更完整的图景，结论只有在拼合后才具有重⼤性。 A 、 C 本⾝ 是关于准则的正确陈述，但并⾮⻢赛克理论的内容。（当时未作答）
method: ⻢赛克＝重⼤公开 + ⾮重⼤⾮公开；重⼤⾮公开信息本⾝绝不可⽤。
header: S II(A) 重⼤⾮公开信息 · ⻢赛克理论 当时未作答
required_actions: 不得利用或促使他人利用重大非公开信息

scenario_en: Jurgen is a portfolio manager . One of her firm's clients has told Jur gen that he will compensate her beyond the compensation provided by her firm on the basis of the capital appreciation of his portfolio each year . Jurgen should:
scenario_cn: Jurgen 是⼀名投资组合经理。公司的⼀位客⼾告诉 她，将在公司薪酬之外，按其组合每年的资本增值 额外付她报酬。 Jurgen 应当：

options.A: turn down the additional compensation because it will result in conflicts with the interests of other clients' accounts.拒绝额外报酬，因为会与其他客⼾账⼾的利益产 ⽣冲突。
options.B: turn down the additional compensation because it will create undue pressure on her to achieve strong short-term performance.拒绝额外报酬，因为会给她造成追求短期业绩的 不当压⼒。
options.C: obtain permission from her employer prior to accepting the compensation arrangement.在接受该报酬安排前取得雇主许可。

explanation: 正确答案 C 。涉及 Standard IV(B) Additional Compensation Arrangements ：此类按账⼾业绩⽀付额外报酬的 安排本⾝不违规，只要以书⾯形式向雇主披露并在接受前获得雇主许可。 A 、 B 错：虽然私下报酬可能与其他 客⼾利益冲突或带来短期业绩压⼒，但只要披露并获雇主许可即可接受。（当时未作答）
method: 额外报酬＝书⾯披露 + 雇主事先许可，不必⼀律拒绝。
header: S IV(B) 额外报酬安排 · 客⼾业绩酬⾦ 当时未作答
required_actions: 向雇主书面披露并取得所有相关方书面同意

scenario_en: One of the discretionary accounts managed by Farnsworth is the Jones Corporation employee profit-sharing plan. Jones, the company president, recently asked Farnsworth to vote the shares in the profit-sharing plan in favor of the slate of directors nominated by Jones Corporation and against the directors sponsored by a dissident stockholder group. Farnsworth does not want to lose this account, because he directs all the account's trades to a brokerage firm that provides Farnsworth with useful information about tax-free investments. Although this information is not of value in managing the Jones Corporation account, it does help in managing several other accounts. The brokerage firm providing this information also of fers the lowest commissions for trades and provides best execution . Farnsworth investigates the director issue, concludes that the management-nominated slate is better for the long-run performance of the company than the dissident group's slate, and votes accordingly . Farnsworth:
scenario_cn: Farnsworth 管理的全权委托账⼾之⼀是 Jones 公司员 ⼯利润分享计划。公司总裁 Jones 要求他将计划持股 投票⽀持公司提名的董事名单、反对异议股东团体 提名的董事。 Farnsworth 不想失去该账⼾，因为他把 该账⼾所有交易都导向⼀家为其提供免税投资有⽤ 信息的券商；该信息对管理 Jones 账⼾⽆⽤，但有助 于管理其他⼏个账⼾，且该券商佣⾦最低、执⾏最 佳。 Farnsworth 对董事议题做了调查，独⽴得出结 论：管理层提名名单更有利于公司⻓期业绩，并据 此投票。 Farnsworth ：

options.A: violated the Standards in voting the shares in the manner requested by Jones but not in directing trades to the brokerage firm.在按 Jones 要求投票⽅⾯违反标准，但在将交易 导向该券商⽅⾯未违反。
options.B: did not violate the Standards in voting the shares in the manner requested by Jones or in directing trades to the brokerage firm.在按 Jones 要求投票及将交易导向该券商两⽅⾯ 均未违反标准。
options.C: violated the Standards in directing trades to the brokerage firm but not in voting the shares as requested by Jones.在将交易导向该券商⽅⾯违反标准，但在按 Jones 要求投票⽅⾯未违反。

explanation: 正确答案 B 。涉及 Standard III(A)—— 代理投票与客⼾佣⾦的使⽤： Farnsworth 独⽴调查后得出结论再投 票，虽与总裁意愿⼀致，仍履⾏了对客⼾（利润分享计划的参与⼈和受益⼈，⽽⾮公司管理层）的忠诚与审 慎义务；若未调查或明知不利于受益⼈仍顺从总裁，则违规。佣⾦⽅⾯，该券商佣⾦最低且执⾏最佳，符合 客⼾利益；其附带的研究信息对本账⼾⽆⽤并不违规，因为并未让客⼾多付佣⾦。 C 错（当时错选此项）： 把"信息对其他账⼾有⽤ " 误认为软美元违规，忽略了最佳执⾏与最低佣⾦已满⾜义务。
method: 代理投票看是否独⽴判断、以受益⼈利益为先；选券商看佣⾦与执⾏质量。
header: S III(A) 忠诚谨慎 · 代理投票与佣⾦ 当时做错 · 错选 C
required_actions: 以客户利益为先；审慎管理客户资产

scenario_en: Brown works for an investment counseling firm. Green, a new client of the firm, is meeting with Brown for the first time. Green used another counseling firm for financial advice for years, but she has switched her account to Brown's firm. After spending a few minutes getting acquainted, Brown explains to Green that she has discovered a highly undervalued stock that of fers lar ge potential gains. She recommends that Green purchase the stock. Brown has committed a violation of the Standards. What should she have done dif ferently?
scenario_cn: Brown 任职于⼀家投资顾问公司。新客⼾ Green ⾸次 与 Brown 会⾯（此前多年⼀直由另⼀家公司服务）。 寒暄⼏分钟后， Brown 告诉 Green 她发现了⼀只被严 重低估、潜在涨幅很⼤的股票，并建议 Green 买⼊。 Brown 已违反标准。她本应怎么做？

options.A: Brown should have determined Green's needs, objectives, and tolerance for risk before making a recommendation of any type of security .Brown 本应在推荐任何证券之前先了解 Green 的 需求、⽬标和⻛险承受能⼒。
options.B: Brown should have thoroughly explained the characteristics of the company to Green, including the characteristics of the industry in which the company operates.Brown 本应向 Green 详细说明该公司及其所在⾏ 业的特征。
options.C: Brown should have explained her qualifications, including her education, training, and experience and the meaning of the CF A designation.Brown 本应说明⾃⼰的资历，包括教育、培训、 经验及 CFA 称号的含义。

explanation: 正确答案 A 。 Brown 在未询问客⼾财务状况、投资经验与投资⽬标的情况下就给出建议，违反 Standard III(C) Suitability 。 B 、 C 虽属与客⼾建⽴关系初期应讨论的内容，但不完整； A 是最佳答案。（当时未作答）
method: 先了解客⼾（需求 / ⽬标 / ⻛险承受）再给建议 —— 顺序颠倒即违反适当性。
header: S III(C) 适当性 · 未了解客⼾即荐股 当时未作答
required_actions: 投资行动前了解客户需求、目标与风险承受能力

scenario_en: Grey recommends the purchase of a mutual fund that invests solely in long-term US Treasury bonds. He makes the following statements to his clients: I. "The payment of the bonds is guaranteed by the US government; therefore, the default risk of the bonds is virtually zero." II. "If you invest in the mutual fund, you will earn a 10% rate of return each year for the next several years based on historical performance of the market." Did Grey's statements violate the CF A Institute Code and Standards?
scenario_cn: Grey 推荐客⼾买⼊⼀只仅投资美国⻓期国债的共同 基⾦，并对客⼾作出两项陈述： I." 债券偿付由美国 政府担保，因此违约⻛险⼏乎为零。 "II." 若投资该基 ⾦，基于市场历史表现，未来⼏年你每年将获得 10% 的回报率。 "Grey 的陈述是否违反准则与标准？

options.A: Neither statement violated the Code and Standards. 两项陈述均未违反。
options.B: Only statement I violated the Code and Standards. 仅陈述 I 违反。
options.C: Only statement II violated the Code and Standards. 仅陈述 II 违反。

explanation: 正确答案 C 。涉及 Standard I(C) Misrepresentation ：陈述 I 是关于投资⼯具条款的事实性陈述，向客⼾披 露了准确信息，不违规；陈述 II 保证具体回报率，是把观点当作事实陈述，违反 I(C) 。若改写为 " 依我看，投 资者可能获得 ……" 之类带限定语的表述则不构成违规。（当时未作答）
method: 事实陈述 OK ；把收益预期说成确定结果＝虚假陈述。
header: S I(C) 虚假陈述 · 国债基⾦宣传 当时未作答
required_actions: 不得作出虚假陈述或遗漏重大事实；纠正错误信息

scenario_en: Anderb, a portfolio manager for XYZ Investment Management Company—a registered investment or ganization that advises investment firms and private accounts—was promoted to that position three years ago. Bates, her supervisor , is responsible for reviewing Anderb's portfolio account transactions and her required monthly reports of personal stock transactions. Anderb has been using Jonelli, a broker , almost exclusively for brokerage transactions for the portfolio account. For securities in which Jonelli's firm makes a market, Jonelli has been giving Anderb lower prices for personal purchases and higher prices for personal sales than Jonelli gives to Anderb's portfolio accounts and other investors. Anderb has been filing monthly reports with Bates only for those months in which she has no personal transactions, which is about every fourth month. Which of the following is most likely to be a violation of the Code and Standards?
scenario_cn: Anderb 是 XYZ 投资管理公司的组合经理，三年前升 任现职。其上司 Bates 负责审查 Anderb 的组合账⼾ 交易及按规定提交的每⽉个⼈股票交易报告。 Anderb 的组合账⼾经纪交易⼏乎 exclusively 通过券商 Jonelli 进⾏；在 Jonelli 做市的证券上， Jonelli 给 Anderb 个 ⼈买⼊的价格低于、个⼈卖出的价格⾼于其组合账 ⼾及其他投资者。 Anderb 只在⽆个⼈交易的⽉份 （约每四个⽉⼀次）才向 Bates 提交⽉报。下列哪项 最可能违反准则与标准？

options.A: Anderb failed to disclose to her employer her personal transactions.Anderb 未向雇主披露其个⼈交易。
options.B: Anderb owned the same securities as those of her clients. Anderb 持有与客⼾相同的证券。
options.C: Bates allowed Anderb to use Jonelli as her broker for personal trades.Bates 允许 Anderb ⽤ Jonelli 作为个⼈交易的券 商。

explanation: 正确答案 A 。本题涉及三条标准： Anderb 个⼈交易获得⽐客⼾更优的价格，违反 Standard III(A) ；不遵 守公司报告政策、向公司隐瞒个⼈交易，违反 Standard I(D) Misconduct ；上司 Bates 未切实执⾏报告制度，违 反 Standard IV(C) Responsibilities of Supervisors 。 B 不违规： VI(B) Priority of Transactions 只要求个⼈交易排在客 ⼾和雇主之后，并不禁⽌持有相同证券； C 不违规：准则不禁⽌员⼯个⼈与客⼾共⽤同⼀券商，但应向雇主 披露以便判断是否存在利益冲突。（当时未作答）
method: 个⼈交易获优于客⼾的价格 + 隐瞒不报，是多重违规的题眼。
header: S III(A)+I(D)+IV(C) 综合 · 隐瞒个⼈交易 当时未作答
required_actions: 以客户利益为先；审慎管理客户资产
不得从事欺诈、欺骗等有损职业声誉的行为
建立合规程序；监督下属行为
客户交易优先于个人交易；禁止抢先交易

scenario_en: Which of the following is a correct statement of a member's or candidate's duty under the Code and Standards?
scenario_cn: 关于会员或考⽣在准则与标准下的义务，下列哪项 说法正确？

options.A: In the absence of specific applicable law or other regulatory requirements, the Code and Standards govern the member's or candidate's actions.在没有具体适⽤法律或其他监管要求时，以准则 与标准规范会员或考⽣的⾏为。
options.B: A member or candidate is required to comply only with applicable local laws, rules, regulations, or customs, even though the Code and Standards may impose a higher degree of responsibility or a higher duty on the member or candidate.会员或考⽣只需遵守当地适⽤法律、规则、法规 或惯例，即使准则与标准要求更⾼的责任或义 务。
options.C: A member or candidate who trades securities in a securities market where no applicable local laws or stock exchange rules regulate the use of material nonpublic information may take investment action based on material nonpublic information .在没有当地法律或交易所规则规管重⼤⾮公开信 息使⽤的市场中，会员或考⽣可以依据重⼤⾮公 开信息采取投资⾏动。

explanation: 正确答案 A 。涉及 Standard I(A) Knowledge of the Law 的全球适⽤：在多个辖区执业可能受不同法律约 束；适⽤法律严于准则时遵守法律，否则必须遵守准则与标准（取两者中更严格者）。 B 错：当地法律宽松时 仍须遵守更严格的准则； C 错：⽆适⽤法律时以准则为准，准则禁⽌使⽤重⼤⾮公开信息。（当时未作答）
method: 法律与准则冲突取更严者；⽆法律时准则兜底。
header: S I(A) 知法守法 · 全球适⽤ 当时未作答
required_actions: 遵守适用法律法规；向监管者报告违法行为

scenario_en: Ward is scheduled to visit the corporate headquarters of Evans Industries. Ward expects to use the information he obtains there to complete his research report on Evans stock. Ward learns that Evans plans to pay all of Ward's expenses for the trip, including the costs of meals, his hotel room, and air transportation. Which of the following actions would be the best course for Ward to take under the Code and Standards?
scenario_cn: Ward 计划⾛访 Evans ⼯业公司总部，以便⽤所获信 息完成对该股票的研究报告。 Ward 得知 Evans 打算 ⽀付此⾏全部费⽤，包括餐费、酒店和机票。依据 准则与标准， Ward 的最佳做法是：

options.A: Accept the expense-paid trip, and write an objective report. 接受付费⾏程，并撰写客观的报告。
options.B: Pay for all travel expenses, including the costs of meals and incidental items.⾃⾏⽀付全部差旅费⽤，包括餐费与杂项。
options.C: Accept the expense-paid trip, but disclose the value of the services accepted in the report.接受付费⾏程，但在报告中披露所接受服务的价 值。

explanation: 正确答案 B 。 Standard I(B) Independence and Objectivity 的最佳做法是尽可能避免利益冲突，故⾃费最 佳。 C 只是披露冲突，不如避免； A 最不可取：即使报告实际不受影响，接受对⽅付费仍会产⽣利益冲突的 表象。（当时未作答）
method: I(B) 题：避免冲突＞披露冲突＞默默接受。
header: S I(B) 独⽴客观 · 公司付费考察 当时未作答
required_actions: 拒绝可能损害独立客观性的礼品、招待或好处

scenario_en: Which of the following statements is correct under the Code and Standards?
scenario_cn: 依据准则与标准，下列哪项说法正确？

options.A: CFA Institute members and candidates are prohibited from undertaking independent practice in competition with their employer .禁⽌ CFA 会员和考⽣从事与雇主竞争的独⽴执 业。
options.B: Written consent from the employer is necessary to permit independent practice that could result in compensation or other benefits in competition with a member's or candidate's employer .从事可能与雇主竞争并带来报酬或其他利益的独 ⽴执业，必须取得雇主书⾯同意。
options.C: Members and candidates are prohibited from making arrangements or preparations to go into a competitive business before terminating their relationship with their employer .禁⽌会员和考⽣在与雇主解除关系前为开展竞争 性业务作任何安排或准备。

explanation: 正确答案 B 。依据 Standard IV(A) Loyalty ：会员和考⽣可以从事可能与雇主竞争并带来报酬的独⽴执 业，但须取得雇主同意。 C 错：准则允许在职期间为创业作准备，只要不损害对现雇主的职责； A 错：准则 并⾮完全禁⽌独⽴执业。（当时未作答）
method: 竞争性独⽴执业不是禁⽌，⽽是要雇主书⾯同意。
header: S IV(A) 忠诚 · 业余独⽴执业 当时未作答
required_actions: 不得剥夺雇主技能优势；避免利益冲突

scenario_en: Smith is a financial analyst with XYZ Brokerage Firm. She is preparing a purchase recommendation on JNI Corporation. Which of the following situations is most likely to represent a conflict of interest for Smith that would have to be avoided or disclosed?
scenario_cn: Smith 是 XYZ 券商的⾦融分析师，正准备对 JNI 公司 的买⼊建议。下列哪种情形最可能构成必须避免或 披露的利益冲突？

options.A: Smith frequently purchases items produced by JNI. Smith 经常购买 JNI ⽣产的产品。
options.B: XYZ holds for its own account a substantial common stock position in JNI.XYZ ⾃营账⼾⼤量持有 JNI 普通股。
options.C: Smith's brother -in-law is a supplier to JNI. Smith 的姐夫 / 妹夫是 JNI 的供应商。

explanation: 正确答案 B 。涉及 Standard VI(A)—— 分析师雇主持有被研究公司股票：雇主⾃营⼤量持股构成必须在研 报中披露的利益冲突；也可通过不让 Smith 撰写该公司报告来避免冲突。 A 只是使⽤该公司产品，通常不产⽣ 需披露的冲突； C 中亲属关系过于间接，不构成须披露的冲突。（当时未作答）
method: 雇主⾃营重仓被研究标的＝典型需披露冲突；私⼈消费和远亲关系不算。
header: S VI(A) 利益冲突 · 雇主持股 当时未作答
required_actions: 充分披露影响独立性的利益冲突

scenario_en: Michelieu tells a prospective client , "I may not have a long- term track record yet, but I'm sure that you'll be very pleased with my recommendations and service. In the three years that I've been in the business, my equity-oriented clients have averaged a total return of more than 26% a year ." The statement is true, but Michelieu only has a few clients, and one of his clients took a lar ge position in a penny stock (against Michelieu's advice) and realized a huge gain. This large return caused the average of all of Michelieu's clients to exceed 26% a year . Without this one investment, the average gain would have been 8% a year . Has Michelieu violated the Standards?
scenario_cn: Michelieu 对潜在客⼾说： " 我或许还没有⻓期业绩记 录，但我相信您会对我的建议和服务⾮常满意。从 业三年来，我股票型客⼾的年均总回报超过 26%。 "该说法属实，但他客⼾很少，其中⼀位客⼾ （违背其建议）重仓⼀只低价股获得巨额收益，使 全体客⼾平均回报超过 26% ；剔除该笔投资，平均 收益仅 8%/ 年。 Michelieu 是否违反标准？

options.A: No, because Michelieu is not promising that he can earn a 26% return in the future.没有，因为他并未承诺未来能获得 26% 的回 报。
options.B: No, because the statement is a true and accurate description of Michelieu's track record.没有，因为该陈述是对其业绩记录真实准确的描 述。
options.C: Yes, because the statement misrepresents Michelieu's track record.是，因为该陈述对其业绩记录构成虚假陈述。

explanation: 正确答案 C （当时答对）。涉及 Standard I(C) Misrepresentation ：虽然平均 26% 的说法技术上属实，但绝 ⼤部分收益来⾃⼀位客⼾违背其建议的重仓，具有误导性，未能公平、准确、完整地呈现本⼈实际负责的业 绩。 B 错； A 错：虽未保证未来收益，但其措辞仍构成对历史业绩的虚假陈述。
method: 技术上属实但实质误导的业绩陈述同样违反 I(C) 。
header: S I(C) 虚假陈述 · 业绩平均数误导 当时做对
required_actions: 不得作出虚假陈述或遗漏重大事实；纠正错误信息

scenario_en: An investment banking department of a brokerage firm often receives material nonpublic information that could have considerable value if used in advising the firm's brokerage clients. In order to conform to the Code and Standards, which one of the following is the best policy for the brokerage firm?
scenario_cn: 某券商的投⾏部⻔经常收到重⼤⾮公开信息，若⽤ 于经纪业务咨询将很有价值。为符合准则与标准， 该券商的最佳政策是：（本题在 OCR 截图 s03 末尾与 s04 开头重复出现，只录⼀次）

options.A: Permanently prohibit both "buy" and "sell" recommendations of the stocks of clients of the investment banking department.永久禁⽌对投⾏部⻔客⼾的股票发布 " 买 ⼊"和 "卖出 " 建议。
options.B: Establish physical and informational barriers within the firm to prevent the exchange of information between the investment banking and brokerage operations.在公司内部建⽴物理与信息屏障，防⽌投⾏与经 纪部⻔之间的信息交换。
options.C: Monitor the exchange of information between the investment banking department and the brokerage operation.监控投⾏部⻔与经纪业务之间的信息交换。

explanation: 正确答案 B 。防⽌违反 Standard II(A) Material Nonpublic Information 的最佳政策是建⽴防⽕墙，物理与信 息屏障可阻⽌投⾏部⻔向经纪侧撰写研报的分析师传递内幕信息。 A 错： " 永久 " 禁⽌并⾮最佳 —— 发⾏完成、 信息公开后即可恢复发布建议； C 错：两部⻔之间本不应有任何信息交换，监控交换不是有效的合规程序。 （当时未作答）
method: 内幕信息治理⾸选 " 防⽕墙 " ，⽽⾮永久禁发或仅监控。
header: S II(A) 重⼤⾮公开信息 · 防⽕墙 当时未作答
required_actions: 不得利用或促使他人利用重大非公开信息

scenario_en: Stewart has been hired by Goodner Industries, Inc., to manage its pension fund . Stewart's duty of loyalty , prudence, and care is owed to:
scenario_cn: Stewart 受 Goodner ⼯业公司委托管理其养⽼基⾦。 Stewart 的忠诚、审慎与勤勉义务应⾯向：

options.A: the management of Goodner . Goodner 的管理层。
options.B: the participants and beneficiaries of Goodner's pension plan. Goodner 养⽼⾦计划的参与⼈与受益⼈。
options.C: the shareholders of Goodner . Goodner 的股东。

explanation: 正确答案 B 。依据 Standard III(A) ：管理公司养⽼基⾦时，忠诚、审慎与勤勉义务⾯向养⽼⾦计划的参与 ⼈和受益⼈，⽽⾮公司管理层或股东。（当时未作答）
method: 管谁的钱对谁负责：养⽼⾦ → 参与⼈与受益⼈。
header: S III(A) 忠诚谨慎 · 养⽼⾦受托对象 当时未作答
required_actions: 以客户利益为先；审慎管理客户资产

scenario_en: Which of the following statements is a stated purpose of disclosure in Standard VI(C) Referral Fees ?
scenario_cn: 下列哪项是 Standard VI(C) Referral Fees （推介费）规 定的披露⽬的？

options.A: Disclosure will allow the client to request discounted service fees.披露可让客⼾要求折扣服务费。
options.B: Disclosure will help the client evaluate any possible partiality shown in the recommendation of services.披露有助于客⼾评估服务推荐中可能存在的偏 袒。
options.C: Disclosure means advising a prospective client about the referral arrangement once a formal client relationship has been established.披露指在正式客⼾关系建⽴之后再告知潜在客⼾ 推介安排。

explanation: 正确答案 B 。⼿册列明 VI(C) 披露推介费的两⼤⽬的之⼀即让客⼾评估推荐中可能的偏袒（另⼀⽬的是 让客⼾和雇主评估服务的全部成本）。 A 错： VI(C) 不要求收取推介费时打折； C 错：有效的披露应在建⽴正 式客⼾关系之前作出。（当时未作答）
method: 推介费披露⽬的：评估偏袒 + 评估全部成本；且须在建⽴关系前披露。
header: S VI(C) 推介费 · 披露⽬的 当时未作答
required_actions: 披露并取得相关方同意后收取介绍费

scenario_en: Rose, a portfolio manager for a local investment advisory firm, is planning to sell a portion of his personal investment portfolio to cover the costs of his child's academic tuition. Rose wants to sell a portion of his holdings in Household Products, but his firm recently upgraded the stock to "strong buy." Which of the following describes Rose's options under the Code and Standards?
scenario_cn: Rose 是本地投资顾问公司的组合经理，打算卖出部 分个⼈持仓以⽀付孩⼦学费。他想卖出部分 Household Products 持股，但公司最近刚把该股上调 为"强烈买⼊ " 。依据准则与标准， Rose 可以怎么 做？

options.A: Based on his firm's "buy" recommendation, Rose cannot sell the shares because he would be improperly prospering from the inflated recommendation.基于公司的 " 买⼊ " 建议， Rose 不能卖出，否则 属不当利⽤被抬⾼的建议获利。
options.B: Rose is free to sell his personal holdings once his firm is properly informed of his intentions.只要将意图适当告知公司， Rose 即可⾃由卖出 个⼈持仓。
options.C: Rose can sell his personal holdings but only when a client of the firm places an order to buy shares of Household.Rose 可以卖出，但仅当公司客⼾下达买⼊ Household 股票的订单时。

explanation: 正确答案 B 。 Standard VI(B) Priority of Transactions 不限制与公司现⾏建议⽅向相反的员⼯个⼈交易，只 要卖出不损害现有客⼾利益。 A 错； C 错：标准不要求个⼈交易与客⼾交易撮合配对。（当时未作答）
method: VI(B) 核⼼是 " 客⼾交易优先 " ，不禁⽌与客⼾利益不冲突的反向个⼈交易。
header: S VI(B) 交易优先 · 个⼈卖出 当时未作答
required_actions: 客户交易优先于个人交易；禁止抢先交易

scenario_en: A former hedge fund manager , Jackman, has decided to launch a new private wealth management firm. From his prior experiences, he believes the new firm needs to achieve US＄ 1 million in assets under management in the first year . Jackman of fers a US ＄ 10,000 incentive to any adviser who joins his firm with the minimum of US ＄ 200,000 in committed investments. Jackman places notice of the opening on several industry web portals and career search sites. Which of the following is correct according to the Code and Standards?
scenario_cn: 前对冲基⾦经理 Jackman 决定创办⼀家私⼈财富管理 公司，认为⾸年需达到 ＄ 1 million 管理规模，并向 带⾄少 ＄ 200,000 承诺投资加盟的顾问提供 ＄ 10,000 奖励。他在多个⾏业⻔⼾⽹站和求职⽹站发布了开 业信息。依据准则与标准，下列哪项正确？

options.A: A member or candidate is eligible for the new position and incentive if he or she can arrange for enough current clients to switch to the new firm and if the member or candidate discloses the incentive fee.只要会员或考⽣能安排⾜够多现客⼾转⼊新公司 并披露奖励费，即可接受该职位与奖励。
options.B: A member or candidate may not accept employment with the new firm, because Jackman's incentive of fer violates the Code and Standards.会员或考⽣不得接受该公司职位，因为 Jackman 的奖励要约违反准则与标准。
options.C: A member or candidate is not eligible for the new position unless he or she is currently unemployed, because soliciting the clients of the member's or candidate's current employer is prohibited.除⾮⽬前处于失业状态，否则会员或考⽣不能接 受该职位，因为禁⽌招揽现雇主的客⼾。

explanation: 正确答案 C （当时答对）。 Standard IV(A) Loyalty 规定离职时可从事的活动：严禁招揽现雇主客⼾，即使 披露奖励安排也不⾏（ A 错）。 B 错：该奖励要约本⾝不直接违反准则 —— 例如失业的会员完全可以在不违规 的情况下完成所需募资。
method: 离职红线：不带⾛、不招揽现雇主客⼾；要约本⾝不违规，违规的是招揽⾏为。
header: S IV(A) 忠诚 · 离职招揽客⼾ 当时做对
required_actions: 不得剥夺雇主技能优势；避免利益冲突

scenario_en: Carter works for Invest Today , a local asset management firm. A broker that provides Carter with proprietary research through client brokerage arrangements is of fering a new trading service. The broker is of fering low-fee, execution- only trades to complement its traditional full-service execution-and-research trades. To entice Carter and other asset managers to send additional business its way , the broker will apply the commissions paid on the new service toward satisfying the brokerage commitment of the prior full-service arrangements. Carter has always been satisfied with the execution provided on the full-service trades, and the fees of the new low-fee trades are comparable to those of other brokers currently used for the accounts that prohibit soft dollar arrangements.
scenario_cn: Carter 任职于本地资产管理公司 Invest Today 。⼀家通 过客⼾佣⾦安排向其提供独家研究的券商推出新交 易服务：低费率纯执⾏交易，与传统的全服务（执 ⾏+研究）交易互补；为吸引 Carter 等资管⼈增加业 务，新服务佣⾦可计⼊原有全服务安排的佣⾦承 诺。 Carter ⼀向满意其全服务交易的执⾏质量，且新 低费率与其他为 " 禁⽌软美元 " 账⼾服务的券商收费相 当。

options.A: Carter can trade for his accounts that prohibit soft dollar arrangements under the new low-fee trading scheme.Carter 可以按新低费率⽅案为禁⽌软美元安排的 账⼾进⾏交易。
options.B: Carter cannot use the new trading scheme because the commissions are prohibited by the soft dollar restrictions of the accounts.Carter 不能使⽤新⽅案，因为佣⾦受这些账⼾的 软美元限制禁⽌。
options.C: Carter should trade only through the new low-fee scheme and should increase his trading volume to meet his required commission commitment.Carter 应只通过新低费率⽅案交易，并应增加交 易量以满⾜佣⾦承诺。

explanation: 正确答案 A 。涉及 Standard III(A) ： Carter 认为该券商执⾏有效且费率与其他券商相当，故可⽤于所有账 ⼾。 B 错：禁⽌软美元的账⼾是不愿让客⼾佣⾦被⽤来购买研究，新⽅案不向客⼾收取额外佣⾦，不违反该 限制。 C 错（当时错选此项）：不得为凑⾜软美元佣⾦承诺⽽增加不必要交易量，否则构成过度交易 （churning ）。
method: 费率合理 + 执⾏好即可⽤；但绝不能为凑佣⾦承诺⽽放⼤交易量。
header: S III(A) 忠诚谨慎 · 软美元新交易⽅案 当时做错 · 错选 C
required_actions: 以客户利益为先；审慎管理客户资产

scenario_en: Rule has worked as a portfolio manager for a lar ge investment management firm for the past 10 years. Rule earned his CF A charter last year and has decided to open his own investment management firm . After leaving his current employer , Rule creates some marketing material for his new firm. He states in the material, "In earning the CF A charter , a highly regarded credential in the investment management industry , I further enhanced the portfolio management skills learned during my professional career . While completing the examination process in three consecutive years, I consistently received the highest possible scores on the topics of Ethics , Alternative Investments, and Portfolio Management." Has Rule violated Standard VII(B) Reference to CF A Institute , the CF A Designation, and the CF A Program in his marketing material?
scenario_cn: Rule 在⼀家⼤型投资公司任组合经理 10 年，去年取 得 CFA 持证资格，决定⾃⽴⻔⼾。离职后他在新公 司宣传材料中写道： " 获得备受推崇的 CFA 证书进⼀ 步提升了我在职业⽣涯中习得的投资组合管理技 能。在连续三年完成各级考试的过程中，我在道 德、另类投资和组合管理科⽬上 consistently 取得了 可能的最⾼分。 " 这是否违反 Standard VII(B) ？

options.A: Rule violated Standard VII(B) in stating that he completed the exams in three consecutive years.Rule 因声称连续三年完成考试⽽违反 VII(B) 。
options.B: Rule violated Standard VII(B) in stating that he received the highest scores in the topics of Ethics , Alternative Investments, and Portfolio Management.Rule 因声称在道德、另类投资、组合管理科⽬ 取得最⾼分⽽违反 VII(B) 。
options.C: Rule did not violate Standard VII(B). Rule 未违反 VII(B) 。

explanation: 正确答案 B 。 CFA 考⽣不会获得实际考试分数，科⽬成绩只归⼊三个宽泛档次，考试仅判 " 通过 / 不通 过"；即使某科⽬ " ⾼于 70%" ，也⽆法声称取得 " 可能的最⾼分 " ，因为该信息并不公布， C 错。 A 错：只要确 实连续三年完成考试，陈述这⼀事实不违反 VII(B) 。（当时未作答）
method: CFA 只说 pass/fail 与三档成绩； " 最⾼分 " ⽆从证实＝违规陈述。
header: S VII(B) CFA 称谓 · 成绩表述 当时未作答
required_actions: 按规范引用CFA协会会员资格与头衔

scenario_en: Stafford is a portfolio manager for a specialized real estate mutual fund. Her firm clearly describes in the fund's prospectus its soft dollar policies. Staf ford decides that entering the CF A Program will enhance her investment decision-making skill and decides to use the fund's soft dollar account to pay the registration and exam fees for the CF A Program. Which of the following statements is most likely correct?
scenario_cn: Stafford 是⼀只专业房地产共同基⾦的组合经理，基 ⾦招募说明书清楚载明软美元政策。她认为参加 CFA 项⽬能提升投资决策能⼒，决定⽤基⾦软美元 账⼾⽀付 CFA 项⽬的报名与考试费。下列哪项最可 能正确？

options.A: Stafford did not violate the Code and Standards because the prospectus informed investors of the fund's soft dollar policies.未违规，因为招募说明书已告知投资者基⾦的软 美元政策。
options.B: Stafford violated the Code and Standards because improving her investment skills is not a reasonable use of the soft dollar account.违规，因为提升个⼈投资技能不是软美元账⼾的 合理⽤途。
options.C: Stafford violated the Code and Standards because the CF A Program does not meet the definition of research allowed to be purchased with brokerage commissions.违规，因为 CFA 项⽬不符合可⽤经纪佣⾦购买 的"研究 " 之定义。

explanation: 正确答案 C 。依据 Standard III(A) ： CFA 项⽬费⽤属个⼈或公司费⽤，不能⽤基⾦经纪佣⾦⽀付；软美元 只能购买直接有助于投资决策过程的研究服务，不能⽤于公司管理或进修教育。 A 错； B 错：问题不在于⽤ 途是否 "合理 " ，⽽在于教育费⽤根本不是研究。（当时未作答）
method: 软美元＝只能买直接服务投资决策的研究；教育费属个⼈ / 公司开⽀。
header: S III(A) 忠诚谨慎 · 软美元付考试费 当时未作答
required_actions: 以客户利益为先；审慎管理客户资产

scenario_en: Long has been asked to be the keynote speaker at an upcoming investment conference. The event is being hosted by one of the third-party investment managers currently used by his pension fund . The manager of fers to cover all conference and travel costs for Long and make the conference registrations free for three additional members of his investment management team. To ensure that the conference obtains the best speakers, the host firm has arranged for an exclusive golf outing for the day following the conference on a local championship-caliber course. Which of the following is least likely to violate Standard I(B)?
scenario_cn: Long 受邀在⼀场投资会议作主题演讲，主办⽅是其 养⽼基⾦⽬前聘⽤的第三⽅投资管理⼈之⼀。对⽅ 提出承担 Long 全部会议与差旅费⽤，并为其团队另 外三⼈免费提供注册；主办⽅还安排了会后⼀天的 锦标赛级⾼尔夫球场专属活动。下列哪项最不可能 违反 Standard I(B) ？

options.A: Long may accept only the of fer to have his conference-related expenses paid by the host firm.Long 只可接受由主办⽅⽀付其会议相关费⽤的 安排。
options.B: Long may accept the of fer to have his conference-related expenses paid and may attend the exclusive golf outing at the expense of the hosting firm.Long 可接受会议费⽤并由主办⽅付费参加专属 ⾼尔夫活动。
options.C: Long may accept the entire package of incentives of fered to speak at this conference.Long 可接受演讲的全部⼀揽⼦礼遇。

explanation: 正确答案 A 。 Standard I(B) 要求保持独⽴客观；最佳实践是对接受差旅招待采取严格政策，但与演讲直 接相关的会议费⽤通常可以接受⽽不损害独⽴性。 B 、 C 错：额外团队成员免费注册和专属⾼尔夫活动可被视 为与业务关系相关的额外好处，超出演讲本⾝；若想带团队或打球，应由本⼈或公司⾃付费⽤。（当时未作 答）
method: 只收与公务直接相关的费⽤；额外福利（⾼尔夫、家属 / 团队名额）要⾃费。
header: S I(B) 独⽴客观 · 会议招待 当时未作答
required_actions: 拒绝可能损害独立客观性的礼品、招待或好处

scenario_en: Andrews, a private wealth manager , is conducting interviews for a new research analyst for his firm. One of the candidates is Wright, an analyst with a local investment bank. During the interview , while Wright is describing his analytical skills, he mentions a current mer ger in which his firm is acting as the adviser . Andrews has heard rumors of a possible mer ger between the two companies, but no releases have been made by the companies concerned. Which of the following actions by Andrews is least likely a violation of the Code and Standards?
scenario_cn: 私⼈财富管理经理 Andrews 正在为公司⾯试⼀名新 研究分析师。候选⼈ Wright 是本地投⾏的分析师， ⾯试中描述分析能⼒时提到其公司正担任顾问的⼀ 桩进⾏中的并购。 Andrews 此前听说过两家公司的并 购传闻，但相关公司均未发布公告。 Andrews 的下列 做法中，最不可能违反准则与标准的是：

options.A: Waiting until the next day before trading on the information to allow time for it to become public等到第⼆天再依据该信息交易，以留出信息公开 的时间
options.B: Notifying all investment managers in his firm of the new information so none of their clients are disadvantaged将新信息通知公司全体投资经理，以免任何客⼾ 处于不利地位
options.C: Placing the securities mentioned as part of the mer ger on the firm's restricted trading list将并购涉及的证券列⼊公司限制交易名单

explanation: 正确答案 C 。 Standard II(A) 指引建议：当公司持有或可能持有重⼤⾮公开信息时，应将相关证券列⼊限 制名单， C 合规。 A 错：等到第⼆天并不能保证信息已公开，并购谈判可能持续更久甚⾄告吹，必须等信息 向市场充分传播后⽅可交易； B 错：不应向其他经理扩散该信息，重⼤⾮公开信息⼀律不得据以交易。（当时 未作答）
method: 拿到重⼤⾮公开信息：上限制名单、不交易、不扩散。
header: S II(A) 重⼤⾮公开信息 · ⾯试泄密 当时未作答
required_actions: 不得利用或促使他人利用重大非公开信息

scenario_en: Pietro, president of Local Bank, has hired the bank's market maker , Vogt, to seek a mer ger partner . Local is currently listed on a stock exchange and has not reported that it is seeking strategic alternatives. Vogt has discussed the possibility of a mer ger with several firms, but they have all decided to wait until after the next period's financial data are available. The potential buyers believe the results will be worse than the results of prior periods and will allow them to pay less for Local Bank. Pietro wants to increase the likelihood of structuring a mer ger deal quickly . Which of the following actions would most likely be a violation of the Code and Standards?
scenario_cn: Local 银⾏⾏⻓ Pietro 聘请该⾏做市商 Vogt 寻找并购 伙伴。 Local 为上市公司，尚未披露其在寻求战略选 择。 Vogt 已与多家公司洽谈并购可能，但对⽅都想 等下期财务数据出来后再定，因为他们预期业绩会 变差、可以压价。 Pietro 想提⾼尽快达成交易的可能 性。下列哪项最可能违反准则与标准？

options.A: Pietro could instruct Local Bank to issue a press release announcing that it has retained Vogt to find a mer ger partner .Pietro 可指⽰ Local 银⾏发布新闻稿，宣布已聘 请 Vogt 寻找并购伙伴。
options.B: Pietro could place a buy order for 2,000 shares (or four times the average weekly volume) through Vogt for his personal account.Pietro 可通过 Vogt 为个⼈账⼾下 2,000 股（约四 倍于平均周成交量）的买单。
options.C: After confirming with Local's chief financial of ficer, Pietro could instruct Local to issue a press release reaf firming the firm's prior announced earnings guidance for the full fiscal year.经与⾸席财务官确认后， Pietro 可指⽰ Local 发 布新闻稿，重申此前公布的全年盈利指引。

explanation: 正确答案 B 。个⼈账⼾⼤额买单（四倍于平均周成交量）意在做多抬价、吸引买⽅，构成 Standard II(B) Market Manipulation 。 A 、 C 中的公告（宣布聘请并购顾问、经 CFO 确认后重申盈利指引）属常⻅且正当的信 息披露，不构成操纵。 C 是当时错选项：把正常信息披露误认为操纵，真正的操纵⾏为是 B 的异常⼤额个⼈ 买单。
method: 异常放量⾃买⾃卖抬价＝交易型市场操纵；正常公告不算。
header: S II(B) 市场操纵 · 拉抬股价促并购 当时做错 · 错选 C
required_actions: 不得操纵市场价格或成交量

scenario_en: ABC Investment Management acquires a new , very lar ge account with two concentrated positions. The firm's current policy is to add new accounts for the purpose of performance calculation after the first full month of management. Cupp is responsible for calculating the firm's performance returns. Before the end of the initial month, Cupp notices that one of the significant holdings of the new accounts is acquired by another company , causing the value of the investment to double. Because of this holding, Cupp decides to account for the new portfolio as of the date of transfer , thereby allowing ABC Investment to reap the positive impact of that month's portfolio return. Which of the following statements is true?
scenario_cn: ABC 投资管理公司获得⼀个含两个集中持仓的超⼤ 新账⼾。公司现⾏政策是：新账⼾在管理满第⼀个 整⽉后才纳⼊业绩计算。负责计算业绩的 Cupp 在⾸ ⽉结束前发现新账⼾的⼀个重要持仓被其他公司收 购、价值翻倍。于是他决定⾃划⼊⽇起就把新组合 纳⼊计算，使 ABC 获得当⽉收益的正向影响。下列 哪项正确？

options.A: Cupp did not violate the Code and Standards, because the GIPS standards allow composites to be updated on the date of large external cash flows.未违规，因为 GIPS 允许在发⽣⼤额外部现⾦流 当⽇更新组合群。
options.B: Cupp did not violate the Code and Standards, because companies are allowed to determine when to incorporate new accounts into their composite calculation.未违规，因为公司可⾃⾏决定何时将新账⼾纳⼊ 组合群计算。
options.C: Cupp violated the Code and Standards because the inclusion of the new account produces an inaccurate calculation of the monthly results according to the firm's stated policies.违规，因为按公司既定政策，纳⼊该新账⼾使当 ⽉业绩计算失准。

explanation: 正确答案 C 。 Cupp 仅为捕捉收购带来的收益⽽偏离公司既定政策，违反 Standard III(D) Performance Presentations 。 A 错：公司并未声称 GIPS 合规，且 GIPS 也要求外部现⾦流按公司书⾯政策⼀致处理； B 错： 公司并未宣布更新组合群政策，若变更政策，当⽉所有现⾦流都须按新政策⼀致复核处理。（当时未作答）
method: 业绩计算必须严格按既定书⾯政策执⾏，不得为收益 " 择时并表 " 。
header: S III(D) 业绩呈报 · 新账⼾并表时点 当时未作答
required_actions: 确保业绩陈述公平、准确、完整

scenario_en: Cannan has been working from home on weekends and occasionally saves correspondence with clients and completed reports on her home computer . Because of worsening market conditions, Cannan is one of several employees released by her firm. While Cannan is looking for a new job, she uses the files she saved at home to request letters of recommendation from former clients. She also provides to prospective clients some of the reports as examples of her abilities. Which of the following statements is true?
scenario_cn: Cannan 周末在家办公，偶尔把与客⼾的往来邮件和 完成的报告存到家⽤电脑上。因市场恶化她被公司 裁减。求职期间，她⽤家中保存的⽂件向前客⼾索 取推荐信，并把部分报告作为能⼒样例提供给潜在 客⼾。下列哪项正确？

options.A: Cannan violated the Code and Standards because she did not receive permission from her former employer to keep or use the files after her employment ended.违规，因为她未获得前雇主许可在离职后保留或 使⽤这些⽂件。
options.B: Cannan did not violate the Code and Standards, because the files were created and saved on her own time and computer .未违规，因为⽂件是在她⾃⼰的时间和电脑上创 建保存的。
options.C: Cannan violated the Code and Standards because she is prohibited from saving files on her home computer .违规，因为她被禁⽌把⽂件保存到家⽤电脑。

explanation: 正确答案 A 。依据 Standard V(C) Record Retention ：离职后在家保留这些⽂件需经雇主许可，未经许可应 删除；凡属职业活动产出的⽂件均为公司财产，即使是在正常⼯时之外创建的， B 错。 C 错：准则不禁⽌⽤ 个⼈电脑为公司⼯作。（当时未作答）
method: ⼯作成果归公司；离职留⽤任何⽂件都要前雇主书⾯许可。
header: S V(C) 记录保存 · 离职带⾛⽂件 当时未作答
required_actions: 保存支持投资决策与建议的记录

scenario_en: Quinn sat for the Level III CF A exam this past weekend. He updates his resume with the following statement: "In finishing the CF A Program, I improved my skills related to researching investments and managing portfolios. I will be eligible for the CF A charter upon completion of the required work experience." Which of the following statements is true?
scenario_cn: Quinn 上周末刚参加 CFA 三级考试。他把简历更新 为： "完成 CFA 项⽬使我提升了投资研究与组合管理 技能。满⾜所需⼯作经验后，我将有资格获得 CFA 证书。 "下列哪项正确？

options.A: Quinn violated the Code and Standards by claiming he improved his skills through the CF A Program.因声称通过 CFA 项⽬提升了技能⽽违规。
options.B: Quinn violated the Code and Standards by incorrectly stating that he is eligible for the CF A charter .因错误地声称⾃⼰有资格获得 CFA 证书⽽违 规。
options.C: Quinn did not violate the Code and Standards with his resume update.其简历更新未违反准则与标准。

explanation: 正确答案 B 。依据 Standard VII(B) ：在正式得知通过三级考试之前，不能声称已 " 完成 CFA 项⽬ " 或 " 有资 格获得证书 " ；成绩公布前刚考完的⼈仍应⾃称 " 考⽣（ candidate ） " ， C 错。 A 错：会员和考⽣可以谈论 CFA 项⽬在哪些执业领域提升了⾃⼰的技能。（当时未作答）
method: 成绩未出＝仍是 candidate ；不得⾃称完成项⽬或 eligible 。
header: S VII(B) CFA 称谓 · 考后简历 当时未作答
required_actions: 按规范引用CFA协会会员资格与头衔

scenario_en: During a round of golf, Rodriguez, chief financial of ficer of Mega Retail, mentions to Hart, a local investment adviser and long-time personal friend, that Mega is having an exceptional sales quarter . Rodriguez expects the results to be almost 10% above the current estimates. The next day , Hart initiates the purchase of a lar ge stake in the local exchange-traded retail fund for her personal account.
scenario_cn: 打⾼尔夫时， Mega Retail 的⾸席财务官 Rodriguez 向 多年好友、本地投资顾问 Hart 透露： Mega 本季销售 异常出⾊，预计业绩⽐当前市场预期⾼出近 10% 。 次⽇， Hart 为个⼈账⼾⼤举买⼊本地上市的零售⾏ 业 ETF。

options.A: Hart violated the Code and Standards by investing in the exchange-traded fund that included Mega Retail.Hart 因买⼊包含 Mega Retail 的 ETF ⽽违反准则 与标准。
options.B: Hart did not violate the Code and Standards, because she did not invest directly in securities of Mega Retail.Hart 未违规，因为她没有直接投资 Mega Retail 的证券。
options.C: Rodriguez did not violate the Code and Standards, because the comments made to Hart were not intended to solicit an investment in Mega Retail.Rodriguez 未违规，因为他对 Hart 说的话并⾮意 在招揽对 Mega Retail 的投资。

explanation: 正确答案 A 。 Hart 买⼊零售 ETF 的决定与 Rodriguez 透露的业绩信息直接相关，违反 Standard II(A) ；该 信息属重⼤信息，既会影响 Mega 股价，也可能影响整个零售 ETF 价格， B 错。 C 错：公司⾼管掌握此类信息 本⾝不违规，但把重⼤⾮公开信息透露给他⼈（即使是朋友闲聊）即违反 II(A) 。（当时未作答）
method: 通过相关⾏业 ETF 变相利⽤内幕信息同样违规；透露者也违规。
header: S II(A) 重⼤⾮公开信息 · 朋友闲聊 +ETF 当时未作答
required_actions: 不得利用或促使他人利用重大非公开信息

scenario_en: Park is very frustrated after taking the Level II CF A exam.
