While she was studying for the exam, to supplement the curriculum provided, she ordered and used study material from a third-party provider . Park believes the additional material focused her attention on specific topic areas that were not tested while ignoring other areas. She posts the following statement on the provider's discussion board: "I am very dissatisfied with your firm's CF A Program Level II material. I found the exam extremely dif ficult and myself unprepared for specific questions after using your product. How could your service provide such limited instructional resources on the analysis of inventories and taxes when the exam had multiple questions about them? I will not recommend your products to other candidates." Which of the following statements is true?
scenario_cn: Park 考完 CFA ⼆级后很沮丧。备考时她在课程之外 购买了第三⽅机构的复习资料，并认为该资料让她 把注意⼒放在未考的内容上⽽忽略了其他考点。她 在该机构讨论版发帖： " 我对贵公司的⼆级资料⾮常 不满。考试极难，⽤过你们产品后我对具体题⽬毫 ⽆准备。考试明明有多道存货分析和税务的题⽬， 你们的辅导资源怎么如此有限？我不会向其他考⽣ 推荐你们的产品。 " 下列哪项正确？

options.A: Park violated the Code and Standards by purchasing third-party review material.因购买第三⽅复习资料⽽违规。
options.B: Park violated the Code and Standards by providing her opinion on the dif ficulty of the exam.因发表对考试难度的看法⽽违规。
options.C: Park violated the Code and Standards by providing specific information on topics tested on the exam.因透露考试涉及的具体考点信息⽽违规。

explanation: 正确答案 C （当时答对）。 Standard VII(A) Conduct as Members and Candidates in the CFA Program 禁⽌向考 ⽣或公众提供属于 CFA 项⽬机密的信息；透露 " 考了存货分析和税务的题⽬ " 即违反该标准。 B 错：该标准指 引明确允许会员和考⽣发表对 CFA 项⽬的看法； A 错：不禁⽌使⽤第三⽅备考资料。
method: 可吐槽难度，但不可泄露具体考点 / 考题内容。
header: S VII(A) 考⽣⾏为 · 泄露考题内容 当时做对
required_actions: 遵守考试规则；不得泄露考题内容

scenario_en: Paper was recently terminated as one of a team of five managers of an equity fund. The fund had two value-focused managers and terminated one of them to reduce costs. In a letter sent to prospective employers, Paper presents, with written permission of the firm, the performance history of the fund to demonstrate his past success. Which of the following statements is true?
scenario_cn: Paper 原是某股票基⾦五⼈管理团队的⼀员（基⾦有 两名价值型经理，为降成本裁掉其⼀）。在发给潜在 雇主的求职信中， Paper 经公司书⾯许可展⽰了该基 ⾦的历史业绩，以证明⾃⼰过往的成功。下列哪项 正确？

options.A: Paper did not violate the Code and Standards. Paper 未违反准则与标准。
options.B: Paper violated the Code and Standards by claiming the performance of the entire fund as his own.违规，因为他把整个基⾦的业绩当作⾃⼰的业 绩。
options.C: Paper violated the Code and Standards by including the historical results of his prior employer .违规，因为其中包含了前雇主的历史业绩。

explanation: 正确答案 B 。 Paper 违反 Standard III(D) Performance Presentation ：未披露所⽰业绩是由⼀个经理团队共同 取得的；若同时展⽰其本⼈直接管理部分的回报则不违规， A 错。 C 错：他已取得前雇主书⾯许可展⽰该业 绩。（当时未作答）
method: 引⽤前雇主业绩：⼀要书⾯许可，⼆要说明⾃⼰在团队中的具体贡献。
header: S III(D) 业绩呈报 · 团队业绩据为⼰有 当时未作答
required_actions: 确保业绩陈述公平、准确、完整

scenario_en: Townsend was recently appointed to the board of directors of a youth golf program that is the local chapter of a national not-for -profit or ganization. The program is beginning a new fund-raising campaign to expand the number of annual scholarships it provides. Townsend believes many of her clients make annual donations to charity . The next week in her regular newsletter to all clients, she includes a small section discussing the fund-raising campaign and her position on the or ganization's board. Which of the following statements is true?
scenario_cn: Townsend 最近被任命为某全国性⾮营利组织地⽅分 会⻘少年⾼尔夫项⽬的董事。该项⽬正发起募捐活 动以扩⼤年度奖学⾦名额。 Townsend 认为许多客⼾ 每年都做慈善捐赠。次周她在发给全体客⼾的常规 通讯中加⼊⼀⼩节，介绍该募捐活动及⾃⼰在该组 织的董事职务。下列哪项正确？

options.A: Townsend did not violate the Code and Standards. Townsend 未违反准则与标准。
options.B: Townsend violated the Code and Standards by soliciting donations from her clients through the newsletter .违规，因为她通过通讯向客⼾募捐。
options.C: Townsend violated the Code and Standards by not getting approval of the or ganization before soliciting her clients.违规，因为她在向客⼾募捐前未取得该组织批 准。

explanation: 正确答案 A 。 Townsend 并未向⾼尔夫项⽬的负责⼈提供其客⼾的任何信息，因此未违反 Standard III(E) Preservation of Confidentiality ；若把客⼾联系⽅式提供给该组织做直邮募捐才构成违规， B 错。 C 错：募捐活 动已经开始，介绍该捐赠机会是恰当的。（当时未作答）
method: 在⾃⼰的通讯⾥谈公益＝ OK ；把客⼾名单交给第三⽅＝违反保密。
header: S III(E) 保密 · 慈善募捐通讯 当时未作答
required_actions: 对客户及前雇主信息保密

scenario_en: Jimmy Lan, CF A, is a technology analyst at Pacific Securities, Inc., and is a leading authority on Japanese technology companies. Lan's clients include many leading Japanese equity managers. While still employed at Pacific, Lan makes plans during weekends to start a new company , JL Consulting. His plans consist of contracting of fice space, interviewing potential employees, and purchasing of fice equipment. Once he feels ready to launch his new firm, Lan provides Pacific with his resignation notice. After leaving, Lan constructs earnings models of the technology companies he previously covered, using the knowledge and experience gained while at Pacific. He then contacts former clients by using public sources and encourages them to become clients of his new firm. Are Lan's actions in compliance with the Code and Standards?
scenario_cn: Jimmy Lan, CFA 是 Pacific 证券的科技⾏业分析师、 ⽇本科技公司权威，客⼾包括多家知名⽇本股票基 ⾦管理⼈。在职期间，他利⽤周末筹备新公司 JL Consulting ：租办公室、⾯试潜在员⼯、采购设备。 准备就绪后他向 Pacific 递交辞呈。离职后，他利⽤ 在 Pacific 积累的知识与经验构建此前覆盖公司的盈 利模型，并通过公开渠道联系前客⼾，邀请他们成 为新公司客⼾。 Lan 的⾏为是否合规？

options.A: Yes, assuming he is not in breach of any non-compete agreement signed while at Pacific Securities合规，前提是他不违反在 Pacific 任职期间签署 的竞业禁⽌协议
options.B: No, because he is prohibited from engaging in activities related to starting his new business while still employed by Pacific Securities不合规，因为他在职期间不得从事任何与创办新 业务相关的活动
options.C: No, because the names of former clients, modeling skills and experience gained by Lan are confidential information of Pacific Securities不合规，因为前客⼾名单、建模技能与经验属于 Pacific 的机密信息

explanation: 正确答案 A 。 Lan 的⾏为不违反 Standard IV(A) ：他未占⽤上班时间筹备新业务，也未挪⽤前雇主信息 （财务模型或客⼾资料），所⽤知识经验属⼀般技能。 B 错：在职期间可以为创业作准备，只要⽤⾃⼰的时间 且不滥⽤公司财产。 C 错（当时错选此项）：任职期间获得的⼀般技能与经验不属于机密或特权信息；同理， 知晓前客⼾的姓名与存在通常也不属 IV(A) 下的机密信息。
method: 业余时间筹备创业合规；技能经验可带⾛，专有资料 / 客⼾名单不可带⾛。
header: S IV(A) 忠诚 · 在职筹备创业 当时做错 · 错选 C
required_actions: 不得剥夺雇主技能优势；避免利益冲突

scenario_en: Marc Davidson, CF A, works as a trust specialist for Integrity Financial. On his own time, Davidson starts a part time consulting business providing advice to Trustees for a fee. Since this is only part time work, he doesn't inform Integrity of the consulting business. Davidson asks his assistant to compile a list of Integrity's clients and their contact information. The following month, Davidson is of fered a similar role at Integrity's lar gest competitor , Legacy Trust Services, Inc. After he begins working at Legacy , his new manager arranges for him to meet with a number of prospective clients , many of whom are clients of Integrity . After meeting with Davidson, a number of former Integrity clients decide to transfer their business to Legacy . Did Davidson's action violate the Code and Standards?
scenario_cn: Marc Davidson, CFA 是 Integrity Financial 的信托专 家。他利⽤业余时间开办收费兼职咨询业务，为受 托⼈提供咨询；因只是兼职，他未告知 Integrity 。他 还让助⼿整理 Integrity 客⼾名单及联系⽅式。次⽉， 他获得 Integrity 最⼤竞争对⼿ Legacy 的同类职位。 ⼊职后，新经理安排他⻅多位潜在客⼾（多为 Integrity 客⼾），会⾯后⼀些原 Integrity 客⼾把业务 转到 Legacy 。 Davidson 的⾏为是否违反准则与标 准？

options.A: No 未违反。
options.B: Yes, Davidson's part time consulting business is a violation of the Standards是，其兼职咨询业务违反标准。
options.C: Yes, both Davidson's part time consulting business and his meetings with Integrity clients are a violation of the Standards是，兼职咨询业务和与 Integrity 客⼾的会⾯均违 反标准。

explanation: 正确答案 B 。会员和考⽣必须向雇主披露任何涉及提供雇主本可收费之服务的报酬安排，即使在⾮⼯作 时间进⾏也须披露 —— 兼职咨询未披露即违反 IV(A) 。 A 错； C 错：被竞争对⼿聘⽤本⾝不违反 IV(A) ，且会 ⾯由新雇主安排， Davidson 并未利⽤ Integrity 的机密信息招揽前客⼾（尽管他在职时曾让助⼿整理客⼾名 单）。（当时未作答）
method: 与雇主业务同类的收费兼职必须披露，⽆论是否在业余时间。
header: S IV(A) 忠诚 · 兼职咨询未披露 当时未作答
required_actions: 不得剥夺雇主技能优势；避免利益冲突

scenario_en: Heidi Katz is a CFA candidate and an analyst at a pension consulting firm. Her father is a major shareholder and managing director at Saturn Partners, a lar ge hedge fund. When assisting in an alternative manager search for a pension client, Katz plans to recommend Saturn's market-neutral strategy because she feels it meets all of the pension plan's criteria. Given this situation, the best course of action for Katz is to:
scenario_cn: Heidi Katz 是 CFA 考⽣、⼀家养⽼⾦咨询公司的分析 师。其⽗是⼤型对冲基⾦ Saturn Partners 的主要股东 兼董事总经理。在为养⽼⾦客⼾筛选另类管理⼈ 时， Katz 认为 Saturn 的市场中性策略完全符合该养 ⽼⾦计划的标准，打算推荐它。此时 Katz 的最佳做 法是：

options.A: not present this strategy to the client and recommend another strategy .不向客⼾介绍该策略，改推其他策略。
options.B: disclose the potential conflict to the pension client when discussing this recommendation.在讨论该建议时向养⽼⾦客⼾披露这⼀潜在冲 突。
options.C: disclose the potential conflict to her employer and follow their guidance regarding disclosure of her relationship to the client.向雇主披露潜在冲突，并就是否向客⼾披露其关 系听从雇主指⽰。

explanation: 正确答案 B 。 Standard VI(A) 要求披露利益冲突，但并不禁⽌会员在适当披露潜在冲突的前提下作出建议 ——若她确信 Saturn 策略最佳可以推荐。 A 错； C 错：即使雇主指⽰不披露，她在向客⼾或潜在客⼾作建议 时仍必须披露任何可能合理影响其客观性的因素。（当时未作答）
method: 冲突披露对象是客⼾本⼈；披露义务不能被雇主指⽰免除。
header: S VI(A) 利益冲突 · 推荐⽗亲基⾦ 当时未作答
required_actions: 充分披露影响独立性的利益冲突

scenario_en: James Woods, CF A, is a Portfolio Manager at ABC Securities. Woods has reasonable grounds to believe his colleague, Sandra Clarke, a CF A Level II Candidate, is engaged in unethical trading activities that may also be in violation of local securities laws. Woods is not Clarke's supervisor , and her activities do not impact Woods or any of the portfolios for which he is responsible. Based on the Code and Standards, the recommended course of action is for Woods to:
scenario_cn: James Woods, CFA 是 ABC 证券的组合经理。他有合 理理由认为同事 Sandra Clarke （ CFA ⼆级考⽣）正从 事不道德交易活动，且可能违反当地证券法。 Woods 不是 Clarke 的上司，其⾏为也不影响 Woods 及其管 理的组合。依据准则与标准，建议 Woods 采取的做 法是：

options.A: not take any action because he is not directly involved. 不采取任何⾏动，因为他未直接牵涉其中。
options.B: report Sandra Clarke to ABC's trading supervisor or compliance department.向 ABC 的交易主管或合规部⻔报告 Sandra Clarke 的⾏为。
options.C: report Sandra Clarke to the appropriate governmental or regulatory or ganization.向相应的政府或监管机构举报 Sandra Clarke 。

explanation: 正确答案 B 。依据 Standard I(A) ：当会员或考⽣察觉雇主 / 同事从事不道德或⾮法活动时，建议通过报告 主管或公司合规部⻔来制⽌该⾏为。 A 错： Woods 有报告义务。 C 错：准则与标准并不强制向政府或监管机构 报告，除⾮法律有此要求。（当时未作答）
method: 发现同事违规：先内部报告（主管 / 合规部）；对外监管举报⾮强制。
header: S I(A) 知法守法 · 举报同事违规 当时未作答
required_actions: 遵守适用法律法规；向监管者报告违法行为

scenario_en: Madeline Smith, CF A, was recently promoted to senior portfolio manager . In her new position, Smith is required to supervise three portfolio managers. Smith asks for a copy of her firm's written supervisory policies and procedures, but is advised that no such policies are required by regulatory standards in the country where Smith works. According to the Standards of Practice Handbook, Smith's most appropriate course of action would be to:
scenario_cn: Madeline Smith, CFA 最近升任⾼级组合经理，新岗位 需督导三名组合经理。她向公司索要与监督有关的 书⾯政策与程序，却被告知所在国家的监管标准并 不要求此类制度。依据《执业标准⼿册》， Smith 最 恰当的做法是：

options.A: require her firm to adopt the CF A Institute Code of Ethics and Standards of Professional Conduct .要求公司采纳 CFA 协会道德准则与职业⾏为标 准。
options.B: require the employees she supervises to adopt the CF A Institute Code of Ethics and Standards of Professional Conduct .要求她所督导的员⼯采纳 CFA 协会道德准则与 职业⾏为标准。
options.C: decline to accept supervisory responsibility until her firm adopts procedures to allow her to adequately exercise such responsibility .在公司出台⾜以让其履⾏督导职责的程序之前， 书⾯拒绝接受督导职责。

explanation: 正确答案 C 。依据 Standard IV(C) Responsibilities of Supervisors ：若因缺乏合规制度或合规制度不健全⽽ ⽆法履⾏督导职责，会员应书⾯拒绝接受督导责任，直⾄公司采纳使其能充分履职的合理程序。 A 、 B 错：仅 要求公司或下属采纳准则并不能提供⼀套完整的合规体系，主管仍⽆法充分履⾏督导职责。（当时未作答）
method: 没有合规制度就不能当主管：书⾯拒绝，直到制度到位。
header: S IV(C) 主管责任 · ⽆合规制度 当时未作答
required_actions: 建立合规程序；监督下属行为

scenario_en: Jiro Sato, CF A, deputy treasurer for May College, manages the Student Scholarship Trust. Sato issued a Request for Proposal (RFP) for domestic equity managers. Pamela Peters, CFA, a good friend of Sato, introduces him to representatives from Capital Investments, who submitted a proposal. Sato selected Capital as a manager based on the firm’ s excellent performance record. Shortly after the selection, Peters, who had outstanding performance as an equity manager with another firm, accepted a lucrative job with Capital. Which of the CF A charterholders violated the CF A Institute Standards of Professional Conduct ?
scenario_cn: Jiro Sato（ CFA ）是 May 学院副财务⻓，管理学⽣奖 学⾦信托。 Sato 就国内股票管理⼈发出征求建议书 （RFP），其好友 Pamela Peters （ CFA ）介绍他认识提 交⽅案的 Capital Investments 代表。 Sato 基于该公司 优异的业绩记录选中 Capital 。遴选后不久，在另⼀ 家公司业绩出⾊的 Peters 接受了 Capital 的⼀份⾼薪 职位。哪位 CFA 持证⼈违反了职业⾏为标准？

options.A: Both violated Standards 两⼈都违反了准则
options.B: Peters violated Standards Peters 违反了准则
options.C: Neither violated Standards 两⼈都未违反准则

explanation: （当时未作答） Standard I(B) Independence and Objectivity 要求会员以合理谨慎和判断保持独⽴与客观。 本案没有证据表明存在不当⾏为： Sato 选择 Capital 是基于其优异业绩记录， Peters 接受职位也是基于其⾃⾝ 出⾊业绩，两项决定均与私⼈友谊⽆关，不构成利益冲突。
method: 独⽴客观性题：看决定是否基于客观业绩与合理判断；仅凭「朋友介绍」不⾜以认定违规。
header: 准则应⽤ · 独⽴客观性 I(B) 当时未作答
required_actions: 拒绝可能损害独立客观性的礼品、招待或好处

scenario_en: When Jef ferson Piedmont, CF A, joined Branch Investing, Branch began using a quantitative stock selection model Piedmont had developed on his own personal time prior to his employment with Branch. One year later when Piedmont left the firm, he found the original copy of the model he had developed in a file at his home and presented it to his new employer , who immediately began using the model. According to the Standards of Practice Handbook, did Piedmont most likely violate any CF A Institute Standards of Professional Conduct ?
scenario_cn: Jefferson Piedmont （ CFA ）加⼊ Branch Investing 时， 公司开始使⽤他在⼊职前利⽤个⼈时间开发的量化 选股模型。⼀年后 Piedmont 离职，在家中的⽂件⾥ 找到该模型的原始副本，并交给新雇主⽴即使⽤。 根据《执业标准⼿册》， Piedmont 是否违反了 CFA 协 会职业⾏为标准？

options.A: No 否
options.B: Yes, because he misappropriated property now belonging to Branch是，因为他挪⽤了现在属于 Branch 的财产
options.C: Yes, because he failed to inform his new employer the model was the same one used by his previous employer是，因为他未告知新雇主该模型与前雇主所⽤模 型相同

explanation: （当时未作答） Standard IV(A) Loyalty 规定离职员⼯不得带⾛雇主财产，但该模型是 Piedmont ⼊职 Branch 之前个⼈开发的，并⾮在受雇期间为 Branch 创作，因此不属于 Branch 的财产（ Branch 只是采⽤了 它）。他将属于⾃⼰的模型交给新雇主不构成违规，也⽆义务告知新雇主前雇主使⽤过同⼀模型。
method: 知识产权题关键看「何时、为谁开发」 ：⼊职前个⼈时间的成果归个⼈，离职可带⾛。
header: 准则应⽤ · 对雇主忠诚 IV(A)/ 知识产权 当时未作答
required_actions: 不得剥夺雇主技能优势；避免利益冲突

scenario_en: Jeffrey Jones passed the Level I CF A exam in 1997 and the Level II exam in 2009. He is not currently enrolled for the Level III exam. According to the CF A Institute Standards of Professional Conduct , which of the following is the most appropriate way for Jones to refer to his participation in the CFA Program?
scenario_cn: Jeffrey Jones 于 1997 年通过 CFA ⼀级考试、 2009 年 通过⼆级考试，⽬前未报名三级考试。根据 CFA 协 会职业⾏为标准， Jones 最恰当的表述⽅式是以下哪 ⼀项？

options.A: Jeffrey Jones, CF A (expected 2014) Jeffrey Jones ， CFA （预计 2014 年获得）
options.B: Candidate in the CF A Institute CF A Program CFA 协会 CFA 课程考⽣
options.C: Passed Level II of the CF A examination in 2009 2009 年通过 CFA ⼆级考试

explanation: （当时未作答） Standard VII(B) ：通过某⼀级考试的⼈只能如实陈述已通过该级别，不存在「通过⼆级」 的专属称号；只有当前已报名 CFA 课程的⼈才能⾃称 Candidate ；在称谓中使⽤ “expected” （预计获得）属于不 当引⽤。
method: 称谓题三规则：如实陈述已过级别；在册才能称 Candidate ；不得写 expected 。
header: 准则应⽤ · CFA 称谓引⽤ VII(B) 当时未作答
required_actions: 按规范引用CFA协会会员资格与头衔

scenario_en: Reiko Kimisaki, CF A, is an investment advisor for a national social security fund in a frontier market with a very limited and illiquid capital market. The labor force is young with an investment time horizon of 25 to 30 years. She has been asked to suggest ways to increase the investment return of the overall portfolio. After careful assessment of the fund’ s previous investment history and available asset classes, she considers investment in private equity . What is Kimisaki’ s lowest priority to avoid any Code of Ethics and Standards of Professional Conduct violations prior to making this investment recommendation?
scenario_cn: Reiko Kimisaki （ CFA ）是⼀个前沿市场国家社保基 ⾦的投资顾问，该市场资本市场极其有限且缺乏流 动性，劳动⼒年轻，投资期限 25-30 年。她被要求就 提⾼组合整体收益提出建议。在仔细评估基⾦既往 投资历史和可投资资产类别后，她考虑投资私募股 权。在做出该投资建议前，为避免违反道德准则与 职业⾏为标准， Kimisaki 的最低优先事项是什么？

options.A: Assess the risk tolerance of the fund 评估基⾦的⻛险承受能⼒
options.B: Analyze the expected returns of private equity in the market 分析该市场私募股权的预期收益
options.C: Determine if the Investment Policy Statement allows for alternative investments确定投资政策声明（ IPS ）是否允许另类投资

explanation: （当时未作答） Standard III(C) Suitability ：在进⾏预期收益分析之前，顾问必须先确定该资产类别的适当 性——是否符合客⼾⻛险承受能⼒、是否为 IPS 允许的资产类别。只有这些前提确定之后，才应进⼊收益分 析以形成具体投资建议。因此「分析预期收益」是最后（最低优先）的步骤。 A 、 C 都是适当性评估的必要前 置⼯作。
method: 适当性顺序题：先⻛险承受⼒与 IPS 允许性，再分析收益；问 lowest priority 选最后才做的事。
header: 准则应⽤ · 适当性 III(C) 当时未作答
required_actions: 投资行动前了解客户需求、目标与风险承受能力

scenario_en: A central bank fines a commercial bank it supervises for not following statutory regulations regarding non-performing loan provisions on three lar ge loans as a result of the bank’ s loan provisioning policy . Louis Marie Buf fet, CF A, sits on the Board of Directors of the commercial bank as a non- executive director , representing minority shareholders. He also chairs the internal audit committee of the bank that determines the loan provisioning policy of the bank. Mercy Gatabaki, CF A, is the bank’ s external auditor and follows international auditing standards whereby she tests the loan portfolio by randomly selecting loans to check for compliance in all aspects of central bank regulations. Which charterholder is most likely in violation of the Code and Standards?
scenario_cn: 某央⾏因其监管的⼀家商业银⾏在三笔⼤额贷款上 未遵守不良贷款拨备的法定规定（源于该⾏贷款拨 备政策）⽽对该⾏罚款。 Louis Marie Buffet （ CFA ） 是该⾏代表少数股东的⾮执⾏董事，并担任决定贷 款拨备政策的内部审计委员会主席。 Mercy Gatabaki （CFA）是该⾏外部审计师，遵循国际审计准则，随 机抽取贷款检查其是否符合央⾏各项监管规定。哪 位持证⼈最可能违反了准则？

options.A: Both 两⼈都违反
options.B: Buffet Buffet
options.C: Gatabaki Gatabaki

explanation: （当时错选 C ） Buffet 担任决定拨备政策的审计委员会主席，该政策违反央⾏法定规定，他最可能违反 Standard I-Professionalism （ I(A) Knowledge of the Law ），未遵守监管机构的法规。 Gatabaki 按国际审计准则随 机抽样检查，违规贷款仅三笔、数量很⼩，她很可能未抽到相关档案，也没有证据表明她明知并协助了违规 政策，故不构成违规。错选 C 是混淆了「审计抽样未发现」与「明知参与违规」。
method: 区分「政策制定者」与「抽样检查者」 ：制定违规政策的⼈担责，合理抽样未发现不违规。
header: 准则应⽤ · 知法守法 I(A) 当时做错 · 错选 C
required_actions: 遵守适用法律法规；向监管者报告违法行为

scenario_en: Ileana Inkster , CFA, was recently of fered a senior management position within the trust department at a regional bank. The department is new , but the bank has plans to expand it significantly over the next few months. Inkster has been told she will be expected to help grow the client base of the trust department. She is informed that the trust department plans to conduct educational seminars and pursue the attendees as new clients. Inkster notices that recent seminar advertisements prepared by the bank’ s marketing department do not mention that investment products will be for sale at the seminar . The ads indicate attendees can “learn how to immediately add ＄ 100,000 to their net worth.” What should Inkster most likely do to avoid violating any CF A Institute Standards of Professional Conduct ?
scenario_cn: Ileana Inkster （ CFA ）获聘某地区银⾏信托部的⾼级 管理职位。该部⻔新设但计划数⽉内⼤幅扩张，她 被告知需帮助拓展客⼾，部⻔计划举办教育研讨会 并把参会者发展为新客⼾。 Inkster 注意到市场部制作 的研讨会⼴告未提及会上将销售投资产品，还宣称 参会者可以「学会如何⽴即让净资产增加 ＄100,000 」。为避免违反准则，她最应该怎么做？

options.A: Decline to accept the new position 拒绝接受该新职位
options.B: Accept the position and revise the marketing material 接受职位并修改营销材料
options.C: Accept the position and inform senior management of inadequate compliance procedures接受职位并告知⾼级管理层合规程序不⾜

explanation: （当时未作答） Standard IV(C) Responsibilities of Supervisors ：在合规程序不充分、营销材料不当的情况 下接受监督职位，会使 Inkster ⾯临违反准则的⻛险。她的第⼀步应是不接受该职位（可先以临时顾问⾝份协 助建⽴充分程序后再上任）。 B 、 C 都是先上任再补救，仍会使她在程序到位前承担违规⻛险。
method: 与 Q101 同⼀套路：程序不到位时，先拒绝上任，⽽不是先上任再整改。
header: 准则应⽤ · 监督职责 IV(C) 当时未作答
required_actions: 建立合规程序；监督下属行为

scenario_en: Margie Germainne, CF A, is a risk management consultant who has been asked by a small investment bank to recommend policies to prevent bank employees from front- running client orders. These clients generally invest in one or more of the bank’ s large cap equity unit trusts . To ensure compliance with the CF A Institute Standards of Professional Conduct , Germainne should least likely recommend which of the following? Employees should be restricted from trading:
scenario_cn: Margie Germainne （ CFA ）是⻛险管理顾问，受⼀家 ⼩型投资银⾏委托，就防⽌员⼯抢跑客⼾交易 （front-running ）提出政策建议；该⾏客⼾⼀般投资 于该⾏的⼤型股股票单位信托。为确保符合 CFA 协 会职业⾏为标准， Germainne 最不可能建议下列哪 项？应限制员⼯交易：

options.A: equity related securities. 股票相关证券。
options.B: without prior permission. 未经事先许可的交易。
options.C: during established time periods. 在规定时间段内的交易。

explanation: （当时未作答） Standard VI(B) Priority of Transactions 旨在防⽌个⼈交易的利益冲突或其表象，但并不禁 ⽌员⼯交易证券。全⾯禁⽌股票相关证券交易对员⼯过于严苛，若已有适当的个⼈交易政策与程序则⽆必 要。 B（事先批准 / 预审批 preclearance ）和 C （限制交易时段 restricted trading period ）都是推荐的合规做法。
method: least likely 题：推荐做法 = 预审批、限制时段；全⾯禁⽌某类资产交易属过度限制。
header: 准则应⽤ · 交易优先 VI(B) 当时未作答
required_actions: 客户交易优先于个人交易；禁止抢先交易

scenario_en: Richard Cardinal, CF A, is the founder of Volcano Capital Research, an investment management firm whose sole activity is short selling. Cardinal seeks out companies whose stocks have had lar ge price increases. Cardinal also pays several lobbying firms to update him immediately on any legislative or regulatory changes that may impact his tar get companies. Cardinal sells short those tar get companies he estimates are near the peak of their sales and earnings and that his sources identify as facing legal or regulatory challenges. Immediately after he sells a stock, Cardinal conducts a public relations campaign to disclose all of the negative information he has gathered on the company , even if the information is not yet public. Which of Cardinal’ s following actions is most likely to be in violation of the CF A Institute Standards of Professional Conduct ?
scenario_cn: Richard Cardinal （ CFA ）是 Volcano Capital Research 创始⼈，该公司唯⼀业务是卖空。他寻找股价⼤涨 的公司，付费请游说公司即时通报影响⽬标公司的 ⽴法或监管变化；对估计销售和盈利⻅顶且⾯临法 律/监管挑战的公司卖空；卖出后⽴即发起公关攻 势，披露其收集的全部负⾯信息，即使信息尚未公 开。 Cardinal 的哪项⾏为最可能违反准则？

options.A: Selling stock short 卖空股票
options.B: Trading on information from lobbyists 依据游说公司提供的信息交易
options.C: Disclosing information about tar get companies 披露⽬标公司的信息

explanation: Cardinal 的公关宣传活动是蓄意压低股价、为⾃⼰谋利，属于故意制造⼈为价格波动以对发⾏⼈股价产 ⽣重⼤影响，违反 Standard II(B) Market Manipulation 。 A 卖空本⾝是⼀种投资策略，不必然违规； B 信息收集 是投资分析的组成部分，其做法体现 Standard V(A) 要求的勤勉尽责，不必然违规。
method: 操纵题看「意图与效果」 ：以影响价格为⽬的散布信息制造⼈为波动 = II(B) 。
header: 准则应⽤ · 市场操纵 II(B) 当时做对
required_actions: 不得操纵市场价格或成交量
基于充分研究与合理依据提出建议

scenario_en: Oliver Opdyke, CF A, works for an independent research organization that does not manage any client money . In the course of his analysis of Red Ribbon Mining he hears rumors that the president of Red Ribbon, Richard Leisber g, has recently been diagnosed with late stage Alzheimer ’s disease, a fact not publicly known. The final stage of Alzheimer ’s is when individuals lose the ability to respond to their environment, the ability to speak, and, ultimately , the ability to control movement. Leisber g is the charismatic founder of Red Ribbon, and under his leadership the company grew to become one of the lar gest in the industry . According to the CFA Institute Code of Ethics and Standards of Professional Conduct , the most appropriate action for Opdyke is to:
scenario_cn: Oliver Opdyke （ CFA ）在⼀家不管理客⼾资⾦的独⽴ 研究机构⼯作。分析 Red Ribbon Mining 时，他听到 传闻：该公司总裁、魅⼒型创始⼈ Richard Leisberg 最近被诊断出晚期阿尔茨海默病，此事未公开。在 Leisberg 领导下公司成⻓为业内最⼤公司之⼀。根据 准则， Opdyke 最恰当的做法是：

options.A: immediately publish a sell recommendation for Red Ribbon Mining.⽴即发布 Red Ribbon Mining 的卖出建议。
options.B: confirm the president’ s diagnosis before publishing his research report.在发布研究报告前确认总裁的病情诊断。
options.C: encourage Red Ribbon Mining management to disclose the president’ s medical condition.敦促 Red Ribbon Mining 管理层披露总裁的病 情。

explanation: （当时未作答） Standard II(A) Material Nonpublic Information ：会员应尽合理努⼒促使重⼤⾮公开信息被 公开传播，通常做法是敦促发⾏⼈公开信息。该诊断若属实则属重⼤信息，应当披露。 A ⽴即发布卖出建 议、 B 先核实再发布报告，都是在利⽤重⼤⾮公开信息，均违反 II(A) （且 B 还可能诱导内部⼈私下披露）。
method: 得知重⼤⾮公开信息的标准动作：敦促公司公开披露，⽽不是抢先交易或发布建议。
header: 准则应⽤ · 重⼤⾮公开信息 II(A) 当时未作答
required_actions: 不得利用或促使他人利用重大非公开信息

scenario_en: Christina Ng, a Level I CFA candidate , defaulted on a bank loan she obtained to pay for her Master ’s degree tuition when her wedding cost more than expected. A micro finance loan company lent her money to pay of f the tuition loan in full including penalties and interest. The micro finance loan company even extended further credit to pay for her parent’ s outstanding medical bills. Unfortunately , her parent’ s health problems escalated to the point where Ng had to take extensive time away from work to deal with the issues. She was subsequently fired and consequently defaulted on the second loan. As she was no longer employed, Ng decided to file for personal bankruptcy . Do the loan defaults leading up to Ng’ s bankruptcy most likely violate Standard I(D)- Misconduct ?
scenario_cn: CFA ⼀级考⽣ Christina Ng 因婚礼超⽀⽽未能偿还⽀ 付硕⼠学费的银⾏贷款。⼀家⼩额贷款公司借钱给 她全额结清学费贷款（含罚息），还追加信贷⽀付她 ⽗⺟的医疗账单。不幸的是，⽗⺟病情恶化， Ng 不 得不⻓期请假，随后被解雇，因⽽第⼆笔贷款也违 约。失业后 Ng 申请个⼈破产。导致破产的贷款违约 是否最可能违反 Standard I(D)-Misconduct ？

options.A: No. 否。
options.B: Yes, with regard to the first loan default. 是，针对第⼀笔贷款违约。
options.C: Yes, with regard to the second loan default. 是，针对第⼆笔贷款违约。

explanation: （当时未作答）虽然第⼀笔违约（把钱花在婚礼⽽⾮学费贷款）反映了不良的财务选择，但两笔违约及 破产均不涉及欺诈或欺骗性的商业⾏为，⽽是源于不幸的个⼈境遇。 Standard I(D) 针对的是欺诈、欺骗等损害 职业诚信的⾏为，个⼈财务困境导致的违约不构成违反。
method: I(D) 关键看是否有欺诈 / 欺骗；单纯的个⼈财务困境或破产不等于不当⾏为。
header: 准则应⽤ · 不当⾏为 I(D) 当时未作答
required_actions: 不得从事欺诈、欺骗等有损职业声誉的行为

scenario_en: Henrietta Huerta, CF A, writes a weekly investment newsletter to market her services and obtain new asset management clients. A third party distributes the free newsletter on her behalf to those individuals on its mailing list. As a result, it is widely read by thousands of individual investors. The newsletter recommendations reflect most of Huerta’ s investment actions. After completing further research on East-W est Cof fee Roasters, Huerta decides to change her initial buy recommendation to a sell. To avoid violating the CFA Institute Standards of Professional Conduct it would be most appropriate for Huerta to distribute the new investment recommendation to:
scenario_cn: Henrietta Huerta （ CFA ）撰写每周投资通讯以营销服 务并获取新的资产管理客⼾，第三⽅按邮件列表免 费代发，读者数千⼈。通讯中的建议基本反映她的 投资操作。完成对 East-West Coffee Roasters 的进⼀步 研究后，她决定将原来的买⼊建议改为卖出。为避 免违反准则，她最应把新建议⾸先发送给：

options.A: newsletter recipients first. 先发给通讯读者。
options.B: asset management clients first. 先发给资产管理客⼾。
options.C: newsletter recipients and asset management clients simultaneously .同时发给通讯读者和资产管理客⼾。

explanation: （当时未作答） Standard III(A) Loyalty, Prudence, and Care 要求会员把客⼾利益置于⾃⾝利益之前。变更 投资建议时必须优先于⾮客⼾（免费通讯读者）通知资产管理客⼾；为拉新客⼾⽽与读者同时甚⾄提前发 布，都会违反 III(A) 。
method: 建议变更题：客⼾优先于⾮客⼾读者，哪怕同时发布也不⾏。
header: 准则应⽤ · 忠诚审慎 III(A) 当时未作答
required_actions: 以客户利益为先；审慎管理客户资产

scenario_en: Danielle Deschutes, CF A, is a portfolio manager who is part of a 10-person team that manages equity portfolios for institutional clients. A competing firm, South West Managers, asks Deschutes to interview for a position within its firm and to bring her performance history to the interview . Deschutes receives written permission from her current employer to bring the performance history of the stock portfolio with her . At the interview , she discloses that the performance numbers represent the work of her team and describes the role of each member . To bolster her credibility , Deschutes also provides the names of institutional clients and related assets constituting the portfolio. During her interview Deschutes most likely violated the CF A Institute Standards of Professional Conduct with regards to:
scenario_cn: Danielle Deschutes （ CFA ）是⼀个 10 ⼈团队的组合经 理，为机构客⼾管理股票组合。竞争对⼿ South West Managers 邀她⾯试并要求携带业绩记录。她获得现 雇主书⾯许可携带股票组合的业绩记录。⾯试中她 说明业绩是团队成果并描述了每位成员的⻆⾊。为 增强可信度，她还提供了机构客⼾的名称及构成组 合的相关资产。⾯试中她最可能在哪⽅⾯违反了准 则？

options.A: the stock portfolio’ s performance history . 该股票组合的业绩记录。
options.B: her contribution to the portfolio’ s returns. 她对组合收益的贡献。
options.C: providing details of the institutional clients. 提供机构客⼾的详细信息。

explanation: （当时未作答）她披露组合中机构客⼾的具体名称与资产细节，违反 Standard III(E) Preservation of Confidentiality （未能对客⼾记录保密）。 A 不违规： Standard III(D) 允许展⽰在前雇主取得的业绩，只要同时披 露业绩取得地点及其本⼈具体⻆⾊（她已做到并获书⾯许可）。 B 不违规：她如实说明业绩是团队成果，未夸 ⼤个⼈贡献。
method: ⾯试带业绩可，但客⼾名称与资产明细属保密信息，任何场合不得外泄。
header: 准则应⽤ · 保密 III(E)/ 业绩陈述 III(D) 当时未作答
required_actions: 对客户及前雇主信息保密
确保业绩陈述公平、准确、完整

scenario_en: When Abdullah Younis, CF A, was hired as a portfolio manager at an asset management firm two years ago and was told he could allocate his work hours as he saw fit. At that time, Younis served on the board of three nonpublic golf equipment companies and managed a pooled investment fund for several members of his immediate family . Younis was not compensated for his board service or for managing the pooled fund. Younis’ investment returns attract interest from friends and co-workers who persuade him to include their assets in his investment pool. Younis recently retired from all board responsibilities and now spends more than 80% of his time managing the investment pool for which he char ges non- family members a management fee. Younis has never told his employer about any of these activities. To comply with the CFA Institute Standards of Professional Conduct with regards to his business activities over the past two years, Younis would least likely be required to disclose which of the following to his employer?
scenario_cn: Abdullah Younis （ CFA ）两年前受聘为资产管理公司 组合经理，被告知可⾃由安排⼯作时间。当时他在 三家⾮上市⾼尔夫设备公司任董事，并为⼏位直系 亲属管理⼀个集合投资基⾦（均⽆报酬）。其投资回 报引起朋友和同事兴趣，说服他把他们的资产也纳 ⼊池⼦。 Younis 最近辞去全部董事职务，如今 80% 以上时间⽤于管理该投资池，并向⾮家庭成员收取 管理费。他从未向雇主提及这些活动。就过去两年 的业务活动，他最不需要向雇主披露下列哪项？

options.A: Board activities 董事任职活动
options.B: Family investment pool management 家庭投资池管理
options.C: Non-family member management fees ⾮家庭成员管理费

explanation: （当时错选 C ）⾼尔夫设备属独⽴于⾦融服务的⾏业，其董事任职不太可能与雇主利益产⽣冲突，按 Standard IV(B) Additional Compensation Arrangements ⽆需因该任职向雇主取得许可 / 披露。⽽管理家庭及⾮家庭 资产并收费、占⽤ 80% 时间、与雇主构成潜在竞争，按 Standard VI(A) 必须做充分公允披露，且本应在⼊职 时即披露。错选 C 是忽视了收费代客理财明显构成利益冲突。
method: 判断披露义务看是否与雇主 / 客⼾利益冲突：跨⾏业⽆报酬董事⽆需披露，收费代客投资必须披露。
header: 准则应⽤ · 冲突披露 VI(A)/ 额外报酬 IV(B) 当时做错 · 错选 C
required_actions: 充分披露影响独立性的利益冲突
向雇主书面披露并取得所有相关方书面同意

scenario_en: Sheila Schleif, CF A, is an equity analyst at an investment banking division of Mokara Financial Group, a full service financial group. Schleif uses a multi-factor computer model to make stock recommendations for all clients of Mokara. Schleif discovers that the model contains an error . If the error were corrected, her most recent buy recommendation communicated to all clients would change to a sell. Schleif corrects the error , changing the buy to a sell recommendation, and then simultaneously distributes via e-mail the revision to all investment banking clients who received the initial recommendation. A week later , Schleif sells the same shares she held in her personal portfolio. Concerning her actions, Schleif most likely violated which of the following CF A Institute Standards of Professional Conduct ?
scenario_cn: Sheila Schleif （ CFA ）是全⽅位⾦融集团 Mokara 投⾏ 部的股票分析师，⽤多因⼦模型为集团所有客⼾做 股票推荐。她发现模型存在错误：若更正，最近发 给所有客⼾的买⼊建议将变为卖出。她更正错误 后，仅通过电⼦邮件把修订后的建议同时发送给收 到原建议的投⾏部客⼾。⼀周后，她卖出个⼈组合 中同样的股票。她最可能违反了哪条准则？

options.A: Fair Dealing 公平对待
options.B: Priority of Transactions 交易优先
options.C: Diligence and Reasonable Basis 勤勉与合理依据

explanation: （当时未作答）她负责为集团所有客⼾提供建议，却只把变更后的建议发给投⾏部客⼾，违反 Standard III(B) Fair Dealing—— 应发给所有收到原建议的客⼾。 B 不违规：她在建议分发⼀周后才交易个⼈账⼾，未违 反 VI(B)。 C 不违规：更正编码错误后她有变更建议的合理依据（ V(A) ）。
method: 建议传播范围题：变更建议必须送达所有收到原建议的客⼾，不能只发本部⻔。
header: 准则应⽤ · 公平对待 III(B) 当时未作答
required_actions: 公平客观对待所有客户
客户交易优先于个人交易；禁止抢先交易
基于充分研究与合理依据提出建议

scenario_en: Rodney Rodrigues, CF A, is responsible for identifying professionals to manage specific asset classes for his firm. In selecting external advisers or subadvisers, Rodrigues reviews the adviser ’s investment process, established code of ethics , the quality of the published return information, and the compliance and integrated control framework of the organization. In completing his review , Rodrigues most likely violated the CF A Institute Standards of Professional Conduct with regards to his due diligence on:
scenario_cn: Rodney Rodrigues （ CFA ）负责为公司挑选管理特定 资产类别的专业⼈⼠。选择外部顾问或次级顾问 时，他审查顾问的投资流程、既定道德准则、已公 布业绩信息的质量、以及合规与整合控制框架。在 审查中，他在哪⽅⾯的尽职调查最可能违反了准 则？

options.A: adherence to strategy . 对既定策略的遵循情况。
options.B: performance measures. 业绩衡量。
options.C: internal control procedures. 内部控制程序。

explanation: （当时未作答） Standard V(A) Diligence and Reasonable Basis 适⽤于选择外部顾问 / 次级顾问时的审查深 度，最低限度应包括审查顾问是否遵循其声明的投资策略。 Rodrigues 审查了业绩信息质量（ B ）和合规 / 控制 框架（ C），却遗漏了对策略遵循情况的审查，故在这⽅⾯未尽职。
method: 外部顾问尽调清单：投资流程、道德准则、业绩质量、内控，还要核对「是否按宣称策略⾏事」 。
header: 准则应⽤ · 勤勉与合理依据 V(A) 当时未作答
required_actions: 基于充分研究与合理依据提出建议

scenario_en: Jackson Barnes, CF A, works for an insurance company providing financial planning services to clients for a fee. Barnes has developed a network of specialists, including accountants, lawyers, and brokers, who contribute their expertise to the financial planning process. Each of the specialists is an independent contractor . Each contractor bills Barnes separately for the work he or she performs, providing a discount based upon the number of clients Barnes has referred. What steps should Barnes take to be consistent with the CF A Institute Standards of Professional Conduct ?
scenario_cn: Jackson Barnes （ CFA ）在保险公司收费为客⼾提供财 务规划服务，建⽴了由会计师、律师、经纪⼈等独 ⽴承包⼈组成的专家⽹络。每位承包⼈单独向 Barnes 开账单，并根据 Barnes 介绍的客⼾数量给予折扣。 为符合准则， Barnes 应采取什么措施？

options.A: Have his independent contractors approved by the insurance company让其独⽴承包⼈获得保险公司批准
options.B: List the consideration he receives from the specialists on monthly client invoices在每⽉客⼾账单上列明他从专家处获得的利益
options.C: Inform potential clients about his arrangement with the contractors before they agree to hire him在潜在客⼾同意聘⽤他之前，告知其与承包⼈的 安排

explanation: （当时未作答） Standard VI(C) Referral Fees 要求向客⼾披露介绍安排，且应在「签订任何正式服务协议 之前」披露，使潜在客⼾能判断该安排是否带来潜在损害（如更⾼费⽤、利益冲突）。 A 不是准则要求； B 在 事后账单上披露为时已晚。
method: 介绍费题记住时机： 「签约前」披露，事后在账单上披露不合格。
header: 准则应⽤ · 介绍费 VI(C) 当时未作答
required_actions: 披露并取得相关方同意后收取介绍费

scenario_en: Linda Chin, CF A, is a member of a political group advocating lower governmental regulation in all aspects of life. She works in a country where local securities laws are minimal and insider trading is not prohibited. Chin’ s politics are reflected in her investment strategy where she follows her country’ s mandatory legal and regulatory requirements. Which of the following actions by Chin is most consistent with the CF A Institute Standards of Professional Conduct ?
scenario_cn: Linda Chin （ CFA ）是⼀个主张全⾯减少政府监管的 政治团体成员。她所在国家证券法规极少，内幕交 易不被禁⽌。她的政治观点反映在其投资策略中 —— 仅遵守本国强制性法律法规。下列哪项⾏为最符合 CFA 协会职业⾏为标准？

options.A: Follow the CF A Code and Standards 遵循 CFA 道德准则与职业⾏为标准
options.B: Disclose her political advocacy to clients 向客⼾披露其政治主张
options.C: Continue her current investment strategy 继续其当前投资策略

explanation: （当时未作答） Standard I(A) Knowledge of the Law 要求会员遵守更严格的法律、规则或规定，即遵循最 ⾼要求 —— 本案中为 CFA 准则。 Standard II(A) 亦适⽤：掌握可能影响投资价值的重⼤⾮公开信息不得据此⾏ 动。披露⾃⼰满⾜当地较低法律要求并不能免除遵守 CFA 准则的义务；其政治主张不构成利益冲突，也⽆需 披露。
method: 从严原则题：准则严于当地法律时，⼀律按更严格的 CFA 准则⾏事。
header: 准则应⽤ · 知法守法 I(A) 当时未作答
required_actions: 遵守适用法律法规；向监管者报告违法行为
不得利用或促使他人利用重大非公开信息

scenario_en: Wouter Duyck, CF A, is the sole proprietor of an investment advisory firm serving several hundred middle class retail clients. Duyck claims to be dif ferent from his competitors because he conducts research himself. He discloses that to simplify the management of all these accounts he has created a recommended list of stocks, from which he selects investments for all of his clients based on their suitability . Duyck’ s recommended list of stocks is obtained from his primary broker , who has completed due diligence on each stock. Duyck’ s recommended list least likely violates which of the following CF A Institute Standards of Professional Conduct ?
scenario_cn: Wouter Duyck （ CFA ）是⼀家服务数百名中产零售客 ⼾的投资咨询公司独资所有⼈。他宣称与竞争对⼿ 不同之处在于⾃⼰亲⾃做研究。他披露为简化账⼾ 管理建⽴了⼀份推荐股票清单，按适当性为所有客 ⼾从中选股。但该清单实际来⾃其主要经纪商（经 纪商已对每只股票完成尽调）。 Duyck 的推荐清单最 不可能违反下列哪条准则？

options.A: Fair Dealing 公平对待
options.B: Misrepresentation 虚假陈述
options.C: Diligence and Reasonable Basis 勤勉与合理依据

explanation: （当时未作答） A 正确： Standard III(B) Fair Dealing 关注投资建议与操作中的公平对待， Duyck 让所有客 ⼾在同⼀股票池中投资，没有证据表明歧视任何客⼾。 B 他违反了 I(C) ：研究并⾮独⽴完成却宣称⾃⼰亲⾃ 研究，构成虚假陈述； C 他违反了 V(A) ：未对第三⽅研究的可靠性做勤勉核实。
method: least likely 题先找「实锤违规」 ：宣称亲⾃研究却照搬券商清单 = I(C)+V(A) ，未歧视客⼾则 III(B) 不违 反。
header: 准则应⽤ · 虚假陈述 I(C)/ 勤勉 V(A) 当时未作答
required_actions: 不得作出虚假陈述或遗漏重大事实；纠正错误信息
基于充分研究与合理依据提出建议
公平客观对待所有客户

scenario_en: What is the theory that best describes the process by which financial analysts combine material public information and nonmaterial nonpublic information as a basis for investment recommendations even if those conclusions would have been material inside information had they been communicated directly to the analyst by the company?
scenario_cn: 哪⼀理论最能描述如下过程：⾦融分析师将重⼤公 开信息与⾮重⼤⾮公开信息相结合作为投资建议的 依据，即使这些结论若由公司直接告知分析师将构 成重⼤内幕信息？

options.A: Mosaic theory ⻢赛克理论
options.B: Economic theory 经济理论
options.C: Probability theory 概率论

explanation: （当时未作答）这正是⻢赛克理论（ Mosaic Theory ）的定义：分析师可组合重⼤公开信息与⾮重⼤⾮公 开信息得出结论，不违反 Standard II(A) 。 B 经济理论是泛指⾦融经济关系的术语，与⾮公开信息⽆关； C 概 率论是统计概念，与⾮公开信息⽆关。
method: 定义题：公开重⼤信息＋⾮公开⾮重⼤信息的拼图分析 = Mosaic Theory ，合法合规。
header: 概念题 · ⻢赛克理论 II(A) 当时未作答
required_actions: 不得利用或促使他人利用重大非公开信息

scenario_en: Atlantic Capital Management has access to a limited number of shares in a popular new issue expected to be oversubscribed. Atlantic’ s portfolio managers have determined the issue to be a prudent addition within Atlantic’ s developing growth equity strategy . A number of the firm’ s investment professionals have family-member accounts that are managed to the developing growth strategy . Which of the following allocation options most likely adheres to the Code and Standards? Atlantic should allocate the shares:
scenario_cn: Atlantic Capital Management 获得⼀只预计超额认购的 热⻔新股的有限份额。公司组合经理认定该股适合 纳⼊公司的成⻓型股票策略。公司多名投资专业⼈ ⼠有按该成⻓策略管理的家庭成员账⼾。哪种分配 ⽅案最符合准则？ Atlantic 应把股份：

options.A: to family-member accounts only after non-family accounts have been allocated their shares.仅在⾮家庭账⼾获得分配后再分给家庭成员账 ⼾。
options.B: on a prorated basis across all developing growth accounts, including the family-member accounts.在所有成⻓策略账⼾（含家庭成员账⼾）间按⽐ 例分配。
options.C: on a prorated basis across all developing growth accounts, excluding the family-member accounts.在所有成⻓策略账⼾间按⽐例分配，但排除家庭 成员账⼾。

explanation: （当时未作答） Standard III(B) ：若投资专业⼈⼠的家庭成员账⼾与公司其他客⼾按相同策略管理，则其 与其他客⼾账⼾同等对待，不应被排除在配售之外 —— 虽有亲属关系，仍是客⼾。 A 、 C 都对家庭账⼾差别对 待，违反公平对待原则。
method: 热⻔新股分配题：家庭成员账⼾ = 客⼾账⼾，同策略同⽐例配售。
header: 准则应⽤ · 公平对待 III(B)/ 家庭账⼾ 当时未作答
required_actions: 公平客观对待所有客户

scenario_en: Alexandra Zagoreos, CF A, is the head of a government pension plan. Whenever Zagoreos hires a money management firm to work with the pension plan, she finalizes the deal over dinner at a nice restaurant. At these meals, Zagoreos also arranges for the money manager to provide her payments equal to 10% of the management fee the manager receives from the pension plan with no formal documentation of this agreement. Zagoreos keeps half of the payments for her own use and distributes the remainder as cash incentives to a handful of her most trusted staf f. Zagoreos least likely violated which of the following CF A Institute Code of Ethics and Standards of Professional Conduct ?
scenario_cn: Alexandra Zagoreos （ CFA ）是⼀家政府养⽼⾦计划负 责⼈。每次聘⽤资⾦管理公司，她都在⾼档餐厅敲 定交易，并安排管理⼈把其从养⽼⾦收到的管理费 的 10% 私下⽀付给她，且⽆任何书⾯⽂件。 Zagoreos 把⼀半据为⼰有，其余作为现⾦奖励分发给少数亲 信员⼯。她最不可能违反下列哪条准则？

options.A: Referral fees 介绍费
options.B: Loyalty , Prudence and Care 忠诚、审慎与尽责
options.C: Additional Compensation Arrangements 额外报酬安排

explanation: （当时未作答；本题在截图中重复出现⼀次，只录⼀次）她未经所有相关⽅书⾯同意即收受与雇主利益 冲突的报酬，违反 Standard IV(B) Additional Compensation Arrangements ；为私利⾏事、把个⼈利益置于客⼾之 前，违反 Standard III(A) Loyalty, Prudence, and Care 。但没有证据表明她因推荐产品或服务⽽从他⼈处收受或向 他⼈⽀付对价，故未违反 Standard VI(C) Referral Fees 。
method: least likely 题：私下抽成 = 额外报酬 + 背弃客⼾忠诚；不存在「推荐换对价」则 VI(C) 不适⽤。
header: 准则应⽤ · 额外报酬 IV(B)/ 介绍费 VI(C) 当时未作答
required_actions: 向雇主书面披露并取得所有相关方书面同意
披露并取得相关方同意后收取介绍费
以客户利益为先；审慎管理客户资产

scenario_en: Tammi Holmber g is enrolled to take the Level I CF A examination. While taking the CF A examination, the candidate on Holmber g’s immediate right takes a stretch break and a piece of paper from his pocket falls onto Holmber g’s desk. Holmber g glances at the paper and realizes there is information written on the paper , which includes a formula Holmber g needs for the question she is working on. Holmber g had not memorized this formula and could not complete the question without this information. Holmber g pushes the paper of f her desk and uses the formula to complete the question. According to the CF A Institute Code of Ethics and Standards of Professional Conduct , Holmber g most likely :
scenario_cn: Tammi Holmberg 报名参加了 CFA ⼀级考试。考试 中，她右边的考⽣伸展休息时，⼀张纸从其⼝袋掉 到 Holmberg 桌上。 Holmberg 瞥⻅纸上写着信息，其 中包含她正做的题⽬所需、但她没有记住的公式。 她把纸推下桌⼦，并⽤该公式完成了题⽬。根据准 则， Holmberg 最可能：

options.A: compromised her exam. 使其考试的有效性受到损害（违规） 。
options.B: was free to act on the information that fell on her desk. 可以⾃由利⽤掉到桌上的信息。
options.C: is responsible for notifying exam proctors of her neighbor ’s violation.有责任向监考⼈员报告邻座考⽣的违规。

explanation: （当时未作答） Holmberg 的⾏为损害了考试的有效性，违反 Standard VII(A) ，同时也违反 CFA 课程规 则、考⽣承诺（ Candidate pledge ）及 CFA 道德准则与标准。 B 错误：她不得使⽤该信息； C 错误：她有义务 报告⾃⼰的违规，但⽆义务报告其他考⽣的潜在违规（尽管 CFA 协会⿎励举报）。
method: 考场题：被动获得的信息也绝不能⽤；报告义务针对⾃⼰⽽⾮他⼈。
header: 准则应⽤ · 考试⾏为 VII(A) 当时未作答
required_actions: 遵守考试规则；不得泄露考题内容

scenario_en: Hezi Cohen, a CFA candidate , is a heavy user of social networking sites on the Internet. His favorite site only allows a limited number of characters for each entry so he has learned to abbreviate everything, including CF A trademarks. Cohen also enjoys professional networking sites and contributes regularly to blogs that discuss the broad topical areas covered within the CF A Program as well as formulas recently tested or not tested on the exam. In addition, he posts to these blogs pieces he has written in his area of expertise: retirement planning. By claiming to be an expert on retirement planning, he believes his stature within the investment community increases and he can gain more clients. Which internet activity can Cohen most likely continue to be in compliance with the CF A Standards of Professional Conduct ?
scenario_cn: Hezi Cohen 是⼀名 CFA 考⽣，是社交⽹络重度⽤ ⼾。他最爱的⽹站限制字数，因此他习惯把⼀切缩 写，包括 CFA 商标。他还活跃于职业社交⽹站，经 常在博客讨论 CFA 课程涵盖的宽泛考点及最近考过 / 没考过的公式。此外他在博客发表其专⻓领域 —— 退 休规划 —— 的⽂章，认为⾃称退休规划专家能提升业 内地位、获取更多客⼾。 Cohen 的哪项⽹络活动最可 以继续⽽不违反准则？

options.A: Use of abbreviations 使⽤缩写
options.B: Claiming retirement planning expertise 宣称退休规划专⻓
options.C: Blogging about broad topical areas and formulas tested or not tested on the CF A exam在博客讨论 CFA 考试的宽泛考点及考过 / 未考过 的公式

explanation: （当时错选 C ） Standard VII 并未禁⽌会员宣称⾃⼰专⻓的领域，只要不是虚假陈述或夸⼤技能即可继 续。 A 错： CFA 协会商标不允许缩写。 C 错： Standard VII 禁⽌披露 CFA 考试的所有⽅⾯，包括考点范围和考 过/未考过的公式 —— 考试⼀切内容在协会公开前均属保密，以维护考试的完整性与严谨性。错选 C 是误以为 「宽泛考点」不算机密。
method: 考试保密范围极宽：题⽬、考点范围、公式考没考过都不能谈；但⾃称某领域专家（⾮夸⼤）可以。
header: 准则应⽤ · VII 称谓与考试保密 当时做错 · 错选 C

scenario_en: PNW Bank publishes Investment Monthly magazine, which highlights a specific stock in each issue. Publication of the magazine invariably causes the highlighted stocks to rise significantly in value. Rachel Coursing, CF A, manager of PNW’ s marketing department, often trades in the securities mentioned in the Investment Monthly articles prior to publication of the magazine. Coursing has access to the recommendations prior to the magazine’ s publication because the magazine is created in her department and edited by her . PNW’ s Code of Ethics restricts trading by all of the bank’ s analysts and portfolio managers and requires their trades to be pre-cleared by the Compliance Department. Coursing least likely violated which of the following CF A Institute Standards of Professional Conduct ?
scenario_cn: PNW 银⾏出版《 Investment Monthly 》杂志，每期重 点推荐⼀只股票，杂志发表总使被推荐股票⼤涨。 市场部经理 Rachel Coursing （ CFA ）经常在杂志出版 前交易⽂中提及的证券 —— 杂志由她所在部⻔制作并 由她编辑，故她能提前获知推荐内容。 PNW 的道德 守则限制该⾏所有分析师和组合经理交易并要求预 审。 Coursing 最不可能违反下列哪条准则？

options.A: Priority of Transactions 交易优先
options.B: Diligence and Reasonable Basis 勤勉与合理依据
options.C: Material Nonpublic Information 重⼤⾮公开信息

explanation: （当时未作答） Coursing 没有为客⼾分析投资、提出建议或采取投资⾏动，故未违反 Standard V 投资分 析、建议与⾏动（ V(A) ）。但她违反了 VI(B) Priority of Transactions （客⼾未优先于本⼈受益的交易）和 II(A) Material Nonpublic Information （杂志内容在⼴泛传播前属⾮公开信息，且发表必然重⼤影响股价；即便银⾏不 要求她预审， II(A) 仍限制其交易）。
method: least likely 题：市场部员⼯不做投资分析 → V(A) 不适⽤；抢在出版前交易 = II(A)+VI(B) 。
header: 准则应⽤ · 交易优先 VI(B)/ 重⼤⾮公开信息 II(A) 当时未作答
required_actions: 客户交易优先于个人交易；禁止抢先交易
不得利用或促使他人利用重大非公开信息
基于充分研究与合理依据提出建议

scenario_en: A large manufacturing company is seeking help finding a fund manager for its pension plan. After a comprehensive but unsuccessful search, Brett Arun, CF A, is hired to solicit proposals from various fund managers. The client pays Arun a lump sum fee for his services. The search concludes with Ramport Investments being hired as the pension plan’ s manager . A year after Ramport is hired, the pension administrator sends Arun a letter telling him how satisfied the pension trustees are with the services provided by the fund manager . Subsequently , without the plan sponsor ’s knowledge, Arun accepts a payment from Ramport for successfully introducing it to the pension plan under an agreement Arun entered into with Ramport when the initial contact with the fund manager was made. With regard to the payment received, did Arun most likely violate the CF A Institute Code of Ethics and Standards of Professional Conduct by accepting the introductory fee?
scenario_cn: ⼀家⼤型制造企业为其养⽼⾦计划寻找基⾦管理 ⼈，全⾯搜寻⽆果后聘⽤ Brett Arun （ CFA ）向各基 ⾦管理⼈征求⽅案，客⼾⽀付其⼀次性费⽤。最终 Ramport Investments 获聘。⼀年后，养⽼⾦管理⼈致 信 Arun 表⽰受托⼈对该管理⼈很满意。随后，在计 划发起⼈不知情的情况下， Arun 按其与 Ramport 在 初次接触时达成的协议，接受了 Ramport ⽀付的「成 功介绍费」。就接受的这笔款项， Arun 是否违反了准 则？

options.A: No 否
options.B: Yes, because he did not disclose his acceptance of the introductory fee to the client是，因为他未向客⼾披露其接受了介绍费
options.C: Yes, because he should have refused payment of the introductory fee from the fund manager是，因为他本应拒绝基⾦管理⼈⽀付的这笔介绍 费

explanation: （当时未作答） Arun 未在客⼾聘⽤ Ramport 之前披露其与 Ramport 的费⽤安排，已违反 Standard VI(C) Referral Fees ；此时唯⼀补救是拒绝该款项，从⽽废⽌与 Ramport 的协议、消除利益冲突。 B 错：即便现在向 客⼾披露，也不满⾜ VI(C) 「在客⼾做出聘⽤决定之前披露」的时点要求。
method: 介绍费时点题：披露必须在客⼾决定之前；事后披露不合格，只能拒收费⽤消除冲突。
header: 准则应⽤ · 介绍费 VI(C) 当时未作答
required_actions: 披露并取得相关方同意后收取介绍费

scenario_en: Roberto Sanchez, CF A, and Andreas Lopez, CF A, worked as financial analysts for OneW orld Analytics for years. While at OneW orld, Lopez created a highly complex financial valuation model with Sanchez making small contributions to its development. Recently , Lopez left OneW orld to start his own company using a simplified model he developed prior to joining OneW orld. Over a six-month period, he improves this software, duplicating features he used at OneW orld. His upgraded program produces predictions similar to the results of the OneW orld program. At OneW orld, Sanchez continues to use the complex model he and Lopez developed and attains superior results. Whose behavior most likely conforms to the CFA Institute Standards of Professional Conduct ?
scenario_cn: Roberto Sanchez （ CFA ）与 Andreas Lopez （ CFA ）曾 在 OneWorld Analytics 任⾦融分析师多年。在职期间 Lopez 创建了⼀个⾼度复杂的估值模型， Sanchez 有 少量贡献。最近 Lopez 离职创业，使⽤其⼊职 OneWorld 之前开发的简化模型，并在六个⽉内改进 该软件，复制了他在 OneWorld 使⽤过的功能，升级 后程序产⽣与 OneWorld 模型相近的预测结果。 Sanchez 则留在 OneWorld 继续使⽤两⼈开发的复杂 模型并取得优异成果。谁的⾏为最符合准则？

options.A: Lopez but not Sanchez Lopez 符合⽽ Sanchez 不符合
options.B: Sanchez but not Lopez Sanchez 符合⽽ Lopez 不符合
options.C: Both Lopez and Sanchez 两⼈都符合

explanation: （当时未作答）两⼈在为雇主完成的⼯作⽅⾯都遵守了 Standard I(C) Misrepresentation ：软件归公司⽽⾮ 开发者个⼈所有， Sanchez 有权继续使⽤主要由 Lopez 开发的模型； Lopez 离职时未带⾛在职期间开发的模 型，不违反准则；他离职后基于⼊职前⾃创的简化模型另⾏开发，该简化模型仍属其知识产权，复制功能属 Standard IV(A) Loyalty 允许的范围（在前雇主获得的专业技能不算保密或特权信息）。故两⼈都符合准则。
method: 雇主财产题两分法：在职开发成果归雇主；⼊职前成果 + 通⽤技能归个⼈，可复制改进。
header: 准则应⽤ · 知识产权 IV(A)/I(C) 当时未作答
required_actions: 不得剥夺雇主技能优势；避免利益冲突
不得作出虚假陈述或遗漏重大事实；纠正错误信息

scenario_en: Anna Saar , CFA, is the head of compliance for Tranne Advisory Services, a regional financial services group including asset management, investment banking, and stock brokerage entities. Reviewing a draft client investment management agreement for the asset management unit, she is concerned that the relationships between the firm’ s various business units are not properly disclosed. To prevent violating CFA Institute Standard VI(A), Avoid or Disclose Conflicts, which of the following should least likely be addressed in the investment management agreement?
scenario_cn: Anna Saar （ CFA ）是地区性⾦融服务集团 Tranne Advisory Services 的合规主管，集团旗下有资产管 理、投资银⾏和股票经纪业务。审查资产管理单元 客⼾投资管理协议草案时，她担⼼集团各业务部⻔ 之间的关系未被适当披露。为避免违反 Standard VI(A)（避免或披露冲突），协议中最不需要涉及下列 哪项？

options.A: The group subsidizes staf f loans for share purchases 集团为员⼯购股贷款提供补贴
options.B: Management fees are frequently loss leaders for brokerage 管理费常作为经纪业务的亏本引流产品
options.C: Asset managers are likely to support corporate finance deals 资产管理⼈员很可能⽀持投⾏的企业融资交易

explanation: （当时未作答）集团补贴员⼯购股贷款只是⼀种融资机制，不会妨碍提供投资建议或采取投资⾏动时的 客观性，对客⼾不构成利益冲突，⽆需在协议中披露。 B （以亏损管理费引流⾄集团经纪服务）和 C （资产管 理⼈员⽀持投⾏企业融资交易）均属跨部⻔利益冲突，应在跨部⻔冲突部分披露（另涉及 VI(B) ）。
method: 披露题区分「内部员⼯福利」与「跨部⻔利益输送」 ：前者不是客⼾冲突，后者必须披露。
header: 准则应⽤ · 冲突披露 VI(A) 当时未作答
required_actions: 充分披露影响独立性的利益冲突
客户交易优先于个人交易；禁止抢先交易

scenario_en: While at a bar in the financial district after work, Ellen Miffitt, CF A, overhears several employees of a competitor discuss how they will manipulate down the price of a thinly traded micro cap stock’ s price over the next few days. Miffitt’s clients have lar ge positions of this stock so when she arrives at work the next day she immediately sells all of these holdings. Because she had determined the micro cap stock was suitable for all of her accounts at its previously higher price, Mif fitt buys back her client’ s original exposure at the end of the week at the new , lower price. Which CF A Institute Standards of Professional Conduct did Mif fitt least likely violate?
scenario_cn: 下班后在⾦融区酒吧， Ellen Miffitt （ CFA ）⽆意中听 到竞争对⼿的⼏名员⼯讨论未来⼏天将如何操纵压 低⼀只交投清淡的⼩盘股价格。 Miffitt 的客⼾⼤量持 有该股，次⽇上班她⽴即卖出客⼾全部持仓。由于 她此前认定该⼩盘股在较⾼价位时适合所有账⼾， 周末她以更低价格买回原有敞⼝。 Miffitt 最不可能违 反哪条准则？

options.A: Market manipulation 市场操纵
options.B: Preservation of confidentiality 保密
options.C: Material nonpublic information 重⼤⾮公开信息

explanation: （当时未作答）保密准则（ III(E) ）涉及的是前、现、潜在客⼾的信息，本案不涉及客⼾信息泄露，故未 违反。 A 她违反 II(B) ：虽⾮操纵发起者，但在下跌市中卖出（清淡⼩盘股极易被成交量影响）加剧了价格异 动，且通过回购企图利⽤操纵获利； C 她违反 II(A) ：关于即将执⾏的⼤额交易指令的信息属重⼤⾮公开信 息，她据此前交易。
method: least likely 题找「不沾边」准则：本案⽆客⼾信息环节， III(E) 安全；跟⻛利⽤操纵也算 II(B) 。
header: 准则应⽤ · 市场操纵 II(B)/ 保密 III(E) 当时未作答
required_actions: 不得操纵市场价格或成交量
对客户及前雇主信息保密
不得利用或促使他人利用重大非公开信息

scenario_en: Sergio Morales, CF A, believes he has found evidence that his supervisor is engaged in fraudulent activity involving a client’ s account. When Morales confronts his supervisor , he is told the client is fully aware of the issue. Later that day , Morales contacts the client and upon disclosing the fraudulent activity , is told by the client to mind his own business. Following the requirements of local law , Morales provides all of his evidence, along with copies of the client’ s most recent account statements, to a government whistle blower program. Has Morales most likely violated the CF A Institute Standards of Professional Conduct ?
scenario_cn: Sergio Morales （ CFA ）认为发现其主管参与涉及某客 ⼾账⼾的欺诈活动的证据。他质问主管，被告知客 ⼾完全知情。当天他联系客⼾披露该欺诈⾏为，客 ⼾却让他少管闲事。按当地法律要求， Morales 把全 部证据及客⼾最近的对账单副本提交给政府举报⼈ 计划。 Morales 是否违反了准则？

options.A: No 否
options.B: Yes, concerning duties to employers . 是，关于对雇主的职责。
options.C: Yes, concerning preservation of confidentiality . 是，关于保密。

explanation: （当时未作答） Morales 相信其主管（且客⼾可能也参与）从事欺诈活动，他按当地法律要求通过政府 举报⼈计划提交证据，未违反 Standard III(E) Preservation of Confidentiality （法律要求披露 / 涉嫌⾮法活动时披 露客⼾信息属允许情形），也未违反 Standard IV 对雇主的职责。
method: 保密例外：法律要求或客⼾涉嫌违法时，向监管机构披露不构成 III(E) 违反。
header: 准则应⽤ · 保密 III(E)/ 举报 当时未作答
required_actions: 对客户及前雇主信息保密

scenario_en: Dilshan Kumar , CFA, is a world-renowned mining analyst based in London. Recently he received an invitation from Cerberus Mining, a London Stock Exchange listed company with headquarters in Johannesbur g, South Africa. Cerberus asked Kumar to join a group of prominent analysts from around the world on a tour of their mines in South Africa, some of which are in remote locations, not easily accessible. The invitation also includes an arranged wildlife safari to Krueger National Park for the analysts. Kumar accepts the invitation planning to visit other mining companies he covers in Namibia and Botswana after the safari. To prevent violating any CF A Institute Standards of Professional Conduct , it is most appropriate for Kumar to only accept which type of paid travel arrangements from Cerberus?
scenario_cn: Dilshan Kumar （ CFA ）是驻伦敦的世界知名矿业分析 师，获 Cerberus Mining （伦敦上市、总部约翰内斯 堡）邀请，与全球知名分析师团⼀起考察其在南⾮ 的矿⼭（部分地处偏远、交通不便），⾏程还包括安 排的克鲁格国家公园野⽣动物游。 Kumar 接受邀请， 并计划在游猎后顺访其覆盖的纳⽶⽐亚和博茨⽡纳 矿业公司。为避免违反准则，他最应该只接受 Cerberus ⽀付的哪类差旅安排？

options.A: Ground transportation to Krueger National Park 前往克鲁格国家公园的地⾯交通
options.B: Economy class round trip ticket from London to Johannesbur g伦敦⾄约翰内斯堡的经济舱往返机票
options.C: Flights on a private airplane to the remote mining sites in South Africa⻜往南⾮偏远矿区的私⼈⻜机航班

explanation: （当时未作答） Standard I(B) Independence and Objectivity ：最佳实践是只接受前往偏远矿区的交通，因为 那⾥难以⾃⾏安排商业航班、地⾯交通也不可⾏。 B 不合适：考察矿⼭本属其⽇常⼯作，且他还要顺访其他 国家矿⼭，由 Cerberus ⽀付伦敦往返机票不恰当； A 不合适：游猎可随团参加，但应⾃付费⽤，以免该馈赠 影响其对 Cerberus 投资建议的客观性。
method: 差旅受礼规则：只接受「⽆法⾃⾏安排」的交通（偏远矿区包机） ，常规机票与娱乐活动⾃费。
header: 准则应⽤ · 独⽴客观性 I(B)/ 差旅礼品 当时未作答
required_actions: 拒绝可能损害独立客观性的礼品、招待或好处

scenario_en: Jack Steyn, CF A, recently became the head of the trading desk at a lar ge investment management firm that specializes in domestic equities. While reviewing the firm’ s trading operations he notices that clients give discretion to the manager to select brokers on the basis of their overall services to the management firm. Despite the client directive, Steyn would most likely violate Standard III(A)- Loyalty , Prudence, and Care if he pays soft commissions for which of the following services from the brokers?
scenario_cn: Jack Steyn （ CFA ）最近成为⼀家专做国内股票的⼤ 型投资管理公司交易台主管。审查交易操作时他注 意到，客⼾授权管理⼈根据券商对管理公司的整体 服务来选择券商。尽管有客⼾授权，若 Steyn ⽤软佣 ⾦⽀付券商的下列哪项服务，他最可能违反 Standard III(A)-忠诚、审慎与尽责？

options.A: Equity research reports 股票研究报告
options.B: Investment conference attendance 参加投资会议
options.C: Database services for of fshore investments 海外投资数据库服务

explanation: （当时未作答） Standard III(A) 规定客⼾经纪佣⾦（ soft commissions ）归客⼾所有，会员只能将客⼾佣⾦ ⽤于使客⼾受益的服务。该公司专做国内股票，海外投资数据库服务不会令其客⼾受益，故⽤软佣⾦⽀付该 服务违反 III(A) 。 A 股票研究报告、 B 参加投资会议都可能产⽣惠及所有客⼾的想法与投资⾏动。
method: 软佣⾦题核⼼：佣⾦属客⼾，只能买「让客⼾受益」的服务；与国内股票⽆关的海外数据库不合格。
header: 准则应⽤ · 忠诚审慎 III(A)/ 软佣⾦ 当时未作答
required_actions: 以客户利益为先；审慎管理客户资产

scenario_en: Claire Jones, CF A, is an analyst following natural gas companies in the United States. At an industry ener gy conference, the CFO of Alpine Ener gy states they are interested in making strategic acquisitions. At a separate event, Alpine’ s head of exploration commented he is bullish on natural gas production prospects within Northeastern Pennsylvania. Jones is aware that Alpine currently has very little exposure to this region. She also knows another company in her universe, Pure Ener gy, Inc., is based in Northeastern Pennsylvania and controls significant assets in the area. Pure Ener gy is highly leveraged, and Jones believes they will need to raise additional capital or partner with another firm to move to the production phase with their assets. Jones attempts to contact Alpine’ s CEO with an unrelated question and is told he is unavailable because he is on a business trip to Northeastern Pennsylvania. Jones updates her research on Pure Ener gy and then recommends the stock to Lisa Wong, CF A, a portfolio manager who purchases significant positions in client accounts. The following week, Pure Ener gy announces that they have entered into an agreement to be purchased by Alpine for a significant premium. Has either Jones or Wong most likely violated Standards with regards to the integrity of capital markets ?
scenario_cn: Claire Jones （ CFA ）是美国天然⽓⾏业分析师。⾏业 能源会议上 Alpine Energy 的 CFO 称有意进⾏战略收 购；另⼀场合 Alpine 勘探主管表⽰看好宾⼣法尼亚 州东北部的天然⽓⽣产前景。 Jones 知道 Alpine 在该 地区敞⼝很⼩，且其覆盖的 Pure Energy 公司正位于 该地、控制⼤量资产、杠杆很⾼，她认为 Pure 需要 融资或引⼊合作⽅才能进⼊⽣产阶段。 Jones 因⼀个 不相关的问题联系 Alpine 的 CEO ，被告知 CEO 正在 宾州东北部出差。 Jones 更新了对 Pure Energy 的研究 并向组合经理 Lisa Wong （ CFA ）推荐该股， Wong 为 客⼾账⼾⼤量买⼊。⼀周后 Pure Energy 宣布与 Alpine 达成⾼溢价收购协议。 Jones 或 Wong 是否在 资本市场诚信⽅⾯违反了准则？

options.A: No 否
options.B: Yes, Jones’ recommendation is based on insider information 是， Jones 的建议基于内幕信息
options.C: Yes, both Jones and Wong have acted on insider information 是， Jones 和 Wong 都依据内幕信息⾏动

explanation: （当时错选 B ） Jones 运⽤⻢赛克理论，将⾮重⼤的⾮公开信息（ CEO 出差地点，孤⽴看并不重⼤）与 重⼤公开信息相结合得出结论，不构成对 Standard II(A) 的违反， Wong 据此买⼊也不违规。错选 B 是把「出 差地点」这类孤⽴⾮重⼤信息误当作内幕信息。 ===== PAGE 105 ===== Guidance for Standards I-VII 准则 I-VII 应⽤指南 105 图⽰ ⻢赛克理论：公开信息 + ⾮重⼤⾮公开信息可组合使⽤；重⼤⾮公开信息严禁交易
method: ⻢赛克理论题：单条⾮公开信息若不重⼤，与公开信息拼图后使⽤不违反 II(A) 。
header: 准则应⽤ · ⻢赛克理论 II(A) 当时做错 · 错选 B
required_actions: 不得利用或促使他人利用重大非公开信息

scenario_en: Justin Blake, CF A, a retired portfolio manager , owns 20,000 shares of a small public company that he would like to sell because he is worried about the company’ s prospects. He posts messages on several internet bulletin boards. The messages read, “This stock is going up once the pending patents are released, so now is the time to buy . The stock is a buy at anything below ＄ 3. I have done some close research on these guys.” According to the Standards of Practice Handbook, Blake most likely violated the Standard(s) relating to:
scenario_cn: Justin Blake （ CFA ）是⼀名退休组合经理，持有某⼩ 型上市公司 20,000 股，因担⼼公司前景想卖出。他 在多个⽹络论坛发帖称：「待批专利⼀旦发布这股就 会涨，现在正是买⼊时机，＄ 3 以下都是买点。我对 这家公司做过深⼊研究。」根据《执业标准⼿册》， Blake 最可能违反了哪条（些）准则？

options.A: Market Manipulation , but not Avoid or Disclose Conflicts. 市场操纵，但不涉及避免或披露冲突。
options.B: both Market Manipulation and Avoid or Disclose Conflicts. 市场操纵和避免或披露冲突均违反。
options.C: neither Market Manipulation nor Avoid or Disclose Conflicts. 两者均未违反。

explanation: （当时未作答） Blake 为卖出持股⽽在论坛散布夸⼤信息，属于可能⼈为抬⾼交易量 / 价格的⾏为，违反 Standard II(B) Market Manipulation 。 Standard VI(A) 要求向客⼾、潜在客⼾和雇主披露利益冲突， Blake 已退 休、⽆此类受众，故⽆需披露、未违反 VI(A) 。
method: 操纵题：为了⾃⼰出货发帖唱多 = II(B) ； VI(A) 披露义务对象是客⼾ / 雇主，退休个⼈⽆此义务。
header: 准则应⽤ · 市场操纵 II(B) 当时未作答
required_actions: 不得操纵市场价格或成交量
充分披露影响独立性的利益冲突

scenario_en: William Wong, CF A, is an equity analyst with Hayswick Securities. Based on his fundamental analysis, Wong concludes that the stock of a company he follows, Nolvec Inc., is substantially undervalued and will experience a lar ge price increase. He delays revising his recommendation on the stock from “hold” to “buy” to allow his brother to buy shares at the current price. Wong is least likely to have violated the CFA Institute Standards of Professional Conduct related to:
scenario_cn: William Wong （ CFA ）是 Hayswick Securities 的股票 分析师。基于基本⾯分析，他认为所跟踪的 Nolvec Inc. 股票被严重低估、将⼤幅上涨。为让哥哥能以现 价买⼊，他推迟把该股建议从「持有」上调为「买 ⼊」。 Wong 最不可能违反哪⽅⾯的准则？

options.A: duty to clients. 对客⼾的职责。
options.B: reasonable basis. 合理依据。
options.C: priority of transactions . 交易优先。

explanation: （当时未作答）没有任何迹象表明 Wong 的结论缺乏合理依据（ Standard V(A) ），故未违反。 A 、 C 均违 反：为让哥哥低价买⼊⽽推迟上调建议，违反了客⼾职责（ III(A) Loyalty, Prudence, and Care ）与交易优先 （VI(B)）。
method: least likely 题：结论本⾝有基本⾯⽀撑 → V(A) 不违反；为亲属推迟发布建议 = III(A)+VI(B) 。
header: 准则应⽤ · 客⼾职责 III(A)/ 交易优先 VI(B) 当时未作答
required_actions: 以客户利益为先；审慎管理客户资产
客户交易优先于个人交易；禁止抢先交易
基于充分研究与合理依据提出建议

scenario_en: Ian O’Sullivan, CF A, is the owner and sole employee of two companies, a public relations firm and a financial research firm. The public relations firm entered into a contract with Mallory Enterprises to provide public relations services, with O’Sullivan receiving 40,000 shares of Mallory stock in payment for his services. Over the next 10 days, the public relations firm issued several press releases that discussed Mallory’ s excellent growth prospects. O’Sullivan, through his financial research firm, also published a research report recommending Mallory stock as a “buy .” According to the CFA Institute Standards of Professional Conduct , O’Sullivan is most likely required to disclose his ownership of Mallory stock in:
scenario_cn: Ian O’Sullivan （ CFA ）是两家公司（⼀家公关公司、 ⼀家⾦融研究公司）的所有者兼唯⼀员⼯。公关公 司与 Mallory Enterprises 签订公关服务合同， O’Sullivan 以 40,000 股 Mallory 股票作为服务报酬。 此后 10 天，公关公司发布多份新闻稿宣传 Mallory 的优异增⻓前景；他还通过研究公司发布研究报告 给予 Mallory 「买⼊」建议。根据准则，他最可能必 须在何处披露其持有的 Mallory 股票？

options.A: the press releases only . 仅新闻稿。
options.B: the research report only . 仅研究报告。
options.C: both the press release and the research report. 新闻稿和研究报告均需披露。

explanation: （当时未作答）会员应披露所有可合理预期会损害其客观性的事项［ Standard I(B) 、 Standard VI(A) ］。持 股报酬同时影响新闻稿与研究报告的客观性，两处都必须披露这⼀潜在利益冲突。
method: 持股披露题：凡产出涉及该公司且可能受损客观性的载体（新闻稿 + 研报）都要披露。
header: 准则应⽤ · 冲突披露 VI(A)/I(B) 当时未作答
required_actions: 充分披露影响独立性的利益冲突
拒绝可能损害独立客观性的礼品、招待或好处

scenario_en: Jefferson Piedmont, CF A, a portfolio manager for Park Investments, plans to manage the portfolios of several family members in exchange for a percentage of each portfolio’ s profits. As his family members have extensive portfolios requiring substantial attention, they have requested that Piedmont provide the services outside his employment with Park. Piedmont sends Park a written notice stating that he intends to manage several family members’ portfolios outside his employment with Park. Two weeks later , Piedmont begins managing the family members’ portfolios. By managing these portfolios, which of the following CF A Institute Standards of Professional Conduct has Piedmont violated?
scenario_cn: Jefferson Piedmont （ CFA ）是 Park Investments 的组合 经理，计划为⼏位家庭成员管理组合并收取组合利 润的⼀定⽐例作为报酬。因家庭组合规模庞⼤需⼤ 量精⼒，家⼈要求他在 Park 的⼯作之外提供服务。 Piedmont 向 Park 发出书⾯通知，表明打算在业余为 家庭成员管理组合，两周后即开始管理。他违反了 下列哪条（些）准则？

options.A: Additional compensation 额外报酬
options.B: Avoid or disclose conflicts 避免或披露冲突
options.C: Both additional compensation and avoid or disclose conflicts 额外报酬与避免或披露冲突均违反

explanation: （当时未作答）两条都违反：管理家庭账⼾需投⼊⼤量时间，他未向雇主披露这⼀时间投⼊，违反避免 或披露冲突准则（ VI(A) ）；同时他在获得所有相关⽅书⾯同意之前即从事收费的独⽴执业活动，违反额外报 酬准则（ IV(B)—— 书⾯「通知」不等于取得书⾯「同意」）。
method: 双重违规典型：业余收费理财既要 VI(A) 披露，⼜要 IV(B) 事先书⾯同意； notice≠consent 。
header: 准则应⽤ · 额外报酬 IV(B)/ 冲突披露 VI(A) 当时未作答
required_actions: 向雇主书面披露并取得所有相关方书面同意
充分披露影响独立性的利益冲突

scenario_en: Hui Chen, CF A, develops marketing materials for an investment fund he founded three years ago. The materials show the 3-year , 2-year , and 1-year returns for the fund. He includes a footnote that states in small print “Past performance does not guarantee future returns.” He does not claim compliance with the GIPS standards in the disclosures or footnotes. He also includes a separate sheet showing the most recent semi-annual and quarterly returns, which notes that they have been neither audited nor verified. Has Chen most likely violated any CF A Institute Standards of Professional Conduct ?
scenario_cn: Hui Chen （ CFA ）为其三年前创办的基⾦制作营销材 料，列⽰ 3 年、 2 年、 1 年收益，并以⼩字脚注「过 往业绩不保证未来回报」；未在披露或脚注中声称遵 守 GIPS；另附⼀⻚列⽰最近半年度和季度收益，注 明未经审计或验证。 Chen 是否违反了准则？

options.A: No 否
options.B: Yes, because he included un-audited and unverified results 是，因为他包含了未经审计和验证的结果
options.C: Yes, because he did not adhere to the GIPS standards 是，因为他未遵守 GIPS 标准

explanation: （当时未作答） Standard III(D) Performance Presentation 只要求会员尽合理努⼒确保业绩信息公平、准 确、完整；准则并不要求遵守 GIPS ，也不要求审计或验证（除⾮声称遵守 GIPS ）。 Chen 已作必要的警⽰性披 露且未声称 GIPS 合规，故未违反准则。
method: 业绩陈述题： III(D) 只要公平准确完整； GIPS 、审计、验证均⾮强制（除⾮⾃称 GIPS 合规）。
header: 准则应⽤ · 业绩陈述 III(D) 当时未作答
required_actions: 确保业绩陈述公平、准确、完整

scenario_en: Charlie Mancini, CF A, is the Managing Director for Business Development at SV Financial (SVF), a lar ge US-based mutual fund or ganization. Mancini has been under pressure recently to increase revenues. In order to secure business from a lar ge hedge fund manager based in Asia, Mancini recently approved flexible terms for the fund’ s client agreement. To allow for time zone dif ferences, the agreement permits the hedge fund to trade in all of SVF’ s mutual funds six hours after the close of US markets, which is prohibited by US regulators. Which Standard(s) did Mancini violate?
scenario_cn: Charlie Mancini （ CFA ）是美国⼤型共同基⾦机构 SV Financial（ SVF ）的业务发展董事总经理，近期承受 增收压⼒。为争取⼀家亚洲⼤型对冲基⾦管理⼈的 业务，他批准了灵活的协议条款：以时差为由，允 许该对冲基⾦在美国市场收盘六⼩时后交易 SVF 全 部共同基⾦ —— 此为美国监管所禁⽌。 Mancini 违反 了哪条（些）准则？

options.A: Only relating to fair dealing 仅违反公平对待
options.B: Only relating to knowledge of the law 仅违反知法守法
options.C: Both relating to knowledge of the law and to fair dealing 知法守法与公平对待均违反

explanation: （当时未作答）他允许该对冲基⾦享受其他客⼾没有的特殊交易安排，未平等对待所有客⼾，违反公平 对待准则（ III(B) ）；同时他允许⼀项他应当知道在其雇主所在市场被监管禁⽌的⾏为（ late trading ），违反知 法守法准则（ I(A) ）。
method: 双重违规识别：给单⼀客⼾违规特权 = I(A) （违法） + III(B) （对其他客⼾不公） 。
header: 准则应⽤ · 知法守法 I(A)/ 公平对待 III(B) 当时未作答
required_actions: 遵守适用法律法规；向监管者报告违法行为
公平客观对待所有客户

scenario_en: Ross Nelson, CF A, manages accounts for high-net-worth clients including his own family’ s account. He has no beneficial ownership in his family’ s account. Because Nelson is concerned about the appearance of improper behavior in managing his family’ s account, when his firm purchases a block of securities, Nelson allocates to his family’ s account only those shares that remain after his other client accounts have their orders filled. The fee for managing his family’ s account is based on his firm’ s normal fee structure. According to the Standards of Practice Handbook, Nelson’ s best course of action with regard to management of his family’ s account would be to:
scenario_cn: Ross Nelson （ CFA ）为⾼净值客⼾管理账⼾，其中包 括其家庭账⼾（他在该账⼾⽆受益所有权）。为避 嫌，公司⼤宗买⼊证券时， Nelson 只把其他客⼾订 单满⾜后剩余的股份分给家庭账⼾。家庭账⼾管理 费按公司正常费率收取。根据《执业标准⼿册》， Nelson 管理家庭账⼾的最佳做法是：

options.A: treat the account like other client accounts. 像对待其他客⼾账⼾⼀样对待该账⼾。
options.B: treat the account like other employee accounts of the firm. 像对待公司其他员⼯账⼾⼀样对待该账⼾。
options.C: remove himself from any direct involvement by transferring responsibility for this account to another investment professional in the firm.把该账⼾移交公司其他投资专业⼈⼠，避免⾃⼰ 直接参与。

explanation: （当时未作答） Nelson 对家庭账⼾差别对待，实际上是对家⼈的违约（失职）：家庭账⼾同样是公司客 ⼾，有权获得与其他客⼾相同的待遇［ Standard III(B) Fair Dealing 与 VI(B) Priority of Transactions ］。 B 、 C 均⽆ 必要。
method: 家庭账⼾题与 Q121 呼应：家庭账⼾ = 普通客⼾，刻意「避嫌式」靠后分配同样违反 III(B) 。
header: 准则应⽤ · 公平对待 III(B)/ 家庭账⼾ 当时未作答
required_actions: 公平客观对待所有客户
客户交易优先于个人交易；禁止抢先交易

scenario_en: Several years ago, Leo Peek, CF A, co-founded an investment club. The club is fully invested but has not actively traded its account for at least a year , and does not plan to resume active trading of the account. Peek’ s employer requires an annual disclosure of employee stock ownership. Peek discloses all of his personal trading accounts, but does not disclose his holdings in the investment club. Peek’ s actions are least likely to be a violation of which of the CF A Institute Standards of Professional Conduct ?
scenario_cn: ⼏年前 Leo Peek （ CFA ）与⼈共同创办了⼀家投资俱 乐部。俱乐部已全额投资，但账⼾⾄少⼀年没有主 动交易，也不打算恢复主动交易。 Peek 的雇主要求 每年披露员⼯持股情况。 Peek 披露了所有个⼈交易 账⼾，但未披露其在投资俱乐部的持仓。 Peek 的⾏ 为最不可能违反哪条准则？

options.A: Misrepresentation 虚假陈述
options.B: Transaction priority 交易优先
options.C: Conflicts of interest 利益冲突

explanation: （当时未作答）没有迹象表明该投资俱乐部抢在客⼾之前交易，故未违反 Standard VI(B) Priority of Transactions 。 A 违反：因未披露，相关投资信息构成虚假陈述（ I(C) ）； C 违反：会员应披露所有可能合理引 发利益冲突的受益所有权，且雇主要求披露⽽不报，同时违反雇主政策与 VI(A) 。
method: least likely 题：账⼾不活跃、⽆抢先交易 → VI(B) 不违反；瞒报受益所有权仍踩 I(C)+VI(A) 。
header: 准则应⽤ · 冲突披露 VI(A)/ 交易优先 VI(B) 当时未作答
required_actions: 充分披露影响独立性的利益冲突
客户交易优先于个人交易；禁止抢先交易
不得作出虚假陈述或遗漏重大事实；纠正错误信息

scenario_en: Vishal Chandarana, an unemployed research analyst, recently registered for the CF A Level I exam. After two months of intense interviewing, he accepts a job with a stock brokerage company in a dif ferent region of the country . Chandarana posts on a social media blog how being a CFA candidate really helped him get a job. He also notes how relieved he was when his new employer didn’ t ask him about being fired from his former employer . Which CF A Institute Code of Ethics or Standards of Professional Conduct did Chandarana least likely violate?
scenario_cn: 失业的研究分析师 Vishal Chandarana 最近报名了 CFA ⼀级考试。经过两个⽉密集⾯试，他接受了外地⼀ 家股票经纪公司的⼯作。他在社交媒体博客上发帖 称 CFA 考⽣⾝份确实帮他找到了⼯作，还称很庆幸 新雇主没问起他被前雇主解雇的事。 Chandarana 最不 可能违反哪条准则？

options.A: Misconduct 不当⾏为
options.B: Loyalty to employers 对雇主的忠诚
options.C: Reference to the CF A Program 对 CFA 课程的引⽤

explanation: （当时未作答）没有证据表明他违反 Standard VII(B) ：作为已报名考⽣⾃称 CFA candidate 属如实陈述， 未夸⼤能⼒或暗⽰因此会有超群业绩。但他隐瞒可能损害新雇主声誉的信息（被前雇主解雇），缺乏诚信，违 反 Standard I(D) Misconduct （ A ）与 Standard IV(A) Loyalty （ B ）。
method: least likely 题：如实说「考⽣⾝份助我求职」不违反 VII(B) ；隐瞒被解雇史踩 I(D)+IV(A) 。
header: 准则应⽤ · 不当⾏为 I(D)/ 忠诚 IV(A)/ 称谓 VII(B) 当时未作答
required_actions: 不得从事欺诈、欺骗等有损职业声誉的行为
不得剥夺雇主技能优势；避免利益冲突
按规范引用CFA协会会员资格与头衔

scenario_en: Amanda Covington, CF A, works for McJan Investment Management. McJan employees must receive prior clearance of their personal investments in accordance with McJan’ s compliance procedures. To obtain prior clearance, McJan employees must provide a written request identifying the security , the quantity of the security to be purchased, and the name of the broker through which the transaction will be made. Pre-cleared transactions are approved only for that trading day . As indicated below , Covington received prior clearance. Two days after she received prior clearance, the price of Stock B had decreased, so Covington decided to purchase 250 shares of Stock B only . In her decision to purchase 250 shares of Stock B only , did Covington violate any CF A Institute Standards of Professional Conduct ?
scenario_cn: Amanda Covington （ CFA ）任职于 McJan Investment Management 。按公司合规程序，员⼯个⼈投资须事 先取得书⾯预审批，须写明证券、拟购数量和经纪 商；预审批仅当⽇有效。如下表所⽰， Covington 获 得了预审批（证券 A ： 100 股、 Easy Trade ，已批 准；证券 B ： 150 股、 Easy Trade ，已批准）。获批两 天后， B 股价格下跌， Covington 决定只买⼊ 250 股 B 股。这⼀决定是否违反准则？ Security Quantity Broker Prior Clearance A 100 Easy Trade Yes B 150 Easy Trade Yes

options.A: No 否
options.B: Yes, relating to diligence and reasonable basis 是，与勤勉与合理依据有关
options.C: Yes, relating to her employer ’s compliance procedures 是，与其雇主的合规程序有关

explanation: （当时错选 B ）预审批程序⽤于防范潜在与实际的利益冲突，会员必须遵守雇主的合规程序［ Standard VI(B)］。 Covington 的预审批仅当⽇有效且核定为 150 股，她两天后以不同数量（ 250 股）买⼊，未遵守程 序，构成违规。 B 错：没有任何迹象涉及 Standard V(A) 勤勉与合理依据。
method: 预审批题抓细节：预审批限定证券、数量、券商和当⽇有效，任⼀不符都须重新报批。
header: 准则应⽤ · 交易优先 VI(B)/ 合规程序 当时做错 · 错选 B
required_actions: 客户交易优先于个人交易；禁止抢先交易

scenario_en: Rebecca Wong is enrolled to take the Level I CF A exam. Her friend William Leung purchased Level I study materials from a well-known CF A review program the previous year . Leung made a photocopy of the previous year ’s copyrighted materials and sold it to Wong to help her study . Who most likely violated the CF A Institute Code of Ethics or any Standards of Professional Conduct ?
scenario_cn: Rebecca Wong 报名参加了 CFA ⼀级考试。她的朋友 William Leung 前⼀年购买了某知名 CFA 备考课程的 ⼀级学习资料， Leung 把前⼀年受版权保护的资料复 印后卖给 Wong 助她备考。谁最可能违反了 CFA 道 德准则或职业⾏为标准？

options.A: Only Leung 仅 Leung
options.B: Both Wong and Leung Wong 和 Leung 两⼈
options.C: Neither Wong or Leung 两⼈都未违反

explanation: （当时未作答）⽆论资料出版年份，复印受版权保护的资料均违反 CFA 准则［ Standard I(A) ］ —— 版权 材料受法律保护，考⽣和会员必须遵守所有适⽤法律、规则与规定，且不得明知参与或协助违法⾏为。 Leung 复印出售、 Wong 明知⽽购买使⽤，两⼈均违反。
method: 版权题：复印盗版资料，卖⽅与明知买⽅都违反 I(A) ；「旧年份资料」不是豁免理由。
header: 准则应⽤ · 知法守法 I(A)/ 版权 当时未作答
required_actions: 遵守适用法律法规；向监管者报告违法行为

scenario_en: Timothy Charles, CF A, applies for a role as an investment analyst. In his resume he states, "CF A charterholders achieve better performance results." He adds, "As a CF A charterholder , I am the most qualified to manage client investments." Charles has most likely violated the Standards:
scenario_cn: Timothy Charles （ CFA ）应聘投资分析师职位。他在 简历中写道： "CFA 持证⼈会取得更好的业绩。 " 他还 补充说： " 作为 CFA 持证⼈，我是管理客⼾投资的最 合格⼈选。 "Charles 最可能违反了准则：

options.A: only by stating, "CF A charterholders achieve better performance results."仅因 "CFA 持证⼈会取得更好的业绩 " 这⼀表述
options.B: only by stating, "As a CF A charterholder , I am the most qualified to manage client investments."仅因 "作为 CFA 持证⼈，我是管理客⼾投资的最 合格⼈选 " 这⼀表述
options.C: both by stating, "CF A charterholders achieve better performance results" and by stating, "As a CF A charterholder , I am the most qualified to manage client investments."两种表述均构成违反

explanation: C 正确。两句话都违反 Standard VII(B) （对 CFA 协会、 CFA 称谓及 CFA 项⽬的引⽤）：该准则禁⽌夸⼤ 个⼈能⼒或直接或间接暗⽰持证⼈可预期取得更优业绩。 "CFA charterholders achieve better performance results"与 " 作为持证⼈我最合格 " 均属准则明确列举的不当引⽤（ Improper References ）。 A 、 B 各只指出⼀句， 不完整。（当时未作答）
method: 凡暗⽰ "持证 → 业绩更优 / 能⼒更强 " 的表述都违反 VII(B) ，两句都中招。
header: Standard VII(B) CFA 称谓引⽤ · 夸⼤能⼒ 当时未作答
required_actions: 按规范引用CFA协会会员资格与头衔

scenario_en: According to the Standard relating to fair dealing , when members disseminate investment recommendations, they are most likely required to make every ef fort to treat individual clients in a(n):
scenario_cn: 根据公平对待（ Fair Dealing ）准则，会员在传播投资 推荐时，最可能被要求尽⼀切努⼒以何种⽅式对待 个⼈客⼾：

options.A: fair and equal manner . 公平且平等的⽅式。
options.B: fair and impartial manner . 公平且公正的⽅式。
options.C: equal and impartial manner . 平等且公正的⽅式。

explanation: B 正确。 Standard III(B) 要求会员和考⽣尽⼀切努⼒以公平、公正（ fair and impartial ）的⽅式对待所有个 ⼈和机构客⼾； "fairly" 意味着不得在传播推荐或采取投资⾏动时歧视任何客⼾。准则刻意不⽤ "equally" ，因为 会员不可能在同⼀时刻触达所有客⼾。 A 、 C 含 "equal" ，错误。（当时未作答）
method: III(B) 的关键词是 fair and impartial ；看到 equal 即排除。
header: Standard III(B) 公平对待 · 公平⽽⾮平等 当时未作答
required_actions: 公平客观对待所有客户

scenario_en: Belen Zapata, CF A, is the owner of Kawah Investments. Kawah promises investors returns of up to 12% per year and claims to achieve this by investing in non-investment-grade bonds and other fixed-income instruments. Over the next 12 months, bond market yields reach unprecedented lows, and Zapata finds it impossible to achieve the returns she expected. No investments are ever made by Kawah, and clients are completely paid back all of their original investment. Zapata most likely violated the CF A Institute Standards of Professional Conduct because of the:
scenario_cn: Belen Zapata （ CFA ）是 Kawah Investments 的所有 者。 Kawah 向投资者承诺每年⾼达 12% 的回报，声 称通过投资⾮投资级债券和其他固定收益⼯具实 现。随后 12 个⽉债券市场收益率跌⾄前所未有的低 点， Zapata 发现⽆法实现预期回报。 Kawah 从未进⾏ 任何投资，客⼾的原始投资被全额退还。 Zapata 最可 能因为哪⼀点违反了 CFA 协会职业⾏为标准：

options.A: return of capital. 退还本⾦。
options.B: promised returns. 承诺的收益。
options.C: investment mandate. 投资授权范围。

explanation: B 正确。 Zapata 对其实际可实现的收益作了误导性承诺，违反 Standard I(C)—— 该准则禁⽌就不稳定投 资的特定收益向客⼾作保证。 A 错：退还本⾦本⾝不违规，只是投资者遭受了机会成本损失。 C 错：投资授 权范围定义宽泛，题⼲信息不⾜以判定其不当；可明确识别的违规是承诺了却未兑现的收益。（当时错选此 项）
method: 对波动性投资 " 保证特定收益 " 即违反 I(C) ，与最终是否亏钱⽆关。
header: Standard I(C) 误导陈述 · 保证收益 当时做错 · 错选 C
required_actions: 不得作出虚假陈述或遗漏重大事实；纠正错误信息

scenario_en: Ken Kawasaki, CF A, shares a building with a number of other professionals who are also involved in the investment management business. Kawasaki makes arrangements with several of these professionals, including accountants and lawyers, to refer clients to each other . An informal score is kept on the expectation the referrals will equal out over time, eliminating the need for any cash payments. Kawasaki never mentions this arrangement to clients or prospective clients . Does Kawasaki’ s agreement with the other building occupants most likely violate any CF A Institute Standards of Professional Conduct ?
scenario_cn: Ken Kawasaki （ CFA ）与多名同样从事投资管理业务 的专业⼈⼠同处⼀栋⼤楼。 Kawasaki 与其中⼏⼈ （包括会计师和律师）达成互相推荐客⼾的安排。 双⽅⾮正式记账，期望推荐随时间相互抵消，因⽽ ⽆需现⾦⽀付。 Kawasaki 从未向客⼾或潜在客⼾提 及该安排。 Kawasaki 与同楼⼈⼠的这⼀约定是否最 可能违反 CFA 协会职业⾏为标准？

options.A: No 否
options.B: Yes, related to referral fees 是，与介绍费有关
options.C: Yes, related to communication with clients 是，与客⼾沟通有关

explanation: B 正确。 Standard VI(C) 要求披露因推荐产品或服务⽽从他⼈处收受或向他⼈⽀付的任何报酬、对价或利 益。即使没有现⾦过⼿，该安排也构成客⼾推荐的互惠对价（ quid pro quo ），必须向客⼾披露。 A 错：已构成 违规。 C 错：客⼾沟通准则（ V(B) ）涉及披露投资流程的⼀般原则，⽽⾮推荐报酬披露。（当时未作答）
method: 介绍费不限于现⾦ —— ⾮现⾦互惠介绍安排同样触发 VI(C) 披露义务。
header: Standard VI(C) 介绍费 · ⾮现⾦互惠安排 当时未作答
required_actions: 披露并取得相关方同意后收取介绍费

scenario_en: A member claims a professional designation she has not earned. This action most likely violates the Standard(s) relating to:
scenario_cn: 某会员声称拥有⾃⼰并未获得的专业资格头衔。该 ⾏为最可能违反与下列哪项相关的准则：

options.A: loyalty only . 仅忠诚。
options.B: misconduct only . 仅不当⾏为。
options.C: both loyalty and misconduct . 忠诚与不当⾏为两者。

explanation: C 正确。冒充未获头衔同时违反 Standard IV(A) Loyalty 与 Standard I(D) Misconduct ：该⾏为可能对雇主造 成伤害（使雇主失去其技能优势、损害雇主利益），故违反忠诚准则；同时该⾏为属不诚实、欺诈与欺骗，损 害个⼈职业声誉、诚信与胜任能⼒，故违反不当⾏为准则。 A 、 B 各只说对⼀半。（当时未作答）
method: 虚假头衔双重违规：对雇主有害（ IV(A) ） + 欺诈性职业⾏为（ I(D) ）。
header: Standard I(D)+IV(A) · 冒充未获头衔 当时未作答
required_actions: 不得从事欺诈、欺骗等有损职业声誉的行为
不得剥夺雇主技能优势；避免利益冲突

scenario_en: According to the Standards, which of the following statements relating to a member in a supervisory position is accurate? Statement 1: The member must make reasonable efforts to ensure that anyone subject to her supervision complies with the Code and Standards. Statement 2: The member must adopt the CF A Institute Code of Ethics to substitute for lack of compliance procedures until the firm adopts reasonable procedures to allow adequate exercise of supervisory responsibility .
scenario_cn: 根据准则，下列关于处于主管职位的会员的陈述， 哪⼀项是准确的？陈述 1 ：会员必须尽合理努⼒确保 受其监督的任何⼈遵守道德准则与职业⾏为标准。 陈述 2：在公司采取合理程序使主管能够充分履⾏监 督职责之前，会员必须采⽤ CFA 协会道德准则来替 代缺失的合规程序。

options.A: Statement 1 only 仅陈述 1
options.B: Statement 2 only 仅陈述 2
options.C: Both Statement 1 and Statement 2 陈述 1 和陈述 2 都正确

explanation: A 正确。 Standard IV(C) 要求会员尽合理努⼒确保受其监督者遵守适⽤法律法规及道德准则与标准，陈述 1 准确。陈述 2 不准确：若因合规体系缺失或不完善⽽明显⽆法履⾏监督职责，会员应书⾯拒绝接受监督责 任，直⾄公司建⽴合理程序，⽽不是⽤ CFA 道德准则替代公司合规程序。（当时错选 C ，误以为主管须⾃⾏引 ⼊ CFA 准则补位。）
method: 合规体系缺失时主管的正确动作是 " 书⾯拒绝接受监督职责 " ，⽽⾮拿 CFA 准则当替代品。
header: Standard IV(C) 主管责任 · 两项陈述判断 当时做错 · 错选 C
required_actions: 建立合规程序；监督下属行为

scenario_en: Min Joon, CF A, works in the client services department at an investment firm. Joon has been short-selling stocks on his personal account in anticipation of a significant decline in the market. His transactions do not disadvantage his firm’ s clients. Following a dramatic rise in the markets, Joon is unable to cover his short positions and is forced to declare personal bankruptcy . Has Joon violated the Standards?
scenario_cn: Min Joon （ CFA ）在⼀家投资公司的客⼾服务部⻔⼯ 作。 Joon 预期市场将⼤幅下跌，⼀直⽤个⼈账⼾做 空股票。他的交易并未损害公司客⼾的利益。市场 ⼤涨之后， Joon ⽆法回补空头仓位，被迫宣布个⼈ 破产。 Joon 是否违反了准则？

options.A: No 否
options.B: Yes, the Standard relating to misconduct 是，违反不当⾏为准则
options.C: Yes, the Standard relating to loyalty , prudence, and care 是，违反忠诚、谨慎与注意准则

explanation: A 正确。 Standard I(D) 禁⽌涉及不诚实、欺诈或欺骗的职业⾏为； Joon 的做空与破产并⾮欺诈性或欺骗 性商业⾏为，个⼈破产本⾝未必反映当事⼈的诚信与可信赖性，故不违反 I(D) 。 Standard III(A) 要求以客⼾利 益为先，题⼲⽆任何迹象表明 Joon 未为客⼾利益⾏事，故也不违反 III(A) 。（当时未作答）
method: 个⼈财务困境（⾮欺诈）不属于 I(D) 职业不端；未损害客⼾即不涉 III(A) 。
header: Standard I(D)/III(A) · 个⼈破产与做空 当时未作答
required_actions: 不得从事欺诈、欺骗等有损职业声誉的行为
以客户利益为先；审慎管理客户资产

scenario_en: A member most likely violates the Standard relating to market manipulation if he:
scenario_cn: 下列哪种⾏为最可能使会员违反市场操纵准则：

options.A: secures a dominant position in a stock to win a proxy vote. 为赢得代理权投票⽽取得某股票的主导性持仓。
options.B: exploits market inef ficiencies in a thinly traded penny stock. 利⽤交易清淡的低价股中的市场⽆效性获利。
options.C: places both buy and sell orders of a stock at the same price to increase trading volume.以同⼀价格同时挂出某股票的买单和卖单以放⼤ 交易量。

explanation: C 正确。 Standard II(B) 禁⽌扭曲价格或⼈为放⼤交易量以误导市场参与者的⾏为；同价对敲买卖制造活 跃假象，偏离公平有效市场的预期，属交易型操纵。 A 错：为赢得代理权投票⽽取得控制性持仓属合法策 略。 B 错：基于市场⽆效性的合法交易策略不在禁⽌之列，判断关键在于⾏为意图。（当时未作答）
method: II(B) 看 "意图 " ：制造虚假价格 / 交易量的对敲交易即操纵；合法策略⽬的（如代理权投票）除外。
header: Standard II(B) 市场操纵 · 虚增交易量 当时未作答
required_actions: 不得操纵市场价格或成交量

scenario_en: A member most likely violates the Standard relating to responsibilities of supervisors if she:
scenario_cn: 下列哪种做法最可能使会员违反主管责任准则：

options.A: accepts supervisory duties before ensuring the firm has adopted a codes of ethics .在确认公司已采⽤道德准则之前就接受监督职 责。
options.B: delegates supervisory duties to subordinates who have no prior compliance experience.把监督职责下放给没有合规经验的下属。
options.C: relies on a subordinate’ s statements without initiating an assessment about the extent of a potential violation of the Standards.仅凭下属的陈述了事，未对潜在违规⾏为的范围 启动评估。
